title: "有" fiilinin "没" ile olumsuzu
summary: "有" (yǒu, sahip olmak/var olmak) fiili asla "不" ile değil, her zaman "没" ile olumsuzlanır: 没有 = yok / sahip değil.
explanation: Çince'de neredeyse tüm fiiller "不" ile olumsuzlanır, ama "有" bunun tek büyük istisnasıdır ve her zaman "没" alır. "没有" hem "sahip değilim" (mülkiyet) hem "yok" (varlık) hem de "-medi" (geçmiş eylem) anlamlarında kullanılır. Konuşma dilinde "有" düşüp sadece "没" da kalabilir. "不有" demek dilbilgisi hatasıdır.

examples.zh: 我没有钱。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu qián.
examples.en: I don't have money.

examples.zh: 他没有时间陪家人。
examples.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu shíjiān péi jiārén.
examples.en: He doesn't have time to spend with his family.

examples.zh: 对不起，我今天没有空。
examples.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ jīntiān méiyǒu kòng.
examples.en: Sorry, I don't have time today.

examples.zh: 这个小城市没有机场。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎo chéngshì méiyǒu jīchǎng.
examples.en: This small city doesn't have an airport.

examples.zh: 她没有兄弟姐妹。
examples.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu xiōngdì jiěmèi.
examples.en: She doesn't have any siblings.

examples.zh: 我的手机里没有他的号码。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒujī lǐ méiyǒu tā de hàomǎ.
examples.en: I don't have his number in my phone.

examples.zh: 冰箱里没有牛奶了。
examples.pinyin: Bīngxiāng lǐ méiyǒu niúnǎi le.
examples.en: There's no more milk in the fridge.

examples.zh: 他家没有汽车，所以他每天坐地铁。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiā méiyǒu qìchē, suǒyǐ tā měitiān zuò dìtiě.
examples.en: His family doesn't have a car, so he takes the subway every day.

examples.zh: 我没有你那么高。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu nǐ nàme gāo.
examples.en: I'm not as tall as you.

examples.zh: 这个问题没有正确的答案。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí méiyǒu zhèngquè de dá'àn.
examples.en: This question has no correct answer.

examples.zh: 教室里现在没有人。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshì lǐ xiànzài méiyǒu rén.
examples.en: There is nobody in the classroom right now.

examples.zh: 我没有见过这么美的地方。

examples.en: I've never seen such a beautiful place.

examples.zh: 他工作很努力，可是还是没有钱买房子。
examples.pinyin: Tā gōngzuò hěn nǔlì, kěshì háishì méiyǒu qián mǎi fángzi.

examples.zh: 我们班没有学生迟到。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bān méiyǒu xuésheng chídào.
examples.en: No student in our class was late.

examples.zh: 她没有告诉我她要走。
examples.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu gàosù wǒ tā yào zǒu.
examples.en: She didn't tell me she was leaving.

examples.zh: 这家餐厅没有我喜欢吃的菜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng méiyǒu wǒ xǐhuan chī de cài.
examples.en: This restaurant doesn't have the dishes I like to eat.

examples.zh: 我没有办法帮你解决这个问题。

examples.en: I have no way to help you solve this problem.

examples.zh: 外面下雨了，可是我没有带伞。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn xiàyǔ le, kěshì wǒ méiyǒu dài sǎn.
examples.en: It's raining outside, but I didn't bring an umbrella.

examples.zh: 他说他没有喝酒，但是我不相信。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō tā méiyǒu hējiǔ, dànshì wǒ bù xiāngxìn.

examples.zh: 这么多年了，她一点儿也没有变。
examples.pinyin: Zhème duō nián le, tā yìdiǎnr yě méiyǒu biàn.
examples.en: After so many years, she hasn't changed a bit.

examples.zh: 我昨天太累了，没有做作业。

examples.en: I was too tired yesterday, so I didn't do my homework.

examples.zh: 公司没有给我们发工资。

examples.zh: 他从来没有对我说过谎。

examples.en: He has never lied to me.

examples.zh: 我等了一个小时，可是他没有来。

examples.en: I waited an hour, but he didn't come.

examples.zh: 没有钱不等于没有幸福。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu qián bù děngyú méiyǒu xìngfú.
examples.en: Having no money doesn't mean having no happiness.

title: "不" ile standart olumsuzlama
summary: "不" (bù) fiilin veya sıfatın önüne gelerek onu olumsuzlar; şimdiki, gelecek ve genel/alışkanlık durumları için kullanılır (geçmiş için "没" kullanılır).
explanation: "不", Çince'nin en temel olumsuzluk kelimesidir ve "有" dışındaki fiilleri, ayrıca sıfatları olumsuzlar. Ton kuralı önemlidir: "不" normalde 4. tondadır (bù), ama ardından başka bir 4. ton gelirse 2. tona döner (bú). Gerçekleşmemiş/geçmiş eylemleri anlatmak için "不" değil "没" kullanılır: "不去" = gitmiyorum/gitmeyeceğim, "没去" = gitmedim.

examples.zh: 他们不是坏孩子。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen bú shì huài háizi.
examples.en: They are not bad kids.

examples.zh: 我不喜欢喝咖啡，我喜欢喝茶。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù xǐhuan hē kāfēi, wǒ xǐhuan hē chá.
examples.en: I don't like coffee, I like tea.

examples.zh: 这件衣服不贵，你可以买。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu bú guì, nǐ kěyǐ mǎi.
examples.en: This piece of clothing isn't expensive, you can buy it.

examples.zh: 今天不冷，你不用穿大衣。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān bù lěng, nǐ búyòng chuān dàyī.
examples.en: It's not cold today, you don't need to wear a coat.

examples.zh: 我明天不去上班。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān bú qù shàngbān.
examples.en: I'm not going to work tomorrow.

examples.zh: 他不会说英文，只会说中文。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú huì shuō Yīngwén, zhǐ huì shuō Zhōngwén.
examples.en: He can't speak English, only Chinese.

examples.zh: 对不起，我不知道这件事。
examples.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ bù zhīdào zhè jiàn shì.
examples.en: Sorry, I don't know about this matter.

examples.zh: 她身体不舒服，今天不来了。
examples.pinyin: Tā shēntǐ bù shūfu, jīntiān bù lái le.
examples.en: She's not feeling well, so she's not coming today.

examples.zh: 这个电影不好看，我们看别的吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhège diànyǐng bù hǎokàn, wǒmen kàn biéde ba.
examples.en: This movie isn't good, let's watch something else.

examples.zh: 我不想现在做决定。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng xiànzài zuò juédìng.
examples.en: I don't want to make a decision right now.

examples.zh: 他不常运动，所以身体不太好。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù cháng yùndòng, suǒyǐ shēntǐ bú tài hǎo.
examples.en: He doesn't exercise often, so his health isn't great.

examples.zh: 这条路不好走，我们换一条吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù bù hǎo zǒu, wǒmen huàn yì tiáo ba.
examples.en: This road is hard to walk, let's take another one.

examples.zh: 我不认识那个站在门口的人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bú rènshi nàge zhàn zài ménkǒu de rén.
examples.en: I don't know that person standing at the door.

examples.zh: 他说话不清楚，我听不懂。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà bù qīngchu, wǒ tīng bu dǒng.
examples.en: He doesn't speak clearly, I can't understand him.

examples.zh: 钱不重要，健康才重要。
examples.pinyin: Qián bú zhòngyào, jiànkāng cái zhòngyào.
examples.en: Money isn't important; health is what matters.

examples.zh: 我不饿，你先吃吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bú è, nǐ xiān chī ba.
examples.en: I'm not hungry, you eat first.

examples.zh: 这个孩子很聪明，可是不努力。
examples.pinyin: Zhège háizi hěn cōngming, kěshì bù nǔlì.
examples.en: This child is smart but doesn't work hard.

examples.zh: 如果你不同意，我们可以再商量。

examples.en: If you don't agree, we can discuss it again.

examples.zh: 他不但不感谢我，反而还生气了。
examples.pinyin: Tā búdàn bù gǎnxiè wǒ, fǎn'ér hái shēngqì le.
examples.en: He not only didn't thank me, but even got angry.

examples.zh: 我不太清楚他为什么不来。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bú tài qīngchu tā wèishénme bù lái.
examples.en: I'm not too sure why he isn't coming.

examples.zh: 这个字我不会写。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zì wǒ bú huì xiě.
examples.en: I don't know how to write this character.

examples.zh: 她不愿意跟我们一起去。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú yuànyì gēn wǒmen yìqǐ qù.
examples.en: She's not willing to go with us.

examples.zh: 你不说，别人怎么知道你的想法？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù shuō, biérén zěnme zhīdào nǐ de xiǎngfǎ?
examples.en: If you don't speak, how will others know what you think?

examples.zh: 这里的天气不冷也不热，很舒服。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de tiānqì bù lěng yě bú rè, hěn shūfu.
examples.en: The weather here is neither cold nor hot, very comfortable.

examples.zh: 我们不应该浪费时间。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bù yīnggāi làngfèi shíjiān.
examples.en: We shouldn't waste time.

title: "都" ile "hepsi/tümü" belirteci
summary: "都" (dōu, hepsi/hep) çoğul özneden sonra, fiilden önce gelir ve "hepsi, tümü" anlamı katar.
explanation: "都", kastettiği ismin ARDINDAN, fiil veya sıfattan ÖNCE gelir — Türkçe'deki gibi öznenin başına değil. Yani "Hepimiz gidiyoruz" = 我们都去 (biz + hepsi + git). Olumsuzlukla birlikte konum anlamı değiştirir: "都不" = hiçbiri/hepsi değil, "不都" = hepsi değil (bazıları). "每" (her) ile birlikte neredeyse her zaman "都" kullanılır.

examples.zh: 我们都住在上海。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dōu zhù zài Shànghǎi.
examples.en: We all live in Shanghai.

examples.zh: 他们都是我的好朋友。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen dōu shì wǒ de hǎo péngyou.
examples.en: They are all my good friends.

examples.zh: 这些菜我都很喜欢吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē cài wǒ dōu hěn xǐhuan chī.
examples.en: I like eating all of these dishes.

examples.zh: 我们班的学生都会说一点儿英文。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bān de xuésheng dōu huì shuō yìdiǎnr Yīngwén.
examples.en: All the students in our class can speak a little English.

examples.zh: 每天早上他都去公园跑步。
examples.pinyin: Měitiān zǎoshang tā dōu qù gōngyuán pǎobù.
examples.en: Every morning he goes to the park to run.

examples.zh: 这里的东西都不便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de dōngxi dōu bù piányi.
examples.en: None of the things here are cheap.

examples.zh: 大家都同意了这个计划。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu tóngyì le zhège jìhuà.
examples.en: Everyone agreed to this plan.

examples.zh: 我的两个孩子都在上大学。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de liǎng ge háizi dōu zài shàng dàxué.
examples.en: Both of my children are in university.

examples.zh: 他每次考试都是第一名。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi cì kǎoshì dōu shì dì yī míng.
examples.en: He comes first in every exam.

examples.zh: 这些问题我都回答不了。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē wèntí wǒ dōu huídá bu liǎo.
examples.en: I can't answer any of these questions.

examples.zh: 无论我说什么，他都不听。
examples.pinyin: Wúlùn wǒ shuō shénme, tā dōu bù tīng.
examples.en: No matter what I say, he doesn't listen.

examples.zh: 我们全家人周末都在家休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen quánjiā rén zhōumò dōu zài jiā xiūxi.
examples.en: Our whole family rests at home on weekends.

examples.zh: 这条街上的商店晚上都关门。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo jiē shàng de shāngdiàn wǎnshang dōu guānmén.
examples.en: The shops on this street all close at night.

examples.zh: 他连一句话都不想跟我说。
examples.pinyin: Tā lián yí jù huà dōu bù xiǎng gēn wǒ shuō.
examples.en: He doesn't even want to say a single word to me.

examples.zh: 我们都很想念以前的老师。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dōu hěn xiǎngniàn yǐqián de lǎoshī.
examples.en: We all miss our former teacher a lot.

examples.zh: 这些照片每一张都有故事。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē zhàopiàn měi yì zhāng dōu yǒu gùshi.
examples.en: Each of these photos has a story.

examples.zh: 他把所有的钱都花在了旅行上。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ suǒyǒu de qián dōu huā zài le lǚxíng shàng.
examples.en: He spent all his money on traveling.

examples.zh: 孩子们听到这个消息都很开心。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen tīngdào zhège xiāoxi dōu hěn kāixīn.
examples.en: The children were all happy to hear this news.

examples.zh: 我们俩都不会做饭。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen liǎ dōu bú huì zuòfàn.
examples.en: Neither of us can cook.

examples.zh: 这个城市一年四季都很暖和。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì yì nián sìjì dōu hěn nuǎnhuo.
examples.en: This city is warm all year round.

examples.zh: 她说的每一个字我都记得很清楚。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō de měi yí ge zì wǒ dōu jìde hěn qīngchu.
examples.en: I remember every word she said very clearly.

examples.zh: 不是所有人都喜欢这种音乐。
examples.pinyin: Bú shì suǒyǒu rén dōu xǐhuan zhè zhǒng yīnyuè.
examples.en: Not everyone likes this kind of music.

examples.zh: 考试以后,大家都松了一口气。
examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì yǐhòu, dàjiā dōu sōng le yì kǒu qì.
examples.en: After the exam, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.

examples.zh: 这几天我每天都很忙。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān wǒ měitiān dōu hěn máng.
examples.en: These days I'm busy every single day.

examples.zh: 他们兄弟俩长得都很像爸爸。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen xiōngdì liǎ zhǎng de dōu hěn xiàng bàba.
examples.en: The two brothers both look a lot like their father.

title: "也" ile "de/da" belirteci
summary: "也" (yě, de/da) özneden sonra, fiil veya sıfattan önce gelerek "o da, aynı şekilde" anlamı verir.
explanation: "也" her zaman fiilin/sıfatın hemen önünde durur ve cümlenin başına ya da sonuna konamaz — Türkçe'deki "da/de"nin aksine konumu sabittir. Başka belirteçlerle birlikte kullanılırken genellikle en başta gelir: "也都" (o da hepsi), "也不" (o da değil). "Ben de öyle" gibi kısa onaylar için "我也是" kalıbı kullanılır.

examples.zh: 昨天很冷,今天也很冷。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān hěn lěng, jīntiān yě hěn lěng.
examples.en: It was cold yesterday, and it's cold today too.

examples.zh: 他是老师,他太太也是老师。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì lǎoshī, tā tàitai yě shì lǎoshī.
examples.en: He is a teacher, and his wife is a teacher too.

examples.zh: 我喜欢这首歌,你也喜欢吗？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan zhè shǒu gē, nǐ yě xǐhuan ma?
examples.en: I like this song, do you like it too?

examples.zh: 我去过北京,也去过上海。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qùguò Běijīng, yě qùguò Shànghǎi.
examples.en: I've been to Beijing, and also to Shanghai.

examples.zh: 他不会游泳,我也不会。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú huì yóuyǒng, wǒ yě bú huì.
examples.en: He can't swim, and neither can I.

examples.zh: 这个道理其实我也不太懂。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dàolǐ qíshí wǒ yě bú tài dǒng.
examples.en: Honestly, I don't quite understand this principle either.

examples.zh: 你累了,我也累了,我们休息一下吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ lèi le, wǒ yě lèi le, wǒmen xiūxi yíxià ba.
examples.en: You're tired, I'm tired too, let's take a rest.

examples.zh: 她会弹钢琴,也会拉小提琴。
examples.pinyin: Tā huì tán gāngqín, yě huì lā xiǎotíqín.
examples.en: She can play the piano, and also the violin.

examples.zh: 就算你不告诉我,我也会知道。
examples.pinyin: Jiùsuàn nǐ bú gàosù wǒ, wǒ yě huì zhīdào.
examples.en: Even if you don't tell me, I'll find out anyway.

examples.zh: 这件事他知道,别人也都知道。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì tā zhīdào, biérén yě dōu zhīdào.
examples.en: He knows about this, and everyone else knows too.

examples.zh: 我妹妹也想跟我们一起去看电影。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei yě xiǎng gēn wǒmen yìqǐ qù kàn diànyǐng.
examples.en: My younger sister also wants to go to the movies with us.

examples.zh: 钱重要,可是时间也很重要。
examples.pinyin: Qián zhòngyào, kěshì shíjiān yě hěn zhòngyào.
examples.en: Money matters, but time matters too.

examples.zh: 他一句话也没说就走了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yí jù huà yě méi shuō jiù zǒu le.
examples.en: He left without saying a single word.

examples.zh: 你放心,再难的问题我们也能解决。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ fàngxīn, zài nán de wèntí wǒmen yě néng jiějué.
examples.en: Don't worry, no matter how hard the problem, we can solve it.

examples.zh: 我以前也是这样想的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐqián yě shì zhèyàng xiǎng de.
examples.en: I used to think this way too.

examples.zh: 下雨的时候,这条河也会变得很危险。
examples.pinyin: Xiàyǔ de shíhou, zhè tiáo hé yě huì biàn de hěn wēixiǎn.
examples.en: When it rains, this river also becomes very dangerous.

examples.zh: 他不喜欢运动,也不喜欢看书。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù xǐhuan yùndòng, yě bù xǐhuan kànshū.
examples.en: He doesn't like sports, nor does he like reading.

examples.zh: 我们试了很多次,可是一次也没成功。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen shì le hěn duō cì, kěshì yí cì yě méi chénggōng.
examples.en: We tried many times, but didn't succeed even once.

examples.zh: 孩子长大了,父母也慢慢变老了。
examples.pinyin: Háizi zhǎngdà le, fùmǔ yě mànman biàn lǎo le.
examples.en: As the children grow up, the parents slowly grow old too.

examples.zh: 这个方法也许也可以试一试。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fāngfǎ yěxǔ yě kěyǐ shì yi shì.
examples.en: Maybe this method is also worth a try.

examples.zh: 你不用担心,即使失败了也没关系。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyòng dānxīn, jíshǐ shībài le yě méi guānxi.
examples.en: Don't worry, even if you fail it doesn't matter.

examples.zh: 我今天心情不好,什么也不想做。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān xīnqíng bù hǎo, shénme yě bù xiǎng zuò.
examples.en: I'm in a bad mood today, I don't want to do anything.

examples.zh: 他不仅聪明,人也很好。
examples.pinyin: Tā bùjǐn cōngming, rén yě hěn hǎo.
examples.en: He's not only smart, but also a good person.

examples.zh: 就是走一天,我也要走到那座山上。
examples.pinyin: Jiùshì zǒu yì tiān, wǒ yě yào zǒudào nà zuò shān shàng.
examples.en: Even if it takes a whole day of walking, I want to reach that mountain.

examples.zh: 你去哪儿我也去哪儿。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ qù nǎr wǒ yě qù nǎr.
examples.en: Wherever you go, I'll go too.

title: "和" ile "ve" bağlacı
summary: "和" (hé, ve) iki ismi (veya isim öbeğini) birbirine bağlar. Yalnızca isimler için kullanılır — cümleleri bağlamak için kullanılmaz.
explanation: "和" Türkçe'deki "ve" gibi görünse de önemli bir fark vardır: yalnızca isimleri/isim öbeklerini bağlar, İngilizce'deki gibi iki tam cümleyi veya fiili bağlamaz. "Ben yemek yerim VE film izlerim" derken "和" kullanılmaz; onun yerine cümleler yan yana dizilir veya başka bağlaçlar kullanılır. İkiden fazla ismi listelerken "和" genellikle sadece son iki öge arasına konur.

examples.zh: 我和他都不去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé tā dōu bú qù.
examples.en: Neither he nor I are going.

examples.zh: 桌子上有一本书和一支笔。
examples.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng yǒu yì běn shū hé yì zhī bǐ.
examples.en: There's a book and a pen on the table.

examples.zh: 我喜欢中国菜和日本菜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan Zhōngguó cài hé Rìběn cài.
examples.en: I like Chinese food and Japanese food.

examples.zh: 爸爸和妈妈都在厨房里忙。
examples.pinyin: Bàba hé māma dōu zài chúfáng lǐ máng.
examples.en: Both dad and mom are busy in the kitchen.

examples.zh: 这个周末我和朋友们要去爬山。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò wǒ hé péngyoumen yào qù páshān.
examples.en: This weekend my friends and I are going hiking.

examples.zh: 老师和学生们一起打扫了教室。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī hé xuéshengmen yìqǐ dǎsǎo le jiàoshì.
examples.en: The teacher and the students cleaned the classroom together.

examples.zh: 我的哥哥和姐姐都已经结婚了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de gēge hé jiějie dōu yǐjīng jiéhūn le.
examples.en: My older brother and older sister are both married.

examples.zh: 健康和快乐比钱更重要。
examples.pinyin: Jiànkāng hé kuàilè bǐ qián gèng zhòngyào.
examples.en: Health and happiness are more important than money.

examples.zh: 请把你的名字和电话号码写在这里。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ nǐ de míngzi hé diànhuà hàomǎ xiě zài zhèlǐ.
examples.en: Please write your name and phone number here.

examples.zh: 这本书讲的是历史和文化。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū jiǎng de shì lìshǐ hé wénhuà.
examples.en: This book is about history and culture.

examples.zh: 我和我的同事关系很好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé wǒ de tóngshì guānxi hěn hǎo.
examples.en: I have a good relationship with my colleagues.

examples.zh: 她买了苹果、香蕉和橘子。
examples.pinyin: Tā mǎi le píngguǒ, xiāngjiāo hé júzi.
examples.en: She bought apples, bananas, and oranges.

examples.zh: 春天和秋天是这里最美的季节。
examples.pinyin: Chūntiān hé qiūtiān shì zhèlǐ zuì měi de jìjié.
examples.en: Spring and autumn are the most beautiful seasons here.

examples.zh: 这件事和我一点儿关系也没有。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì hé wǒ yìdiǎnr guānxi yě méiyǒu.
examples.en: This matter has nothing to do with me at all.

examples.zh: 你和他的想法完全不一样。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ hé tā de xiǎngfǎ wánquán bù yíyàng.
examples.en: Your idea and his are completely different.

examples.zh: 我需要一些时间和空间好好想一想。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xūyào yìxiē shíjiān hé kōngjiān hǎohǎo xiǎng yi xiǎng.
examples.en: I need some time and space to think it over.

examples.zh: 老人和孩子在公园里晒太阳。
examples.pinyin: Lǎorén hé háizi zài gōngyuán lǐ shài tàiyáng.
examples.en: The elderly and children are sunbathing in the park.

examples.zh: 这次旅行让我认识了很多新朋友和新地方。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚxíng ràng wǒ rènshi le hěn duō xīn péngyou hé xīn dìfang.
examples.en: This trip introduced me to many new friends and new places.

examples.zh: 成功需要努力和一点点运气。
examples.pinyin: Chénggōng xūyào nǔlì hé yìdiǎndiǎn yùnqì.
examples.en: Success needs hard work and a little bit of luck.

examples.zh: 他和我是从小一起长大的。
examples.pinyin: Tā hé wǒ shì cóngxiǎo yìqǐ zhǎngdà de.
examples.en: He and I grew up together from childhood.

examples.zh: 我把水果和蔬菜放进了冰箱。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ shuǐguǒ hé shūcài fàng jìn le bīngxiāng.
examples.en: I put the fruits and vegetables into the fridge.

examples.zh: 这个城市的白天和晚上完全是两个样子。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de báitiān hé wǎnshang wánquán shì liǎng ge yàngzi.
examples.en: This city looks completely different during the day and at night.

examples.zh: 我和她聊了很久关于未来的事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé tā liáo le hěn jiǔ guānyú wèilái de shì.
examples.en: She and I talked for a long time about the future.

examples.zh: 父母的爱和支持给了我很大的力量。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ de ài hé zhīchí gěi le wǒ hěn dà de lìliàng.
examples.en: My parents' love and support gave me great strength.

examples.zh: 茶和咖啡,你更喜欢哪一个？
examples.pinyin: Chá hé kāfēi, nǐ gèng xǐhuan nǎ yí ge?
examples.en: Tea and coffee, which one do you prefer?

title: "还是" ile seçenek sunma
summary: "还是" (háishì), bir soruda iki seçenek sunmak için A ile B'nin arasına konur: "A mı yoksa B mi?"
explanation: "还是", cevabı iki (veya daha fazla) belirli seçenek arasından isteyen seçmeli sorularda kullanılır. Bu tür sorularda cümlenin sonuna "吗" EKLENMEZ, çünkü "还是" zaten soruyu oluşturur. Dikkat: "或者" (huòzhě) da "veya" demektir ama o soru DEĞİL düz cümlelerde kullanılır. Yani soru sorarken "还是", cevap/ifade verirken "或者".

examples.zh: 你要喝茶还是咖啡？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào hē chá háishì kāfēi?
examples.en: Do you want tea or coffee?

examples.zh: 我们今天去还是明天去？
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jīntiān qù háishì míngtiān qù?
examples.en: Are we going today or tomorrow?

examples.zh: 这个是你的还是他的？
examples.pinyin: Zhège shì nǐ de háishì tā de?
examples.en: Is this yours or his?

examples.zh: 你想吃米饭还是面条？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng chī mǐfàn háishì miàntiáo?
examples.en: Do you want to eat rice or noodles?

examples.zh: 我们坐地铁还是坐出租车比较快？
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zuò dìtiě háishì zuò chūzūchē bǐjiào kuài?
examples.en: Is it faster to take the subway or a taxi?

examples.zh: 你是学生还是老师？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shì xuésheng háishì lǎoshī?
examples.en: Are you a student or a teacher?

examples.zh: 这件事我应该告诉他还是不告诉他？
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ yīnggāi gàosù tā háishì bú gàosù tā?
examples.en: Should I tell him about this or not?

examples.zh: 你喜欢住在城市还是住在乡下？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan zhù zài chéngshì háishì zhù zài xiāngxià?
examples.en: Do you prefer living in the city or the countryside?

examples.zh: 你想现在走还是等雨停了再走？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng xiànzài zǒu háishì děng yǔ tíng le zài zǒu?
examples.en: Do you want to leave now or wait until the rain stops?

examples.zh: 你觉得红色的好看还是蓝色的好看？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde hóngsè de hǎokàn háishì lánsè de hǎokàn?
examples.en: Do you think the red one looks better or the blue one?

examples.zh: 这次的问题是他的错还是你的错？
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de wèntí shì tā de cuò háishì nǐ de cuò?
examples.en: Is this time's problem his fault or yours?

examples.zh: 你打算坐飞机还是坐火车去？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dǎsuàn zuò fēijī háishì zuò huǒchē qù?
examples.en: Are you planning to go by plane or by train?

examples.zh: 我们是先吃饭还是先看电影？
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen shì xiān chīfàn háishì xiān kàn diànyǐng?
examples.en: Should we eat first or watch the movie first?

examples.zh: 你是一个人来的还是和朋友一起来的？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shì yí ge rén lái de háishì hé péngyou yìqǐ lái de?
examples.en: Did you come alone or with friends?

examples.zh: 这道题的答案是对还是错？
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí de dá'àn shì duì háishì cuò?
examples.en: Is the answer to this question right or wrong?

examples.zh: 你想要大的还是小的？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng yào dà de háishì xiǎo de?
examples.en: Do you want the big one or the small one?

examples.zh: 我们在这里等他还是先进去？
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài zhèlǐ děng tā háishì xiān jìnqù?
examples.en: Should we wait for him here or go in first?

examples.zh: 你更相信他说的还是她说的？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ gèng xiāngxìn tā shuō de háishì tā shuō de?
examples.en: Do you believe more what he said or what she said?

examples.zh: 周末你想休息还是想出去玩？
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò nǐ xiǎng xiūxi háishì xiǎng chūqù wán?
examples.en: On the weekend, do you want to rest or go out and have fun?

examples.zh: 这份工作你打算接受还是拒绝？
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò nǐ dǎsuàn jiēshòu háishì jùjué?
examples.en: Are you going to accept this job or turn it down?

examples.zh: 你想听真话还是想听好话？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng tīng zhēnhuà háishì xiǎng tīng hǎohuà?
examples.en: Do you want to hear the truth or hear nice words?

examples.zh: 这个字读第一声还是第四声？
examples.pinyin: Zhège zì dú dì yī shēng háishì dì sì shēng?
examples.en: Is this character read in the first tone or the fourth tone?

examples.zh: 你们是打算住酒店还是住朋友家？
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen shì dǎsuàn zhù jiǔdiàn háishì zhù péngyou jiā?
examples.en: Are you planning to stay at a hotel or a friend's place?

examples.zh: 是我去找你还是你来找我？
examples.pinyin: Shì wǒ qù zhǎo nǐ háishì nǐ lái zhǎo wǒ?
examples.en: Should I go find you or will you come find me?

examples.zh: 你到底是同意还是不同意？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dàodǐ shì tóngyì háishì bù tóngyì?
examples.en: Do you agree or not, after all?

title: "岁" ile yaş söyleme
summary: Yaş, "Özne + sayı + 岁 (suì)" kalıbıyla söylenir; bu cümlede "是" fiiline gerek yoktur.
explanation: Çince'de yaş bildirirken sayıdan sonra "岁" (suì, yaş) ölçü sözcüğü kullanılır ve genellikle "是" fiili KULLANILMAZ: "我二十岁" (ben yirmi yaşındayım). Yaş sormak için "多大" (büyükler için) veya "几岁" (küçük çocuklar için) kullanılır. "是" yalnızca vurgu için eklenebilir: "我是二十岁".

examples.zh: 我今年二十岁。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīnnián èrshí suì.
examples.en: I am twenty years old this year.

examples.zh: 你女儿几岁了？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ nǚ'ér jǐ suì le?
examples.en: How old is your daughter?

examples.zh: 我弟弟比我小三岁。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi bǐ wǒ xiǎo sān suì.
examples.en: My younger brother is three years younger than me.

examples.zh: 这个孩子才五岁,已经会写字了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège háizi cái wǔ suì, yǐjīng huì xiězì le.
examples.en: This child is only five years old and can already write.

examples.zh: 她奶奶今年八十岁了,身体还很好。
examples.pinyin: Tā nǎinai jīnnián bāshí suì le, shēntǐ hái hěn hǎo.
examples.en: Her grandma is eighty this year and still in good health.

examples.zh: 请问您多大岁数了？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn nín duō dà suìshu le?
examples.en: May I ask how old you are?

examples.zh: 我三十岁才开始学中文。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ sānshí suì cái kāishǐ xué Zhōngwén.
examples.en: I only started learning Chinese at thirty.

examples.zh: 他十八岁那年离开了家乡。
examples.pinyin: Tā shíbā suì nà nián líkāi le jiāxiāng.
examples.en: He left his hometown the year he turned eighteen.

examples.zh: 我儿子明年就十岁了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ érzi míngnián jiù shí suì le.
examples.en: My son will be ten years old next year.

examples.zh: 两个孩子,一个七岁,一个九岁。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng ge háizi, yí ge qī suì, yí ge jiǔ suì.
examples.en: Two children, one is seven and one is nine.

examples.zh: 她看起来不像四十岁的人。
examples.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐlái bú xiàng sìshí suì de rén.
examples.en: She doesn't look like a forty-year-old.

examples.zh: 我爷爷九十岁的时候还每天散步。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yéye jiǔshí suì de shíhou hái měitiān sànbù.
examples.en: My grandpa still went for a walk every day at ninety.

examples.zh: 孩子六岁以后就应该上学了。
examples.pinyin: Háizi liù suì yǐhòu jiù yīnggāi shàngxué le.
examples.en: Children should go to school after they turn six.

examples.zh: 我二十五岁那年找到了第一份工作。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ èrshíwǔ suì nà nián zhǎodào le dì yī fèn gōngzuò.
examples.en: I found my first job the year I was twenty-five.

examples.zh: 这只小狗才两岁,很爱玩。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī xiǎogǒu cái liǎng suì, hěn ài wán.
examples.en: This puppy is only two years old and loves to play.

examples.zh: 他不到三十岁就当上了经理。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú dào sānshí suì jiù dāngshàng le jīnglǐ.
examples.en: He became a manager before he was even thirty.

examples.zh: 我妹妹今年十六岁,正在上高中。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei jīnnián shíliù suì, zhèngzài shàng gāozhōng.
examples.en: My sister is sixteen this year and is in high school.

examples.zh: 人到了六十岁一般就可以退休了。
examples.pinyin: Rén dào le liùshí suì yìbān jiù kěyǐ tuìxiū le.
examples.en: People can generally retire once they reach sixty.

examples.zh: 你猜猜她多大岁数？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ cāicai tā duō dà suìshu?
examples.en: Guess how old she is?

examples.zh: 我十二岁的时候开始学游泳。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shí'èr suì de shíhou kāishǐ xué yóuyǒng.
examples.en: I started learning to swim when I was twelve.

examples.zh: 他四十多岁了,还像年轻人一样有活力。
examples.pinyin: Tā sìshí duō suì le, hái xiàng niánqīngrén yíyàng yǒu huólì.
examples.en: He's in his forties but still as energetic as a young person.

examples.zh: 这个小女孩三岁就会背很多首诗。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎo nǚhái sān suì jiù huì bèi hěn duō shǒu shī.
examples.en: This little girl could recite many poems at just three.

examples.zh: 到了一定的岁数,人就会开始怀念过去。
examples.pinyin: Dào le yídìng de suìshu, rén jiù huì kāishǐ huáiniàn guòqù.
examples.en: At a certain age, people start to miss the past.

examples.zh: 我今年已经不小了,不能再像小孩子一样。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīnnián yǐjīng bù xiǎo le, bù néng zài xiàng xiǎoháizi yíyàng.
examples.en: I'm not young anymore and can't act like a child.

examples.zh: 她比我大两岁,但是我们像同龄人一样。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǐ wǒ dà liǎng suì, dànshì wǒmen xiàng tónglíngrén yíyàng.
examples.en: She's two years older than me, but we're like peers.

title: "个" ölçü sözcüğü
summary: Çince'de sayı ile isim arasına bir ölçü sözcüğü girer; "个" (ge) en yaygın ve genel amaçlı olanıdır.
explanation: Çince'de bir ismi sayarken doğrudan "sayı + isim" denmez; araya bir ölçü sözcüğü (量词) girer. "个" en genel ölçü sözcüğüdür ve doğru ölçü sözcüğünü bilmediğinizde çoğu insanla ilgili ve genel nesne için kullanılabilir. "个" genellikle hafif tonda (ge) okunur. "这/那" (bu/şu) ve "几" (kaç) de sayı gibi davranır: 这个人 (bu kişi), 几个 (kaç tane).

examples.zh: 我有一个问题想问你。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí ge wèntí xiǎng wèn nǐ.
examples.en: I have a question I want to ask you.

examples.zh: 我们班有三十个学生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bān yǒu sānshí ge xuésheng.
examples.en: Our class has thirty students.

examples.zh: 这个人我好像在哪里见过。
examples.pinyin: Zhège rén wǒ hǎoxiàng zài nǎlǐ jiànguò.
examples.en: I feel like I've seen this person somewhere.

examples.zh: 给我两个苹果和一个橘子。
examples.pinyin: Gěi wǒ liǎng ge píngguǒ hé yí ge júzi.
examples.en: Give me two apples and one orange.

examples.zh: 他一个人住在这么大的房子里。
examples.pinyin: Tā yí ge rén zhù zài zhème dà de fángzi lǐ.
examples.en: He lives alone in such a big house.

examples.zh: 这个月我花了很多钱。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yuè wǒ huā le hěn duō qián.
examples.en: I spent a lot of money this month.

examples.zh: 我想请你帮我一个忙。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ yí ge máng.
examples.en: I'd like to ask you for a favor.

examples.zh: 那个穿红衣服的女孩是谁？
examples.pinyin: Nàge chuān hóng yīfu de nǚhái shì shéi?
examples.en: Who is that girl in the red clothes?

examples.zh: 我们花了三个小时才到山顶。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen huā le sān ge xiǎoshí cái dào shāndǐng.
examples.en: It took us three hours to reach the mountaintop.

examples.zh: 这几个孩子都很有礼貌。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ ge háizi dōu hěn yǒu lǐmào.
examples.en: These few children are all very polite.

examples.zh: 他每个星期都会给妈妈打一个电话。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi ge xīngqī dōu huì gěi māma dǎ yí ge diànhuà.
examples.en: He calls his mom once every week.

examples.zh: 这个决定改变了我的一生。
examples.pinyin: Zhège juédìng gǎibiàn le wǒ de yìshēng.
examples.en: This decision changed my whole life.

examples.zh: 桌子上放着几个空杯子。
examples.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng fàngzhe jǐ ge kōng bēizi.
examples.en: There are a few empty cups on the table.

examples.zh: 我认识一个会说五种语言的人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ rènshi yí ge huì shuō wǔ zhǒng yǔyán de rén.
examples.en: I know a person who can speak five languages.

examples.zh: 这个星期天我们打算去看一个朋友。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīngqītiān wǒmen dǎsuàn qù kàn yí ge péngyou.
examples.en: This Sunday we plan to visit a friend.

examples.zh: 他一口气吃了三个包子。
examples.pinyin: Tā yì kǒu qì chī le sān ge bāozi.
examples.en: He ate three buns in one go.

examples.zh: 每个人都有自己的梦想。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng.
examples.en: Everyone has their own dream.

examples.zh: 我在这个城市住了十个年头了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài zhège chéngshì zhù le shí ge niántóu le.
examples.en: I've lived in this city for ten years now.

examples.zh: 这个办法听起来是个好主意。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bànfǎ tīng qǐlái shì ge hǎo zhǔyi.
examples.en: This method sounds like a good idea.

examples.zh: 他给我讲了一个很有意思的故事。
examples.pinyin: Tā gěi wǒ jiǎng le yí ge hěn yǒu yìsi de gùshi.
examples.en: He told me a very interesting story.

examples.zh: 我们需要再找几个人来帮忙。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào zài zhǎo jǐ ge rén lái bāngmáng.
examples.en: We need to find a few more people to help.

examples.zh: 这个季节的水果又新鲜又便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jìjié de shuǐguǒ yòu xīnxiān yòu piányi.
examples.en: The fruit this season is both fresh and cheap.

examples.zh: 他是一个值得信任的人。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yí ge zhídé xìnrèn de rén.
examples.en: He is a person worth trusting.

examples.zh: 我想在市中心买一个小房子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zài shìzhōngxīn mǎi yí ge xiǎo fángzi.
examples.en: I want to buy a small house in the city center.

examples.zh: 这个世界上没有一个人是完美的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shìjiè shàng méiyǒu yí ge rén shì wánměi de.
examples.en: There is no perfect person in this world.

title: Tarihlerin yapısı
pattern: Sayı + 年 + Sayı + 月 + Sayı + 号
summary: Çince'de tarih büyükten küçüğe yazılır: önce yıl (年), sonra ay (月), sonra gün (号/日).
explanation: Çince tarih sıralaması Türkçe'nin tersidir: en büyük birimden en küçüğe gider — yıl → ay → gün. Yıl için "年" (nián), ay için "月" (yuè), gün için konuşma dilinde "号" (hào) veya resmî yazıda "日" (rì) kullanılır. Aylar sadece sayı + 月'dir: 一月 (Ocak), 十二月 (Aralık). Bu cümlelerde de "是" çoğu zaman kullanılmaz.

examples.zh: 今天是三月八号。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shì sān yuè bā hào.
examples.en: Today is March 8th.

examples.zh: 我的生日是十月一号。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de shēngri shì shí yuè yī hào.
examples.en: My birthday is October 1st.

examples.zh: 他们打算在明年五月结婚。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen dǎsuàn zài míngnián wǔ yuè jiéhūn.
examples.en: They plan to get married next May.

examples.zh: 这家公司是二零一零年成立的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī shì èr líng yī líng nián chénglì de.
examples.en: This company was founded in 2010.

examples.zh: 考试是下个月十五号。
examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì shì xià ge yuè shíwǔ hào.
examples.en: The exam is on the 15th of next month.

examples.zh: 我是一九九五年出生的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shì yī jiǔ jiǔ wǔ nián chūshēng de.
examples.en: I was born in 1995.

examples.zh: 从七月一号开始放暑假。
examples.pinyin: Cóng qī yuè yī hào kāishǐ fàng shǔjià.
examples.en: Summer vacation starts on July 1st.

examples.zh: 每年十二月都很冷。
examples.pinyin: Měinián shí'èr yuè dōu hěn lěng.
examples.en: December is cold every year.

examples.zh: 她的婚礼定在六月十号。
examples.pinyin: Tā de hūnlǐ dìng zài liù yuè shí hào.
examples.en: Her wedding is set for June 10th.

examples.zh: 这件事发生在去年八月。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì fāshēng zài qùnián bā yuè.
examples.en: This happened last August.

examples.zh: 我们的会议改到了三月二十号。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de huìyì gǎidào le sān yuè èrshí hào.
examples.en: Our meeting was moved to March 20th.

examples.zh: 中国的春节一般在一月或二月。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó de Chūnjié yìbān zài yī yuè huò èr yuè.
examples.en: Chinese New Year is usually in January or February.

examples.zh: 请在四月底以前交作业。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng zài sì yuè dǐ yǐqián jiāo zuòyè.
examples.en: Please hand in the homework before the end of April.

examples.zh: 他是二零零八年来到北京的。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì èr líng líng bā nián láidào Běijīng de.
examples.en: He came to Beijing in 2008.

examples.zh: 我记得那天是九月三号,天气很好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìde nà tiān shì jiǔ yuè sān hào, tiānqì hěn hǎo.
examples.en: I remember that day was September 3rd, and the weather was nice.

examples.zh: 新学期从九月一号开始。
examples.pinyin: Xīn xuéqī cóng jiǔ yuè yī hào kāishǐ.
examples.en: The new semester starts on September 1st.

examples.zh: 这本书是二零二零年出版的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū shì èr líng èr líng nián chūbǎn de.
examples.en: This book was published in 2020.

examples.zh: 你的护照到明年三月就过期了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de hùzhào dào míngnián sān yuè jiù guòqī le.
examples.en: Your passport expires next March.

examples.zh: 十一月的天气不冷也不热。
examples.pinyin: Shíyī yuè de tiānqì bù lěng yě bú rè.
examples.en: November weather is neither cold nor hot.

examples.zh: 我们是二零一五年五月认识的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen shì èr líng yī wǔ nián wǔ yuè rènshi de.
examples.en: We met in May 2015.

examples.zh: 下个星期五是四月一号。
examples.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqīwǔ shì sì yuè yī hào.
examples.en: Next Friday is April 1st.

examples.zh: 这个节日每年十月都会举行。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiérì měinián shí yuè dōu huì jǔxíng.
examples.en: This festival is held every October.

examples.zh: 我打算七月中旬去旅行。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎsuàn qī yuè zhōngxún qù lǚxíng.
examples.en: I plan to travel in mid-July.

examples.zh: 他的合同到十二月三十一号结束。
examples.pinyin: Tā de hétong dào shí'èr yuè sānshíyī hào jiéshù.
examples.en: His contract ends on December 31st.

examples.zh: 我永远记得二零一二年那个夏天。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒngyuǎn jìde èr líng yī èr nián nàge xiàtiān.
examples.en: I'll always remember that summer of 2012.

title: Haftanın günlerinin yapısı
titleEn: Structure of days of the week
summary: Haftanın günleri "星期" (xīngqī) + sayı ile yapılır: 星期一 (Pazartesi) ... 星期六 (Cumartesi). Pazar istisnadır: 星期天/星期日.
explanation: Haftanın günleri çok düzenlidir: "星期" (hafta) + gün sayısı. 星期一 = 1. gün = Pazartesi, 星期二 = Salı, ... 星期六 = Cumartesi. Pazar için sayı değil "天" veya "日" kullanılır: 星期天 (konuşma) / 星期日 (resmî). "礼拜" (lǐbài) de aynı anlamda kullanılabilir. Bu cümlelerde de "是" çoğunlukla düşer: 今天星期三.

examples.zh: 今天星期三,后天星期五。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān xīngqīsān, hòutiān xīngqīwǔ.
examples.en: Today is Wednesday, the day after tomorrow is Friday.

examples.zh: 我们每个星期一开会。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen měi ge xīngqīyī kāihuì.
examples.en: We have a meeting every Monday.

examples.zh: 星期六我不用上班。
examples.pinyin: Xīngqīliù wǒ búyòng shàngbān.
examples.en: I don't have to work on Saturday.

examples.zh: 这家博物馆星期一不开门。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā bówùguǎn xīngqīyī bù kāimén.
examples.en: This museum is closed on Mondays.

examples.zh: 你星期几有空？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xīngqī jǐ yǒu kòng?
examples.en: Which day of the week are you free?

examples.zh: 我们打算星期天去爬山。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dǎsuàn xīngqītiān qù páshān.
examples.en: We plan to go hiking on Sunday.

examples.zh: 从星期一到星期五我都很忙。
examples.pinyin: Cóng xīngqīyī dào xīngqīwǔ wǒ dōu hěn máng.
examples.en: I'm busy from Monday to Friday.

examples.zh: 他每个星期二晚上去学画画。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi ge xīngqī'èr wǎnshang qù xué huàhuà.
examples.en: He goes to painting class every Tuesday evening.

examples.zh: 这个星期四是我的生日。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīngqīsì shì wǒ de shēngri.
examples.en: This Thursday is my birthday.

examples.zh: 星期五下班以后我们一起去吃饭吧。
examples.pinyin: Xīngqīwǔ xiàbān yǐhòu wǒmen yìqǐ qù chīfàn ba.
examples.en: Let's have dinner together after work on Friday.

examples.zh: 我上个星期天睡了一整天。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shàng ge xīngqītiān shuì le yìzhěng tiān.
examples.en: I slept the whole day last Sunday.

examples.zh: 下个星期一我要去出差。
examples.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqīyī wǒ yào qù chūchāi.
examples.en: I'm going on a business trip next Monday.

examples.zh: 孩子们最喜欢星期六和星期天。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen zuì xǐhuan xīngqīliù hé xīngqītiān.
examples.en: Children like Saturdays and Sundays the most.

examples.zh: 这个星期三我们没有课。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīngqīsān wǒmen méiyǒu kè.
examples.en: We don't have class this Wednesday.

examples.zh: 她答应我下个星期四给我回信。
examples.pinyin: Tā dāying wǒ xià ge xīngqīsì gěi wǒ huíxìn.
examples.en: She promised to reply to me next Thursday.

examples.zh: 星期天的早上,街上人很少。
examples.pinyin: Xīngqītiān de zǎoshang, jiē shàng rén hěn shǎo.
examples.en: On Sunday mornings, there are few people on the streets.

examples.zh: 我们的中文课是每个星期二和星期四。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de Zhōngwén kè shì měi ge xīngqī'èr hé xīngqīsì.
examples.en: Our Chinese class is every Tuesday and Thursday.

examples.zh: 星期一总是让人觉得很累。
examples.pinyin: Xīngqīyī zǒngshì ràng rén juéde hěn lèi.
examples.en: Mondays always make people feel tired.

examples.zh: 这个星期六有一场重要的比赛。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīngqīliù yǒu yì chǎng zhòngyào de bǐsài.
examples.en: There's an important match this Saturday.

examples.zh: 我忘了今天是星期几了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wàng le jīntiān shì xīngqī jǐ le.
examples.en: I forgot what day of the week it is today.

examples.zh: 每个星期天我都会给父母打电话。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge xīngqītiān wǒ dōu huì gěi fùmǔ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.en: I call my parents every Sunday.

examples.zh: 我们的假期从这个星期五开始。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de jiàqī cóng zhège xīngqīwǔ kāishǐ.
examples.en: Our vacation starts this Friday.

examples.zh: 他星期三就要回国了。
examples.pinyin: Tā xīngqīsān jiù yào huíguó le.
examples.en: He's going back to his country this Wednesday.

examples.zh: 下个星期六我要参加一个婚礼。
examples.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqīliù wǒ yào cānjiā yí ge hūnlǐ.
examples.en: Next Saturday I'm attending a wedding.

examples.zh: 一个星期有七天,可是感觉过得很快。
examples.pinyin: Yí ge xīngqī yǒu qī tiān, kěshì gǎnjué guò de hěn kuài.
examples.en: A week has seven days, but it feels like it passes quickly.

title: Sayıların yapısı
pattern: Sayı + Birim (十 / 百 / 千 / 万)
summary: Çince sayılar 十 (on), 百 (yüz), 千 (bin), 万 (on bin) birimleriyle düzenli biçimde kurulur.
explanation: Çince sayı sistemi çok düzenlidir: 11 = 十一 (on-bir), 20 = 二十 (iki-on), 35 = 三十五 (üç-on-beş). Yüzler 百, binler 千, ve önemli fark: Çince'de 万 (on bin) ayrı bir birimdir. Yani 10.000 = 一万, 100.000 = 十万. "二" (èr) ve "两" (liǎng) her ikisi de "iki" demektir ama farklı yerlerde kullanılır (ayrı konu).

examples.zh: 三百五十九是一个奇数。
examples.pinyin: Sānbǎi wǔshíjiǔ shì yí ge jīshù.
examples.en: 359 is an odd number.

examples.zh: 这本书一共有五百多页。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū yígòng yǒu wǔbǎi duō yè.
examples.en: This book has over five hundred pages in total.

examples.zh: 这台电脑要八千块钱。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái diànnǎo yào bāqiān kuài qián.
examples.en: This computer costs eight thousand yuan.

examples.zh: 我们公司有一千多个员工。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī yǒu yìqiān duō ge yuángōng.
examples.en: Our company has over a thousand employees.

examples.zh: 这座城市有五百万人口。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì yǒu wǔbǎiwàn rénkǒu.
examples.en: This city has a population of five million.

examples.zh: 从一数到一百对孩子来说不难。
examples.pinyin: Cóng yī shǔ dào yìbǎi duì háizi lái shuō bù nán.
examples.en: Counting from one to a hundred isn't hard for a child.

examples.zh: 这次活动来了三千多个人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng lái le sānqiān duō ge rén.
examples.en: Over three thousand people came to this event.

examples.zh: 他一个月挣一万块钱。
examples.pinyin: Tā yí ge yuè zhèng yíwàn kuài qián.
examples.en: He earns ten thousand yuan a month.

examples.zh: 这条河有两千多公里长。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé yǒu liǎngqiān duō gōnglǐ cháng.
examples.en: This river is over two thousand kilometers long.

examples.zh: 一年有三百六十五天。
examples.pinyin: Yì nián yǒu sānbǎi liùshíwǔ tiān.
examples.en: A year has three hundred sixty-five days.

examples.zh: 这幅画卖了十万块钱。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú huà mài le shíwàn kuài qián.
examples.en: This painting sold for a hundred thousand yuan.

examples.zh: 他家离公司大概有二十公里。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiā lí gōngsī dàgài yǒu èrshí gōnglǐ.
examples.en: His home is about twenty kilometers from the company.

examples.zh: 这个数字太大了,我念不出来。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shùzì tài dà le, wǒ niàn bu chūlái.
examples.en: This number is too big, I can't read it out.

examples.zh: 我们班一共有四十五个学生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bān yígòng yǒu sìshíwǔ ge xuésheng.
examples.en: Our class has forty-five students in total.

examples.zh: 这件事发生在一百多年以前。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì fāshēng zài yìbǎi duō nián yǐqián.
examples.en: This happened over a hundred years ago.

examples.zh: 我数了三遍,一共是九十九个。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shǔ le sān biàn, yígòng shì jiǔshíjiǔ ge.
examples.en: I counted three times, it's ninety-nine in total.

examples.zh: 这次考试满分是一百分。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì mǎnfēn shì yìbǎi fēn.
examples.en: The full score of this exam is one hundred.

examples.zh: 他借了我五千块钱,还没还。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiè le wǒ wǔqiān kuài qián, hái méi huán.
examples.en: He borrowed five thousand yuan from me and hasn't paid it back.

examples.zh: 这个村子只有三百多口人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège cūnzi zhǐ yǒu sānbǎi duō kǒu rén.
examples.en: This village has only a little over three hundred people.

examples.zh: 一万块钱在大城市不够花一个月。
examples.pinyin: Yíwàn kuài qián zài dà chéngshì búgòu huā yí ge yuè.
examples.en: Ten thousand yuan isn't enough for a month in a big city.

examples.zh: 这场音乐会有两千个座位。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng yīnyuèhuì yǒu liǎngqiān ge zuòwèi.
examples.en: This concert has two thousand seats.

examples.zh: 他跑了五千米还不觉得累。
examples.pinyin: Tā pǎo le wǔqiān mǐ hái bù juéde lèi.
examples.en: He ran five thousand meters and still didn't feel tired.

examples.zh: 这本词典有六万多个词。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn cídiǎn yǒu liùwàn duō ge cí.
examples.en: This dictionary has over sixty thousand words.

examples.zh: 从一百减到零需要一点时间。
examples.pinyin: Cóng yìbǎi jiǎn dào líng xūyào yìdiǎn shíjiān.
examples.en: Counting down from a hundred to zero takes a little time.

examples.zh: 这个数加上那个数正好是一千。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shù jiā shàng nàge shù zhènghǎo shì yìqiān.
examples.en: This number plus that number is exactly one thousand.

title: Saatlerin yapısı (temel)
summary: Saat, sayı + "点" (diǎn) ile söylenir: 三点 = saat üç. İsteğe bağlı olarak "钟" eklenebilir.
explanation: Çince'de saat söylerken "点" (diǎn, nokta/saat) kullanılır: 一点 (saat bir), 十点 (saat on). İsteğe bağlı "钟" (zhōng) eklenebilir: 三点钟. Dakika için "分" (fēn) kullanılır (ileri konu). Önemli: "iki" saat söylerken "两点" (liǎng diǎn) denir, "二点" değil. "半" (bàn, yarım) buçuğu belirtir: 三点半 (üç buçuk).

examples.zh: 现在十一点,我们该睡觉了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài shíyī diǎn, wǒmen gāi shuìjiào le.
examples.en: It's eleven o'clock now, we should go to bed.

examples.zh: 我每天早上六点起床。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang liù diǎn qǐchuáng.
examples.en: I get up at six every morning.

examples.zh: 火车八点准时开。
examples.pinyin: Huǒchē bā diǎn zhǔnshí kāi.
examples.en: The train departs at eight sharp.

examples.zh: 我们两点在门口见面吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen liǎng diǎn zài ménkǒu jiànmiàn ba.
examples.en: Let's meet at the door at two o'clock.

examples.zh: 他一般晚上十点以后才回家。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìbān wǎnshang shí diǎn yǐhòu cái huíjiā.
examples.en: He usually gets home only after ten at night.

examples.zh: 现在几点了？我的表停了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài jǐ diǎn le? Wǒ de biǎo tíng le.
examples.en: What time is it now? My watch has stopped.

examples.zh: 商店早上九点开门。
examples.pinyin: Shāngdiàn zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn kāimén.
examples.en: The shop opens at nine in the morning.

examples.zh: 我们下午三点开会。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàwǔ sān diǎn kāihuì.
examples.en: We have a meeting at three in the afternoon.

examples.zh: 电影七点开始,我们六点半出发吧。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐng qī diǎn kāishǐ, wǒmen liù diǎn bàn chūfā ba.
examples.en: The movie starts at seven, let's leave at six thirty.

examples.zh: 他每天工作到晚上十二点。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān gōngzuò dào wǎnshang shí'èr diǎn.
examples.en: He works until twelve at night every day.

examples.zh: 飞机是明天早上五点的。
examples.pinyin: Fēijī shì míngtiān zǎoshang wǔ diǎn de.
examples.en: The flight is at five tomorrow morning.

examples.zh: 我们中午十二点一起吃午饭。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn yìqǐ chī wǔfàn.
examples.en: We have lunch together at noon.

examples.zh: 她答应四点钟来接我。
examples.pinyin: Tā dāying sì diǎn zhōng lái jiē wǒ.
examples.en: She promised to pick me up at four o'clock.

examples.zh: 孩子们八点就要上床睡觉。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen bā diǎn jiù yào shàngchuáng shuìjiào.
examples.en: The children have to go to bed at eight.

examples.zh: 银行一般下午五点关门。
examples.pinyin: Yínháng yìbān xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn guānmén.
examples.en: Banks usually close at five in the afternoon.

examples.zh: 我睡得很晚,昨天两点才睡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shuì de hěn wǎn, zuótiān liǎng diǎn cái shuì.
examples.en: I sleep late; yesterday I only slept at two.

examples.zh: 下午一点是我最困的时候。
examples.pinyin: Xiàwǔ yì diǎn shì wǒ zuì kùn de shíhou.
examples.en: One in the afternoon is when I'm sleepiest.

examples.zh: 我们约好了明天十点在图书馆见。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yuēhǎo le míngtiān shí diǎn zài túshūguǎn jiàn.
examples.en: We agreed to meet at the library at ten tomorrow.

examples.zh: 太阳大概六点钟就升起来了。
examples.pinyin: Tàiyáng dàgài liù diǎn zhōng jiù shēng qǐlái le.
examples.en: The sun rises at about six o'clock.

examples.zh: 现在才三点,离下班还早呢。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài cái sān diǎn, lí xiàbān hái zǎo ne.
examples.en: It's only three now, it's still early before work ends.

examples.zh: 我习惯十一点半上床看书。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xíguàn shíyī diǎn bàn shàngchuáng kànshū.
examples.en: I'm used to reading in bed at eleven thirty.

examples.zh: 比赛四点开始,请提前半个小时到。
examples.pinyin: Bǐsài sì diǎn kāishǐ, qǐng tíqián bàn ge xiǎoshí dào.
examples.en: The match starts at four, please arrive half an hour early.

examples.zh: 他每天七点准时出门。
examples.pinyin: Tā měitiān qī diǎn zhǔnshí chūmén.
examples.en: He leaves home at seven sharp every day.

examples.zh: 我们晚上八点在餐厅有个约会。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen wǎnshang bā diǎn zài cāntīng yǒu ge yuēhuì.
examples.en: We have a date at the restaurant at eight in the evening.

examples.zh: 都十点了,你怎么还不起床？
examples.pinyin: Dōu shí diǎn le, nǐ zěnme hái bù qǐchuáng?
examples.en: It's already ten, why aren't you up yet?

title: "的" olmadan yakınlık iyeliği
summary: Aile üyeleri ve çok yakın ilişkilerde iyelik "的" olmadan söylenebilir: 我妈妈 (annem), 你朋友 (arkadaşın).
explanation: İyelik normalde "的" (de) ile kurulur (我的书 = benim kitabım), ama söz konusu ilişki çok yakınsa — aile üyeleri, yakın arkadaşlar, ait olunan kurum — "的" genellikle atılır: 我妈妈, 他哥哥, 我们学校, 你们公司. Bu daha doğal ve samimi durur. "的" eklemek yanlış olmaz ama gereksiz kalır.

examples.zh: 我妈妈做的菜特别好吃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma zuò de cài tèbié hǎochī.
examples.en: The food my mom makes is especially delicious.

examples.zh: 你哥哥今年多大了？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ gēge jīnnián duō dà le?
examples.en: How old is your older brother this year?

examples.zh: 他爸爸是一位有名的医生。
examples.pinyin: Tā bàba shì yí wèi yǒumíng de yīshēng.
examples.en: His father is a famous doctor.

examples.zh: 我们学校离这里不太远。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào lí zhèlǐ bú tài yuǎn.
examples.en: Our school isn't too far from here.

examples.zh: 她奶奶今年八十多岁了。
examples.pinyin: Tā nǎinai jīnnián bāshí duō suì le.
examples.en: Her grandmother is over eighty this year.

examples.zh: 你们公司有多少员工？
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen gōngsī yǒu duōshao yuángōng?
examples.en: How many employees does your company have?

examples.zh: 我弟弟特别喜欢踢足球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi tèbié xǐhuan tī zúqiú.
examples.en: My younger brother especially loves playing soccer.

examples.zh: 他女朋友是个很温柔的人。
examples.pinyin: Tā nǚpéngyou shì ge hěn wēnróu de rén.
examples.en: His girlfriend is a very gentle person.

examples.zh: 我们家有一只很可爱的猫。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jiā yǒu yì zhī hěn kě'ài de māo.
examples.en: Our family has a very cute cat.

examples.zh: 你妹妹长得跟你很像。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ mèimei zhǎng de gēn nǐ hěn xiàng.
examples.en: Your little sister looks a lot like you.

examples.zh: 我爷爷年轻的时候当过老师。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yéye niánqīng de shíhou dāngguò lǎoshī.
examples.en: My grandfather was a teacher when he was young.

examples.zh: 他儿子明年就要上大学了。
examples.pinyin: Tā érzi míngnián jiù yào shàng dàxué le.
examples.en: His son is going to university next year.

examples.zh: 我们老师对每个学生都很好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen lǎoshī duì měi ge xuésheng dōu hěn hǎo.
examples.en: Our teacher is nice to every student.

examples.zh: 你太太做的蛋糕真好看。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ tàitai zuò de dàngāo zhēn hǎokàn.
examples.en: The cake your wife made looks really nice.

examples.zh: 我姐姐在国外工作已经五年了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie zài guówài gōngzuò yǐjīng wǔ nián le.
examples.en: My older sister has been working abroad for five years.

examples.zh: 他们家的房子在山上,风景很美。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen jiā de fángzi zài shān shàng, fēngjǐng hěn měi.
examples.en: Their house is on the mountain, with beautiful scenery.

examples.zh: 我朋友昨天从北京来看我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ péngyou zuótiān cóng Běijīng lái kàn wǒ.
examples.en: My friend came from Beijing to visit me yesterday.

examples.zh: 你父母知道这件事吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ fùmǔ zhīdào zhè jiàn shì ma?
examples.en: Do your parents know about this?

examples.zh: 我们班长是个很负责任的人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bānzhǎng shì ge hěn fùzérèn de rén.
examples.en: Our class monitor is a very responsible person.

examples.zh: 他叔叔在这个城市开了一家饭馆。
examples.pinyin: Tā shūshu zài zhège chéngshì kāi le yì jiā fànguǎn.
examples.en: His uncle opened a restaurant in this city.

examples.zh: 我妈妈总是担心我吃不好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma zǒngshì dānxīn wǒ chī bu hǎo.
examples.en: My mom always worries that I'm not eating well.

examples.zh: 你同学里有会说中文的吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ tóngxué lǐ yǒu huì shuō Zhōngwén de ma?
examples.en: Are there any Chinese speakers among your classmates?

examples.zh: 我们邻居是一对很热情的老夫妻。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen línjū shì yí duì hěn rèqíng de lǎo fūqī.
examples.en: Our neighbors are a very warm old couple.

examples.zh: 他孩子还小,需要人照顾。
examples.pinyin: Tā háizi hái xiǎo, xūyào rén zhàogù.
examples.en: His child is still young and needs care.

examples.zh: 我家离地铁站走路只要五分钟。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lí dìtiě zhàn zǒulù zhǐ yào wǔ fēnzhōng.
examples.en: My home is only a five-minute walk from the subway station.

title: "的" ile iyelik
summary: "的" (de) iki isim arasına girerek iyelik/aitlik kurar: 我的书 = benim kitabım, 老师的车 = öğretmenin arabası.
explanation: "的", Türkçe'deki "-in/-nin" iyelik ekine karşılık gelir ve sahibi ile sahip olunan şeyin arasına konur: A + 的 + B = A'nın B'si. Bağlam açıksa ikinci isim düşebilir: 这是我的 (bu benim). Ayrıca sıfat/öbek + 的 + isim kalıbıyla isimleri niteler (ayrı konu). Yakın ilişkilerde "的" atılabilir (bkz. önceki konu).

examples.zh: 这是我的书,那是他的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de shū, nà shì tā de.
examples.en: This is my book, that one is his.

examples.zh: 老师的车停在楼下。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī de chē tíng zài lóuxià.
examples.en: The teacher's car is parked downstairs.

examples.zh: 这个手机是谁的？
examples.pinyin: Zhège shǒujī shì shéi de?
examples.en: Whose phone is this?

examples.zh: 我忘了带今天的作业。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wàng le dài jīntiān de zuòyè.
examples.en: I forgot to bring today's homework.

examples.zh: 孩子的笑声让整个房间都变亮了。
examples.pinyin: Háizi de xiàoshēng ràng zhěnggè fángjiān dōu biàn liàng le.
examples.en: The child's laughter brightened the whole room.

examples.zh: 这是我一生中最重要的决定。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ yìshēng zhōng zuì zhòngyào de juédìng.
examples.en: This is the most important decision of my life.

examples.zh: 你的想法和我的完全一样。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de xiǎngfǎ hé wǒ de wánquán yíyàng.
examples.en: Your idea is exactly the same as mine.

examples.zh: 这本书的作者是一位年轻人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū de zuòzhě shì yí wèi niánqīngrén.
examples.en: The author of this book is a young person.

examples.zh: 公司的规定不允许我们迟到。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de guīdìng bù yǔnxǔ wǒmen chídào.
examples.en: The company's rules don't allow us to be late.

examples.zh: 这件事的结果让所有人都很意外。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì de jiéguǒ ràng suǒyǒu rén dōu hěn yìwài.
examples.en: The result of this matter surprised everyone.

examples.zh: 我最喜欢春天的天气。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan chūntiān de tiānqì.
examples.en: I like spring weather the most.

examples.zh: 他把别人的东西当成了自己的。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ biérén de dōngxi dàngchéng le zìjǐ de.
examples.en: He mistook someone else's things for his own.

examples.zh: 这座城市的夜景非常漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì de yèjǐng fēicháng piàoliang.
examples.en: This city's night view is very beautiful.

examples.zh: 我很欣赏她的勇气和努力。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xīnshǎng tā de yǒngqì hé nǔlì.
examples.en: I really admire her courage and hard work.

examples.zh: 这道菜的味道让我想起了家。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài de wèidào ràng wǒ xiǎngqǐ le jiā.
examples.en: The taste of this dish reminded me of home.

examples.zh: 每个人的生活方式都不一样。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén de shēnghuó fāngshì dōu bù yíyàng.
examples.en: Everyone's lifestyle is different.

examples.zh: 这是去年拍的照片。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì qùnián pāi de zhàopiàn.
examples.en: This is a photo taken last year.

examples.zh: 他的成功不是偶然的。
examples.pinyin: Tā de chénggōng bú shì ǒurán de.
examples.en: His success is not accidental.

examples.zh: 我们要尊重别人的选择。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zūnzhòng biérén de xuǎnzé.
examples.en: We should respect other people's choices.

examples.zh: 这份工作的压力有点大。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò de yālì yǒudiǎn dà.
examples.en: The pressure of this job is a bit heavy.

examples.zh: 父母的爱是世界上最无私的。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ de ài shì shìjiè shàng zuì wúsī de.
examples.en: A parent's love is the most selfless in the world.

examples.zh: 我看不懂他写的字。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ kàn bu dǒng tā xiě de zì.
examples.en: I can't read the characters he wrote.

examples.zh: 这个问题的答案其实很简单。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí de dá'àn qíshí hěn jiǎndān.
examples.en: The answer to this question is actually quite simple.

examples.zh: 她的房间总是收拾得很干净。
examples.pinyin: Tā de fángjiān zǒngshì shōushi de hěn gānjìng.
examples.en: Her room is always kept very clean.

examples.zh: 今天的会议改到明天下午了。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de huìyì gǎidào míngtiān xiàwǔ le.
examples.en: Today's meeting has been moved to tomorrow afternoon.

title: "呢" ile soru sorma
summary: "呢" (ne) cümle sonuna gelerek "peki ya...?" anlamında kısa geri-soru yapar veya bir şeyin nerede olduğunu sorar.
explanation: "呢" iki temel işlev görür: (1) Aynı soruyu başkasına yöneltmek: "我很好,你呢?" (Ben iyiyim, ya sen?). Bu durumda tüm soruyu tekrar etmeye gerek kalmaz. (2) Bir şeyin/kişinin nerede olduğunu sormak: "我的钥匙呢?" (Anahtarım nerede?). "呢" ayrıca süregelen bir duruma yumuşak vurgu da katar.

examples.zh: 我很好,你呢？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn hǎo, nǐ ne?
examples.en: I'm doing well, and you?

examples.zh: 我的手机呢？刚才还在这里。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒujī ne? Gāngcái hái zài zhèlǐ.
examples.en: Where's my phone? It was just here.

examples.zh: 我喜欢喝茶,你呢？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan hē chá, nǐ ne?
examples.en: I like drinking tea, how about you?

examples.zh: 孩子们都睡了,你爸爸呢？
examples.pinyin: Háizimen dōu shuì le, nǐ bàba ne?
examples.en: The children are all asleep, where's your dad?

examples.zh: 这个周末我要加班,你们呢？
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò wǒ yào jiābān, nǐmen ne?
examples.en: I have to work overtime this weekend, what about you all?

examples.zh: 我的那本书呢？我记得放在桌子上了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de nà běn shū ne? Wǒ jìde fàng zài zhuōzi shàng le.
examples.en: Where's that book of mine? I remember putting it on the table.

examples.zh: 你要咖啡,那她呢？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào kāfēi, nà tā ne?
examples.en: You want coffee, so what about her?

examples.zh: 大家都到了,张老师呢？
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu dào le, Zhāng lǎoshī ne?
examples.en: Everyone's here, where's Teacher Zhang?

examples.zh: 如果他不同意呢？我们怎么办？
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ tā bù tóngyì ne? Wǒmen zěnme bàn?
examples.en: What if he doesn't agree? What do we do?

examples.zh: 我选了红色的,你觉得蓝色的呢？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xuǎn le hóngsè de, nǐ juéde lánsè de ne?
examples.en: I chose the red one; what do you think of the blue one?

examples.zh: 钱不是问题,可是时间呢？
examples.pinyin: Qián bú shì wèntí, kěshì shíjiān ne?
examples.en: Money isn't the problem, but what about time?

examples.zh: 你的雨伞呢？外面下大雨了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de yǔsǎn ne? Wàimiàn xià dàyǔ le.
examples.en: Where's your umbrella? It's pouring outside.

examples.zh: 我已经准备好了,你呢,准备好了吗？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng zhǔnbèi hǎo le, nǐ ne, zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma?
examples.en: I'm ready, and you, are you ready?

examples.zh: 这个办法不行,那个办法呢？
examples.pinyin: Zhège bànfǎ bùxíng, nàge bànfǎ ne?
examples.en: This method won't work; what about that one?

examples.zh: 我点了面条,你呢,想吃什么？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ diǎn le miàntiáo, nǐ ne, xiǎng chī shénme?
examples.en: I ordered noodles, and you, what do you want to eat?

examples.zh: 猫呢？怎么一整天都没看见它？
examples.pinyin: Māo ne? Zěnme yìzhěng tiān dōu méi kànjiàn tā?
examples.en: Where's the cat? I haven't seen it all day.

examples.zh: 你们都去旅行,那我呢？
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen dōu qù lǚxíng, nà wǒ ne?
examples.en: You're all going traveling, so what about me?

examples.zh: 我记得带钥匙了,可是现在钥匙呢？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìde dài yàoshi le, kěshì xiànzài yàoshi ne?
examples.en: I remember bringing the keys, but where are they now?

examples.zh: 这件事你怎么看呢？
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì nǐ zěnme kàn ne?
examples.en: What's your take on this matter?

examples.zh: 要是明天下雨,我们的计划呢？
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi míngtiān xiàyǔ, wǒmen de jìhuà ne?
examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, what about our plan?

examples.zh: 他们都有答案了,就差你呢。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen dōu yǒu dá'àn le, jiù chà nǐ ne.
examples.en: They all have an answer, only you are left.

examples.zh: 我选择留下来,你呢,打算怎么做？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xuǎnzé liú xiàlái, nǐ ne, dǎsuàn zěnme zuò?
examples.en: I chose to stay; and you, what do you plan to do?

examples.zh: 作业写完了,那你的房间呢,打扫了吗？
examples.pinyin: Zuòyè xiěwán le, nà nǐ de fángjiān ne, dǎsǎo le ma?
examples.en: You finished your homework, but what about your room, did you clean it?

examples.zh: 我的位子呢？怎么有人坐在这里？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de wèizi ne? Zěnme yǒu rén zuò zài zhèlǐ?
examples.en: Where's my seat? Why is someone sitting here?

examples.zh: 我们都说了自己的想法,老师您呢？
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dōu shuō le zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ, lǎoshī nín ne?
examples.en: We've all shared our thoughts; and you, teacher?

title: "吧" ile öneri yapma
summary: "吧" (ba) cümle sonuna gelerek öneri, rica veya yumuşak bir teklif katar: "...yapalım / ...yap hadi".
explanation: "吧" cümlenin tonunu yumuşatan çok yaygın bir parçacıktır. Başlıca kullanımı öneri/teklif yapmaktır: "我们走吧" (Hadi gidelim). Ayrıca yumuşak bir emir ("你休息吧" - sen dinlen artık), bir tahmini onaylatma ("你是老师吧?" - sen öğretmensin, değil mi?), ve isteksiz kabul ("好吧" - peki o zaman) anlamları da katar. "吧"'sız emir sert, "吧"'lı emir nazik durur.

examples.zh: 时间不早了,我们走吧。
examples.pinyin: Shíjiān bù zǎo le, wǒmen zǒu ba.
examples.en: It's getting late, let's go.

examples.zh: 你累了就先休息吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ lèi le jiù xiān xiūxi ba.
examples.en: If you're tired, go rest first.

examples.zh: 这件事我们明天再谈吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒmen míngtiān zài tán ba.
examples.en: Let's talk about this tomorrow.

examples.zh: 外面太冷了,你多穿点儿吧。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn tài lěng le, nǐ duō chuān diǎnr ba.
examples.en: It's too cold outside, put on more clothes.

examples.zh: 既然大家都同意,那就这样决定吧。
examples.pinyin: Jìrán dàjiā dōu tóngyì, nà jiù zhèyàng juédìng ba.
examples.en: Since everyone agrees, let's decide it this way.

examples.zh: 你是新来的同事吧？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shì xīn lái de tóngshì ba?
examples.en: You're the new colleague, right?

examples.zh: 我们点一些菜,然后慢慢聊吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen diǎn yìxiē cài, ránhòu mànman liáo ba.
examples.en: Let's order some food and then chat slowly.

examples.zh: 别担心了,一切都会好起来的吧。
examples.pinyin: Bié dānxīn le, yíqiè dōu huì hǎo qǐlái de ba.
examples.en: Don't worry, everything will get better.

examples.zh: 这么晚了,你就住在我家吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhème wǎn le, nǐ jiù zhù zài wǒ jiā ba.
examples.en: It's so late, just stay at my place.

examples.zh: 既然你这么想去,那就去吧。
examples.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ zhème xiǎng qù, nà jiù qù ba.
examples.en: Since you want to go so much, then go.

examples.zh: 我们先吃饭,吃完再工作吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān chīfàn, chīwán zài gōngzuò ba.
examples.en: Let's eat first and work after we finish.

examples.zh: 这个问题太难了,还是问问老师吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí tài nán le, háishì wènwen lǎoshī ba.
examples.en: This question is too hard, let's just ask the teacher.

examples.zh: 你一定很饿了吧,快去吃点东西。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yídìng hěn è le ba, kuài qù chī diǎn dōngxi.
examples.en: You must be hungry, go eat something.

examples.zh: 天气这么好,我们出去走走吧。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì zhème hǎo, wǒmen chūqù zǒuzou ba.
examples.en: The weather is so nice, let's go out for a walk.

examples.zh: 这件衣服挺适合你的,买了吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu tǐng shìhé nǐ de, mǎi le ba.
examples.en: This outfit suits you well, just buy it.

examples.zh: 好吧,这次听你的。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo ba, zhè cì tīng nǐ de.
examples.en: Fine, I'll listen to you this time.

examples.zh: 我们分头去找吧,这样快一点。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen fēntóu qù zhǎo ba, zhèyàng kuài yìdiǎn.
examples.en: Let's split up to look, it'll be faster.

examples.zh: 你先别生气,听我解释一下吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bié shēngqì, tīng wǒ jiěshì yíxià ba.
examples.en: Don't be angry yet, let me explain.

examples.zh: 既然已经来了,就好好玩吧。
examples.pinyin: Jìrán yǐjīng lái le, jiù hǎohǎo wán ba.
examples.en: Since we're already here, let's enjoy ourselves.

examples.zh: 这道题你自己再想想吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí nǐ zìjǐ zài xiǎngxiang ba.
examples.en: Think about this question a bit more on your own.

examples.zh: 我们还是走路去吧,不太远。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen háishì zǒulù qù ba, bú tài yuǎn.
examples.en: Let's just walk there, it's not too far.

examples.zh: 你今天脸色不好,是不是生病了吧？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān liǎnsè bù hǎo, shì bu shì shēngbìng le ba?
examples.en: You don't look well today, are you sick?

examples.zh: 这些旧衣服就送给需要的人吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē jiù yīfu jiù sòng gěi xūyào de rén ba.
examples.en: Let's give these old clothes to people who need them.

examples.zh: 事情已经这样了,我们往前看吧。
examples.pinyin: Shìqing yǐjīng zhèyàng le, wǒmen wǎng qián kàn ba.
examples.en: Things are already like this, let's look forward.

examples.zh: 你说得对,就按你说的做吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de duì, jiù àn nǐ shuō de zuò ba.
examples.en: You're right, let's do it your way.

title: "在" ile bir yerde bulunma
titleEn: Expressing existence in a place with "zai"
summary: "在" (zài) fiili bir kişi/nesnenin bir yerde bulunduğunu belirtir: 老师在上海 = Öğretmen Şanghay'da.
explanation: "在" bir varlığın nerede olduğunu söyleyen fiildir: Özne + 在 + yer = Özne, ...dadır. Olumsuzu "不在": 他不在家 (o evde değil). Dikkat: "在" ayrıca bir eylemin nerede yapıldığını belirtmek için fiilden önce edat olarak da kullanılır (我在家吃饭 - evde yemek yerim) ve süregelen eylemi göstermek için de kullanılır (ayrı konular). Yer sözcükleri genellikle "上/里/旁边" gibi konum sözcükleriyle netleşir.

examples.zh: 老师现在在办公室。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī xiànzài zài bàngōngshì.
examples.en: The teacher is in the office now.

examples.zh: 你的手机在桌子上。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de shǒujī zài zhuōzi shàng.
examples.en: Your phone is on the table.

examples.zh: 对不起,王经理现在不在。
examples.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, Wáng jīnglǐ xiànzài bú zài.
examples.en: Sorry, Manager Wang is not in right now.

examples.zh: 孩子们都在楼下的花园里玩。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen dōu zài lóuxià de huāyuán lǐ wán.
examples.en: The children are all playing in the garden downstairs.

examples.zh: 我的钥匙好像在包里。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de yàoshi hǎoxiàng zài bāo lǐ.
examples.en: My keys seem to be in the bag.

examples.zh: 他家在这座山的后面。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiā zài zhè zuò shān de hòumiàn.
examples.en: His home is behind this mountain.

examples.zh: 你要找的那本书在书架的最上面。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào zhǎo de nà běn shū zài shūjià de zuì shàngmiàn.
examples.en: The book you're looking for is at the top of the shelf.

examples.zh: 请问,洗手间在哪里？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn, xǐshǒujiān zài nǎlǐ?
examples.en: Excuse me, where is the restroom?

examples.zh: 我父母现在在国外旅行。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ fùmǔ xiànzài zài guówài lǚxíng.
examples.en: My parents are traveling abroad right now.

examples.zh: 猫又不在它自己的窝里了。
examples.pinyin: Māo yòu bú zài tā zìjǐ de wō lǐ le.
examples.en: The cat is again not in its own bed.

examples.zh: 你的座位在前面还是后面？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de zuòwèi zài qiánmiàn háishì hòumiàn?
examples.en: Is your seat at the front or the back?

examples.zh: 重要的文件都在这个抽屉里。
examples.pinyin: Zhòngyào de wénjiàn dōu zài zhège chōuti lǐ.
examples.en: The important documents are all in this drawer.

examples.zh: 他不在办公室,可能去开会了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú zài bàngōngshì, kěnéng qù kāihuì le.
examples.en: He's not in the office, he might have gone to a meeting.

examples.zh: 我们约好在电影院门口见。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yuēhǎo zài diànyǐngyuàn ménkǒu jiàn.
examples.en: We agreed to meet at the cinema entrance.

examples.zh: 答案其实一直都在你心里。
examples.pinyin: Dá'àn qíshí yìzhí dōu zài nǐ xīnlǐ.
examples.en: The answer has always been in your heart.

examples.zh: 你要的资料在电脑里,我发给你。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào de zīliào zài diànnǎo lǐ, wǒ fā gěi nǐ.
examples.en: The materials you want are on the computer, I'll send them to you.

examples.zh: 车站就在那家银行的对面。
examples.pinyin: Chēzhàn jiù zài nà jiā yínháng de duìmiàn.
examples.en: The station is right across from that bank.

examples.zh: 这个时候他一般都在健身房。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shíhou tā yìbān dōu zài jiànshēnfáng.
examples.en: At this time he's usually at the gym.

examples.zh: 我的心一直在你身边。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de xīn yìzhí zài nǐ shēnbiān.
examples.en: My heart has always been by your side.

examples.zh: 钱包不在口袋里,也不在包里。
examples.pinyin: Qiánbāo bú zài kǒudài lǐ, yě bú zài bāo lǐ.
examples.en: The wallet isn't in the pocket, nor in the bag.

examples.zh: 你找的人不在这里,他已经搬走了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhǎo de rén bú zài zhèlǐ, tā yǐjīng bānzǒu le.
examples.en: The person you're looking for isn't here, he's moved away.

examples.zh: 孩子生病的时候,母亲总是在身边。
examples.pinyin: Háizi shēngbìng de shíhou, mǔqīn zǒngshì zài shēnbiān.
examples.en: When a child is ill, the mother is always by their side.

examples.zh: 我们的希望还在,不能放弃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de xīwàng hái zài, bù néng fàngqì.
examples.en: Our hope is still there, we can't give up.

examples.zh: 他一整天都在图书馆看书。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìzhěng tiān dōu zài túshūguǎn kànshū.
examples.en: He spent the whole day reading in the library.

examples.zh: 问题的关键在于我们怎么解决它。
examples.pinyin: Wèntí de guānjiàn zàiyú wǒmen zěnme jiějué tā.
examples.en: The key to the problem lies in how we solve it.

title: "有" ile bir yerde bir şeyin var olması
summary: "Yer + 有 + nesne" kalıbı bir yerde bir şeyin bulunduğunu/var olduğunu anlatır: 桌子上有一本书 = Masanın üstünde bir kitap var.
explanation: "有" mülkiyetin yanı sıra "var olma / bulunma" anlamında da kullanılır. Kalıp: yer + 有 + nesne. Bu, "在"'ın tersidir: "在" belirli bir şeyin nerede olduğunu söyler (bilinenden yere), "有" ise bir yerde ne olduğunu söyler (yerden bilinmeyene). Olumsuzu her zaman "没有": 桌子上没有书 (masada kitap yok). Genellikle belirsiz/yeni bir nesneyi tanıtır.

examples.zh: 桌子上有一本书和一杯茶。
examples.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng yǒu yì běn shū hé yì bēi chá.
examples.en: There's a book and a cup of tea on the table.

examples.zh: 我们学校有很多外国学生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào yǒu hěn duō wàiguó xuésheng.
examples.en: Our school has many foreign students.

examples.zh: 这附近有没有好吃的饭馆？
examples.pinyin: Zhè fùjìn yǒu méiyǒu hǎochī de fànguǎn?
examples.en: Is there a good restaurant nearby?

examples.zh: 冰箱里有一些水果和牛奶。
examples.pinyin: Bīngxiāng lǐ yǒu yìxiē shuǐguǒ hé niúnǎi.
examples.en: There are some fruits and milk in the fridge.

examples.zh: 我们家附近有一个很大的公园。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jiā fùjìn yǒu yí ge hěn dà de gōngyuán.
examples.en: There's a big park near our home.

examples.zh: 这个城市有很多有意思的地方。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì yǒu hěn duō yǒu yìsi de dìfang.
examples.en: This city has many interesting places.

examples.zh: 墙上有一张很旧的照片。
examples.pinyin: Qiáng shàng yǒu yì zhāng hěn jiù de zhàopiàn.
examples.en: There's a very old photo on the wall.

examples.zh: 这本书里有很多有用的知识。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū lǐ yǒu hěn duō yǒuyòng de zhīshi.
examples.en: This book contains a lot of useful knowledge.

examples.zh: 路口有一家二十四小时的便利店。
examples.pinyin: Lùkǒu yǒu yì jiā èrshísì xiǎoshí de biànlìdiàn.
examples.en: There's a 24-hour convenience store at the intersection.

examples.zh: 教室后面有几个空座位。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshì hòumiàn yǒu jǐ ge kōng zuòwèi.
examples.en: There are a few empty seats at the back of the classroom.

examples.zh: 我的心里有很多话想对你说。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de xīnlǐ yǒu hěn duō huà xiǎng duì nǐ shuō.
examples.en: I have a lot to say to you in my heart.

examples.zh: 这座山上有一座很古老的寺庙。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò shān shàng yǒu yí zuò hěn gǔlǎo de sìmiào.
examples.en: There's a very ancient temple on this mountain.

examples.zh: 这个问题背后有一个感人的故事。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí bèihòu yǒu yí ge gǎnrén de gùshi.
examples.en: There's a touching story behind this question.

examples.zh: 天上有很多星星,今晚真美。
examples.pinyin: Tiān shàng yǒu hěn duō xīngxing, jīnwǎn zhēn měi.
examples.en: There are many stars in the sky, it's so beautiful tonight.

examples.zh: 我家门口有一棵很高的大树。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā ménkǒu yǒu yì kē hěn gāo de dàshù.
examples.en: There's a tall tree at my door.

examples.zh: 这条街上有各种各样的小吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo jiē shàng yǒu gèzhǒnggèyàng de xiǎochī.
examples.en: This street has all kinds of snacks.

examples.zh: 每个人心里都有一个梦想。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén xīnlǐ dōu yǒu yí ge mèngxiǎng.
examples.en: Everyone has a dream in their heart.

examples.zh: 这个盒子里有一些旧照片和信。
examples.pinyin: Zhège hézi lǐ yǒu yìxiē jiù zhàopiàn hé xìn.
examples.en: There are some old photos and letters in this box.

examples.zh: 公司楼下有一家很方便的咖啡店。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī lóuxià yǒu yì jiā hěn fāngbiàn de kāfēidiàn.
examples.en: There's a convenient coffee shop downstairs from the company.

examples.zh: 这件事里有一些我们不知道的原因。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì lǐ yǒu yìxiē wǒmen bù zhīdào de yuányīn.
examples.en: There are some reasons we don't know behind this matter.

examples.zh: 河的对岸有一片很美的树林。
examples.pinyin: Hé de duì'àn yǒu yí piàn hěn měi de shùlín.
examples.en: There's a beautiful forest on the other side of the river.

examples.zh: 这个世界上有很多我们没见过的东西。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shìjiè shàng yǒu hěn duō wǒmen méi jiànguò de dōngxi.
examples.en: There are many things in this world we've never seen.

examples.zh: 抽屉里有一把旧钥匙,不知道是开什么的。
examples.pinyin: Chōuti lǐ yǒu yì bǎ jiù yàoshi, bù zhīdào shì kāi shénme de.
examples.en: There's an old key in the drawer, I don't know what it opens.

examples.zh: 生活里总是有一些让人开心的小事。
examples.pinyin: Shēnghuó lǐ zǒngshì yǒu yìxiē ràng rén kāixīn de xiǎoshì.
examples.en: There are always little joys in life.

examples.zh: 车里有点冷,你把外套穿上吧。
examples.pinyin: Chē lǐ yǒudiǎn lěng, nǐ bǎ wàitào chuān shàng ba.
examples.en: It's a bit cold in the car, put on your coat.

title: "有" ile mülkiyet belirtme
summary: "有" (yǒu) bir kişinin bir şeye sahip olduğunu belirtir: 我有一辆车 = Benim bir arabam var.
explanation: "有" hem "sahip olmak" hem "var olmak" fiilidir. Mülkiyet anlamında kalıp: Özne + 有 + nesne. Türkçe'deki "...m var" yapısına karşılık gelir. Olumsuzu istisnai olarak "不" değil her zaman "没有"'dur: 我没有车 (arabam yok). Soru için ya sona "吗" ya da "有没有" kalıbı kullanılır: 你有没有时间? (vaktin var mı?).

examples.zh: 我有一个很大的梦想。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí ge hěn dà de mèngxiǎng.
examples.en: I have a big dream.

examples.zh: 你有没有兄弟姐妹？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu méiyǒu xiōngdì jiěmèi?
examples.en: Do you have any siblings?

examples.zh: 他有一辆很旧的自行车。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǒu yí liàng hěn jiù de zìxíngchē.
examples.en: He has a very old bicycle.

examples.zh: 我现在没有时间,我们晚点再说。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài méiyǒu shíjiān, wǒmen wǎndiǎn zài shuō.
examples.en: I don't have time now, let's talk later.

examples.zh: 她有一双很漂亮的眼睛。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǒu yì shuāng hěn piàoliang de yǎnjing.
examples.en: She has a pair of very beautiful eyes.

examples.zh: 我们有一个共同的爱好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yǒu yí ge gòngtóng de àihào.
examples.en: We have a common hobby.

examples.zh: 这家公司有很长的历史。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī yǒu hěn cháng de lìshǐ.
examples.en: This company has a long history.

examples.zh: 你有什么好办法解决这个问题吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu shénme hǎo bànfǎ jiějué zhège wèntí ma?
examples.en: Do you have any good way to solve this problem?

examples.zh: 他有很多朋友,可是没有几个知心的。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǒu hěn duō péngyou, kěshì méiyǒu jǐ ge zhīxīn de.
examples.en: He has many friends, but few close ones.

examples.zh: 我有一种感觉,今天会发生好事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yì zhǒng gǎnjué, jīntiān huì fāshēng hǎoshì.
examples.en: I have a feeling something good will happen today.

examples.zh: 每个人都有权利选择自己的生活。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu quánlì xuǎnzé zìjǐ de shēnghuó.
examples.en: Everyone has the right to choose their own life.

examples.zh: 这个孩子有很好的音乐天分。
examples.pinyin: Zhège háizi yǒu hěn hǎo de yīnyuè tiānfèn.
examples.en: This child has great musical talent.

examples.zh: 我们有足够的时间准备考试。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yǒu zúgòu de shíjiān zhǔnbèi kǎoshì.
examples.en: We have enough time to prepare for the exam.

examples.zh: 他做事很有耐心,从不着急。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuòshì hěn yǒu nàixīn, cóng bù zháojí.
examples.en: He does things very patiently, never in a rush.

examples.zh: 你有没有想过将来做什么？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu méiyǒu xiǎngguò jiānglái zuò shénme?
examples.en: Have you ever thought about what to do in the future?

examples.zh: 这件事我有不同的看法。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ yǒu bùtóng de kànfǎ.
examples.en: I have a different view on this matter.

examples.zh: 他们家有一只养了十年的老狗。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen jiā yǒu yì zhī yǎng le shí nián de lǎo gǒu.
examples.en: Their family has an old dog they've kept for ten years.

examples.zh: 我对这份工作有很大的兴趣。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ duì zhè fèn gōngzuò yǒu hěn dà de xìngqù.
examples.en: I'm very interested in this job.

examples.zh: 她有一颗善良的心。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǒu yì kē shànliáng de xīn.
examples.en: She has a kind heart.

examples.zh: 我们有信心把这件事做好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yǒu xìnxīn bǎ zhè jiàn shì zuòhǎo.
examples.en: We have the confidence to do this well.

examples.zh: 他有一个坏习惯,总是把东西乱放。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǒu yí ge huài xíguàn, zǒngshì bǎ dōngxi luàn fàng.
examples.en: He has a bad habit of leaving things all over the place.

examples.zh: 你有没有带够钱？这里比较贵。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu méiyǒu dài gòu qián? Zhèlǐ bǐjiào guì.
examples.en: Did you bring enough money? It's rather expensive here.

examples.zh: 这个计划有一个很明显的问题。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jìhuà yǒu yí ge hěn míngxiǎn de wèntí.
examples.en: This plan has an obvious problem.

examples.zh: 我有一句话不知道该不该说。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí jù huà bù zhīdào gāi bu gāi shuō.
examples.en: There's something I don't know whether I should say.

examples.zh: 只要还有希望,我们就不会放弃。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào hái yǒu xīwàng, wǒmen jiù bú huì fàngqì.
examples.en: As long as there's hope, we won't give up.

title: "叫" fiilinin kullanımı
summary: "叫" (jiào) tam adı söylemek veya birini çağırmak için kullanılır: 我叫李明 = Adım Li Ming.
explanation: "叫" iki temel işlev görür: (1) İsim/tam ad bildirme: "我叫王小明" (adım Wang Xiaoming). Soyad + ad ya da sadece ad söylenebilir. Ad sormak için "你叫什么名字?". (2) Birini çağırmak/seslenmek: "妈妈叫你回家" (annen seni eve çağırıyor). Sadece soyad söylerken "叫" değil "姓" kullanılır (ayrı konu).

examples.zh: 你好,我叫张伟,很高兴认识你。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ jiào Zhāng Wěi, hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ.
examples.en: Hello, my name is Zhang Wei, nice to meet you.

examples.zh: 请问你叫什么名字？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?
examples.en: May I ask what your name is?

examples.zh: 我家的小狗叫豆豆。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā de xiǎogǒu jiào Dòudou.
examples.en: My family's puppy is called Doudou.

examples.zh: 妈妈叫你回家吃饭。
examples.pinyin: Māma jiào nǐ huíjiā chīfàn.
examples.en: Mom is calling you home for dinner.

examples.zh: 这种花叫什么名字？真好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng huā jiào shénme míngzi? Zhēn hǎokàn.
examples.en: What is this kind of flower called? It's so pretty.

examples.zh: 老师叫我明天去办公室找他。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī jiào wǒ míngtiān qù bàngōngshì zhǎo tā.
examples.en: The teacher told me to see him in the office tomorrow.

examples.zh: 我的中文名字叫李月。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de Zhōngwén míngzi jiào Lǐ Yuè.
examples.en: My Chinese name is Li Yue.

examples.zh: 外面有人叫你,你去看看吧。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn yǒu rén jiào nǐ, nǐ qù kànkan ba.
examples.en: Someone is calling you outside, go take a look.

examples.zh: 他叫我别担心,一切都会好的。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiào wǒ bié dānxīn, yíqiè dōu huì hǎo de.
examples.en: He told me not to worry, everything will be fine.

examples.zh: 这道菜叫什么？我以前没吃过。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài jiào shénme? Wǒ yǐqián méi chīguò.
examples.en: What is this dish called? I've never had it before.

examples.zh: 我们叫了一辆出租车去机场。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jiào le yí liàng chūzūchē qù jīchǎng.
examples.en: We called a taxi to go to the airport.

examples.zh: 他给儿子取的名字叫平安。
examples.pinyin: Tā gěi érzi qǔ de míngzi jiào Píng'ān.
examples.en: The name he gave his son is Ping'an.

examples.zh: 你叫他一声,他可能没听见。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiào tā yì shēng, tā kěnéng méi tīngjiàn.
examples.en: Call out to him, he might not have heard.

examples.zh: 这个地方叫什么？我第一次来。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìfang jiào shénme? Wǒ dì yī cì lái.
examples.en: What is this place called? It's my first time here.

examples.zh: 经理叫大家下午三点开会。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ jiào dàjiā xiàwǔ sān diǎn kāihuì.
examples.en: The manager told everyone to have a meeting at three.

examples.zh: 她叫我帮她照顾一下孩子。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiào wǒ bāng tā zhàogù yíxià háizi.
examples.en: She asked me to help look after her child.

examples.zh: 这只猫没有名字,你给它起一个吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī māo méiyǒu míngzi, nǐ gěi tā qǐ yí ge ba.
examples.en: This cat has no name, why don't you give it one.

examples.zh: 别叫我老师,叫我的名字就好。
examples.pinyin: Bié jiào wǒ lǎoshī, jiào wǒ de míngzi jiù hǎo.
examples.en: Don't call me teacher, just call me by my name.

examples.zh: 我叫了很多次,他才慢慢醒过来。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiào le hěn duō cì, tā cái mànman xǐng guòlái.
examples.en: I called many times before he slowly woke up.

examples.zh: 这种感觉说不清楚,我不知道该叫什么。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng gǎnjué shuō bu qīngchu, wǒ bù zhīdào gāi jiào shénme.
examples.en: This feeling is hard to describe, I don't know what to call it.

examples.zh: 孩子第一次叫爸爸的时候,他哭了。
examples.pinyin: Háizi dì yī cì jiào bàba de shíhou, tā kū le.
examples.en: When the child called him 'dad' for the first time, he cried.

examples.zh: 我们叫她小美,因为她长得很美。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jiào tā Xiǎoměi, yīnwèi tā zhǎng de hěn měi.
examples.en: We call her Xiaomei because she's very pretty.

examples.zh: 要是有事就叫我,我一直在旁边。
