examples.en: In the past, every New Year the whole family would return home to reunite.

examples.zh: 我以前的想法很简单,只想找个稳定的工作。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ qián de xiǎng fǎ hěn jiǎn dān, zhǐ xiǎng zhǎo gè wěn dìng de gōng zuò。
examples.en: My thinking used to be simple: I just wanted a stable job.

examples.zh: 这种老式的自行车,以前几乎家家都有一辆。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng lǎo shì de zì xíng chē, yǐ qián jī hū jiā jiā dōu yǒu yī liàng。
examples.en: This kind of old bicycle — almost every household used to have one.

examples.zh: 以前她说话很小声,当了老师以后声音大多了。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ qián tā shuō huà hěn xiǎo shēng, dāng le lǎo shī yǐ hòu shēng yīn dà duō le。
examples.en: She used to speak softly; after becoming a teacher her voice got much louder.

examples.zh: 以前我不明白父母的辛苦,自己有了孩子才懂。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ qián wǒ bù míng bái fù mǔ de xīn kǔ, zì jǐ yǒu le hái zi cái dǒng。
examples.en: I didn't understand my parents' hardships before; only after having a child did I get it.

examples.zh: 这座桥以前是木头的,后来才修成了现在的样子。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáo yǐ qián shì mù tou de, hòu lái cái xiū chéng le xiàn zài de yàng zi。
examples.en: This bridge used to be wooden; only later was it rebuilt into its current form.

title: "刚才" ile "az önce, demin"
summary: "刚才" (gāngcái) "az önce, demin" demektir ve yakın geçmişteki bir andan söz eder: 刚才他来过 = Az önce o gelmişti.
explanation: "刚才" bir zaman sözcüğüdür ve "az önce, biraz önce, demin" anlamına gelir; konuşma anından hemen önceki kısa bir zamanı gösterir. Genelde öznenin önünde ya da hemen ardında gelir: 刚才谁给我打电话了? (Az önce bana kim aradı?). "刚" (gāng) ile karıştırılmamalı: "刚才" bir ZAMAN sözcüğüdür (isim gibi, tek başına durabilir, olumsuzu 没 ile olur), "刚" ise bir ZARFTIR ve fiilin hemen önünde durur. "刚才我没听清楚" doğru; çünkü "刚才" geçmiş bir ana işaret eder.

examples.zh: 刚才有人来找你,可是你不在,他就走了。
examples.pinyin: Gāng cái yǒu rén lái zhǎo nǐ, kě shì nǐ bù zài, tā jiù zǒu le。
examples.en: Someone came looking for you just now, but you weren't in, so he left.

examples.zh: 对不起,刚才我没听清楚,你能再说一遍吗?
examples.pinyin: Duì bù qǐ, gāng cái wǒ méi tīng qīng chǔ, nǐ néng zài shuō yī biàn ma?
examples.en: Sorry, I didn't hear clearly just now; could you say it again?

examples.zh: 刚才还是晴天,怎么一下子就下起雨来了?
examples.pinyin: Gāng cái hái shì qíng tiān, zěn me yī xià zi jiù xià qǐ yǔ lái le?
examples.en: It was sunny just a moment ago; how did it suddenly start raining?

examples.zh: 你刚才说的那家餐厅,具体在哪条街?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ gāng cái shuō de nà jiā cān tīng, jù tǐ zài nǎ tiáo jiē?
examples.en: The restaurant you mentioned just now — which street exactly is it on?

examples.zh: 刚才老师讲的内容很重要,你怎么没记笔记?
examples.pinyin: Gāng cái lǎo shī jiǎng de nèi róng hěn zhòng yào, nǐ zěn me méi jì bǐ jì?
examples.en: What the teacher said just now was important; why didn't you take notes?

examples.zh: 我刚才在路上看见你了,可是叫你你没听见。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng cái zài lù shàng kàn jiàn nǐ le, kě shì jiào nǐ nǐ méi tīng jiàn。
examples.en: I saw you on the road just now, but you didn't hear me call you.

examples.zh: 刚才电话里太吵,我们改到现在慢慢谈吧。
examples.pinyin: Gāng cái diàn huà lǐ tài chǎo, wǒ men gǎi dào xiàn zài màn màn tán ba。
examples.en: It was too noisy on the phone earlier; let's talk slowly now instead.

examples.zh: 他刚才还好好的,怎么突然就不舒服了?
examples.pinyin: Tā gāng cái hái hǎo hǎo de, zěn me tū rán jiù bù shū fú le?
examples.en: He was fine just a moment ago; how did he suddenly feel unwell?

examples.zh: 刚才那个问题我没答对,回去我得好好想想。
examples.pinyin: Gāng cái nà ge wèn tí wǒ méi dá duì, huí qù wǒ de hǎo hǎo xiǎng xiǎng。
examples.en: I didn't answer that question correctly just now; I need to think it over at home.

examples.zh: 你刚才去哪儿了?我找了你半天都没找到。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ gāng cái qù nǎ ér le? wǒ zhǎo le nǐ bàn tiān dōu méi zhǎo dào。
examples.en: Where did you go just now? I looked for you for ages and couldn't find you.

examples.zh: 刚才的会开得挺顺利,大家都很满意。
examples.pinyin: Gāng cái de huì kāi de tǐng shùn lì, dà jiā dōu hěn mǎn yì。
examples.en: The meeting just now went smoothly; everyone was satisfied.

examples.zh: 我刚才把钥匙放在桌子上了,怎么现在找不到了?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng cái bǎ yào shi fàng zài zhuō zi shàng le, zěn me xiàn zài zhǎo bú dào le?
examples.en: I put the keys on the table just now; why can't I find them now?

examples.zh: 刚才你笑什么呢?是不是想起什么好玩的事了?
examples.pinyin: Gāng cái nǐ xiào shén me ne? shì bú shì xiǎng qǐ shén me hǎo wán de shì le?
examples.en: What were you laughing at just now? Did you think of something funny?

examples.zh: 刚才外面好像有人敲门,你听见了吗?
examples.pinyin: Gāng cái wài miàn hǎo xiàng yǒu rén qiāo mén, nǐ tīng jiàn le ma?
examples.en: It seemed like someone knocked on the door just now; did you hear it?

examples.zh: 刚才我一紧张,把准备好的话全忘了。
examples.pinyin: Gāng cái wǒ yī jǐn zhāng, bǎ zhǔn bèi hǎo de huà quán wàng le。
examples.en: I got so nervous just now that I forgot everything I'd prepared to say.

examples.zh: 你别生气,刚才我不是那个意思。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié shēng qì, gāng cái wǒ bú shì nà ge yì si。
examples.en: Don't be angry; that's not what I meant just now.

examples.zh: 刚才那杯咖啡太烫了,我等它凉一凉再喝。
examples.pinyin: Gāng cái nà bēi kā fēi tài tàng le, wǒ děng tā liàng yī liàng zài hē。
examples.en: That cup of coffee just now was too hot; I'll wait for it to cool.

examples.zh: 他刚才还在这儿坐着,一转眼就不见了。
examples.pinyin: Tā gāng cái hái zài zhè ér zuò zhe, yī zhuǎn yǎn jiù bú jiàn le。
examples.en: He was sitting here just now; in the blink of an eye he was gone.

examples.zh: 刚才我算错了一个数,现在重新算一遍。
examples.pinyin: Gāng cái wǒ suàn cuò le yí gè shù, xiàn zài chóng xīn suàn yī biàn。
examples.en: I miscalculated a number just now; let me redo it.

examples.zh: 刚才路过书店,我顺便给你买了本你想要的书。
examples.pinyin: Gāng cái lù guò shū diàn, wǒ shùn biàn gěi nǐ mǎi le běn nǐ xiǎng yào de shū。
examples.en: Passing the bookstore just now, I bought you the book you wanted.

examples.zh: 你刚才接的那个电话,是不是有什么急事?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ gāng cái jiē de nà ge diàn huà, shì bú shì yǒu shén me jí shì?
examples.en: That call you took just now — was it something urgent?

examples.zh: 刚才还热得不行,太阳一下山就凉快了。
examples.pinyin: Gāng cái hái rè de bù xíng, tài yáng yī xià shān jiù liáng kuài le。
examples.en: It was unbearably hot just now; as soon as the sun set it cooled down.

examples.zh: 我刚才明明把车停在这儿了,车怎么不见了?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng cái míng míng bǎ chē tíng zài zhè ér le, chē zěn me bú jiàn le?
examples.en: I clearly parked the car here just now; how is it gone?

examples.zh: 刚才你没在,所以我把东西交给了你同事。
examples.pinyin: Gāng cái nǐ méi zài, suǒ yǐ wǒ bǎ dōng xī jiāo gěi le nǐ tóng shì。
examples.en: You weren't here just now, so I handed the things to your colleague.

examples.zh: 刚才那首歌真好听,你知道叫什么名字吗?
examples.pinyin: Gāng cái nà shǒu gē zhēn hǎo tīng, nǐ zhī dào jiào shén me míng zì ma?
examples.en: That song just now was really nice; do you know its name?

title: "的时候" ile "...-dığı zaman"
summary: "的时候" (de shíhou) bir olayın ne zaman olduğunu belirtir: 我小的时候 = ben küçükken; 吃饭的时候 = yemek yerken.
explanation: Bir eylemin ya da durumun "ne zaman" gerçekleştiğini anlatmak için, o öbeğin SONUNA "的时候" eklenir: 我上大学的时候 (üniversitedeyken), 你不在的时候 (sen yokken), 下雨的时候 (yağmur yağarken). Türkçedeki "...-dığı zaman / ...-ken" yapısına karşılık gelir ve niteldiği ifadenin arkasında durur. İçindeki eylem sürüyorsa "...-ken", bir noktayı gösteriyorsa "...-dığı an" anlamı verir. Cümlenin başında ya da ortasında bir zaman belirteci öbeği olarak yer alır.

examples.zh: 我小的时候,家门口有一棵很大的树。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎo de shí hòu, jiā mén kǒu yǒu yī kē hěn dà de shù。
examples.en: When I was little, there was a big tree in front of our house.

examples.zh: 吃饭的时候最好别看手机,对身体不好。
examples.pinyin: Chī fàn de shí hòu zuì hǎo bié kàn shǒu jī, duì shēn tǐ bù hǎo。
examples.en: It's best not to look at your phone while eating; it's bad for you.

examples.zh: 你不在的时候,有个快递员送来一个包裹。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù zài de shí hòu, yǒu gè kuài dì yuán sòng lái yí gè bāo guǒ。
examples.en: While you were out, a courier delivered a package.

examples.zh: 下雨的时候,这条路特别容易堵车。
examples.pinyin: Xià yǔ de shí hòu, zhè tiáo lù tè bié róng yì dǔ chē。
examples.en: When it rains, this road gets especially jammed.

examples.zh: 我第一次见到他的时候,他还是个高中生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dì yī cì jiàn dào tā de shí hòu, tā hái shì gè gāo zhōng shēng。
examples.en: When I first met him, he was still a high school student.

examples.zh: 累的时候就休息一下,别硬撑着。
examples.pinyin: Lèi de shí hòu jiù xiū xī yī xià, bié yìng chēng zhe。
examples.en: When you're tired, take a break; don't force yourself to keep going.

examples.zh: 我们聊天的时候,时间过得特别快。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men liáo tiān de shí hòu, shí jiān guò de tè bié kuài。
examples.en: When we chat, time flies especially fast.

examples.zh: 过马路的时候,你一定要小心来往的车。
examples.pinyin: Guò mǎ lù de shí hòu, nǐ yí dìng yào xiǎo xīn lái wǎng de chē。
examples.en: When crossing the road, you must watch out for passing cars.

examples.zh: 他心情不好的时候,喜欢一个人去海边走走。
examples.pinyin: Tā xīn qíng bù hǎo de shí hòu, xǐ huān yí gè rén qù hǎi biān zǒu zǒu。
examples.en: When he's in a bad mood, he likes to walk alone by the sea.

examples.zh: 我睡觉的时候,请你们说话小声一点。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shuì jiào de shí hòu, qǐng nǐ men shuō huà xiǎo shēng yì diǎn。
examples.en: While I'm sleeping, please keep your voices down.

examples.zh: 学汉语的时候,最难的部分就是记住那些汉字。
examples.pinyin: Xué hàn yǔ de shí hòu, zuì nán de bù fèn jiù shì jì zhù nà xiē hàn zì。
examples.en: When learning Chinese, the hardest part is memorizing the characters.

examples.zh: 孩子哭的时候,妈妈总是第一个跑过去。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi kū de shí hòu, mā mā zǒng shì dì yí gè pǎo guò qù。
examples.en: When the child cries, mom is always the first to rush over.

examples.zh: 你打电话来的时候,我正好在开车,没能接。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dǎ diàn huà lái de shí hòu, wǒ zhèng hǎo zài kāi chē, méi néng jiē。
examples.en: When you called, I happened to be driving and couldn't answer.

examples.zh: 天气好的时候,我喜欢把被子拿到阳台上晒。
examples.pinyin: Tiān qì hǎo de shí hòu, wǒ xǐ huān bǎ bèi zi ná dào yáng tái shàng shài。
examples.en: When the weather is nice, I like to air the quilt on the balcony.

examples.zh: 考试的时候不要紧张,把会的先做完。
examples.pinyin: Kǎo shì de shí hòu bú yào jǐn zhāng, bǎ huì de xiān zuò wán。
examples.en: During the exam, don't be nervous; finish the ones you know first.

examples.zh: 我难过的时候,是这首歌一直陪着我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nán guò de shí hòu, shì zhè shǒu gē yì zhí péi zhe wǒ。
examples.en: When I was sad, it was this song that kept me company.

examples.zh: 刚来这个城市的时候,我一个朋友都没有。
examples.pinyin: Gāng lái zhè ge chéng shì de shí hòu, wǒ yí gè péng yǒu dōu méi yǒu。
examples.en: When I first came to this city, I didn't have a single friend.

examples.zh: 你不开心的时候,可以随时给我打电话。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù kāi xīn de shí hòu, kě yǐ suí shí gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà。
examples.en: When you're unhappy, you can call me anytime.

examples.zh: 坐飞机的时候,起飞和降落要特别注意安全。
examples.pinyin: Zuò fēi jī de shí hòu, qǐ fēi hé jiàng luò yào tè bié zhù yì ān quán。
examples.en: When flying, you should be especially careful during takeoff and landing.

examples.zh: 小时候上学的时候,我最喜欢的就是下课。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo shí hòu shàng xué de shí hòu, wǒ zuì xǐ huān de jiù shì xià kè。
examples.en: Back when I went to school as a kid, my favorite thing was recess.

examples.zh: 做菜的时候,盐一定要一点一点地放。
examples.pinyin: Zuò cài de shí hòu, yán yí dìng yào yì diǎn yì diǎn de fàng。
examples.en: When cooking, you must add salt little by little.

examples.zh: 他说这句话的时候,眼睛里好像有泪水。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō zhè jù huà de shí hòu, yǎn jīng lǐ hǎo xiàng yǒu lèi shuǐ。
examples.en: When he said this, there seemed to be tears in his eyes.

examples.zh: 放假的时候,这个景点每天都是人山人海。
examples.pinyin: Fàng jià de shí hòu, zhè ge jǐng diǎn měi tiān dōu shì rén shān rén hǎi。
examples.en: During holidays, this attraction is packed with people every day.

examples.zh: 我年轻的时候,也曾经有过很多梦想。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nián qīng de shí hòu, yě céng jīng yǒu guò hěn duō mèng xiǎng。
examples.en: When I was young, I too once had many dreams.

examples.zh: 你需要帮助的时候,别忘了还有我们在。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xū yào bāng zhù de shí hòu, bié wàng le hái yǒu wǒ men zài。
examples.en: When you need help, don't forget that we're here for you.

title: "以后" ile "ileride, bundan sonra" (genel)
titleEn: In the future in general with "yihou"
summary: Cümle başında tek başına "以后" (yǐhòu) "ileride, bundan sonra, gelecekte" anlamı verir: 以后我想当医生 = İleride doktor olmak istiyorum.
explanation: "以后" belirli bir olaya bağlanmadan, tek başına cümle başında (ya da öznenin ardında) geldiğinde "ileride, bundan böyle, gelecekte" anlamına gelir ve geleceğe yönelik genel bir niyeti ya da beklentiyi bildirir: 以后我想当医生 (İleride doktor olmak istiyorum), 以后你可要小心点 (Bundan sonra dikkatli olmalısın). Bu, "eskiden" anlamındaki "以前"in karşıtıdır. Belirli bir zaman/fiile bağlı "...-den sonra" anlamından (bkz. ayrı konu) bağlamla ayrılır.

examples.zh: 以后我想当一名医生,帮助更多需要帮助的人。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ hòu wǒ xiǎng dāng yī míng yī shēng, bāng zhù gèng duō xū yào bāng zhù de rén。
examples.en: In the future I want to be a doctor and help more people in need.

examples.zh: 以后你可要小心点,别再犯同样的错误了。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ hòu nǐ kě yào xiǎo xīn diǎn, bié zài fàn tóng yàng de cuò wù le。
examples.en: From now on be careful; don't make the same mistake again.

examples.zh: 以后有机会的话,我一定要去南方看看。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ hòu yǒu jī huì de huà, wǒ yí dìng yào qù nán fāng kàn kàn。
examples.en: If I get the chance in the future, I definitely want to visit the south.

examples.zh: 以后咱们就是一家人了,有事儿别客气。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ hòu zán men jiù shì yī jiā rén le, yǒu shì ér bié kè qì。
examples.en: From now on we're family; don't be shy about anything.

examples.zh: 以后你会明白,今天的努力都不会白费。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ hòu nǐ huì míng bái, jīn tiān de nǔ lì dōu bú huì bái fèi。
examples.en: In the future you'll understand that today's efforts won't be wasted.

examples.zh: 以后我打算少吃点儿肉,多吃点儿蔬菜。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ hòu wǒ dǎ suàn shǎo chī diǎn ér ròu, duō chī diǎn ér shū cài。
examples.en: In the future I plan to eat less meat and more vegetables.

examples.zh: 以后不管遇到什么困难,我们都一起面对。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ hòu bù guǎn yù dào shén me kùn nán, wǒ men dōu yì qǐ miàn duì。
examples.en: No matter what difficulties we face in the future, we'll face them together.

examples.zh: 以后这种事你直接问我就行,别自己乱猜。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ hòu zhè zhǒng shì nǐ zhí jiē wèn wǒ jiù xíng, bié zì jǐ luàn cāi。
examples.en: In the future just ask me directly about this; don't guess on your own.

examples.zh: 以后科技会越来越发达,生活也会更方便。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ hòu kē jì huì yuè lái yuè fā dá, shēng huó yě huì gèng fāng biàn。
examples.en: In the future technology will grow more advanced, and life more convenient.

examples.zh: 以后你长大了,就会懂得父母的一片苦心。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ hòu nǐ zhǎng dà le, jiù huì dǒng de fù mǔ de yī piàn kǔ xīn。
examples.en: When you grow up, you'll understand your parents' painstaking care.

examples.zh: 以后我再也不熬夜了,身体真的受不了。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ hòu wǒ zài yě bù áo yè le, shēn tǐ zhēn de shòu bù liǎo。
examples.en: From now on I'll never stay up late again; my body really can't take it.

examples.zh: 以后咱们常联系,别像这次一样这么久不见。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ hòu zán men cháng lián xì, bié xiàng zhè cì yī yàng zhè me jiǔ bú jiàn。
examples.en: Let's keep in touch from now on; don't go so long without seeing each other again.

examples.zh: 以后这里会建一座公园,大家都能来休息。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ hòu zhè lǐ huì jiàn yī zuò gōng yuán, dà jiā dōu néng lái xiū xī。
examples.en: In the future a park will be built here where everyone can relax.

examples.zh: 以后你要是来北京,一定要提前告诉我。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ hòu nǐ yào shì lái běi jīng, yí dìng yào tí qián gào sù wǒ。
examples.en: If you come to Beijing in the future, be sure to tell me in advance.

examples.zh: 以后无论多忙,我都要抽时间陪陪家人。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ hòu wú lùn duō máng, wǒ dōu yào chōu shí jiān péi péi jiā rén。
examples.en: No matter how busy I am in the future, I'll make time for my family.

examples.zh: 以后的路还很长,你不要因为一次失败就放弃。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ hòu de lù hái hěn zhǎng, nǐ bú yào yīn wèi yī cì shī bài jiù fàng qì。
examples.en: The road ahead is still long; don't give up over one failure.

examples.zh: 以后请你把东西放回原来的地方,好吗?
examples.pinyin: Yǐ hòu qǐng nǐ bǎ dōng xī fàng huí yuán lái de dì fāng, hǎo ma?
examples.en: From now on, please put things back where they were, okay?

examples.zh: 以后我想在海边买一间小房子,安静地生活。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ hòu wǒ xiǎng zài hǎi biān mǎi yī jiān xiǎo fáng zi, ān jìng de shēng huó。
examples.en: In the future I want to buy a small house by the sea and live quietly.

examples.zh: 以后你自己一个人在外面,要好好照顾自己。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ hòu nǐ zì jǐ yí gè rén zài wài miàn, yào hǎo hǎo zhào gù zì jǐ。
examples.en: From now on, living alone away from home, take good care of yourself.

examples.zh: 以后每年这个时候,我们都回来看看老朋友。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ hòu měi nián zhè ge shí hòu, wǒ men dōu huí lái kàn kàn lǎo péng yǒu。
examples.en: From now on, at this time each year, let's come back to see old friends.

examples.zh: 以后的事谁也说不准,现在做好眼前的就够了。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ hòu de shì shuí yě shuō bù zhǔn, xiàn zài zuò hǎo yǎn qián de jiù gòu le。
examples.en: No one can be sure about the future; just do well with what's in front of you now.

examples.zh: 以后你会感谢现在这么拼命的自己。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ hòu nǐ huì gǎn xiè xiàn zài zhè me pīn mìng de zì jǐ。
examples.en: In the future you'll thank your present self for working so hard.

examples.zh: 以后我们的孩子长大了,一定会为你骄傲。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ hòu wǒ men de hái zi zhǎng dà le, yí dìng huì wèi nǐ jiāo ào。
examples.en: When our children grow up in the future, they'll surely be proud of you.

examples.zh: 以后买东西之前,先想清楚是不是真的需要。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ hòu mǎi dōng xī zhī qián, xiān xiǎng qīng chǔ shì bú shì zhēn de xū yào。
examples.en: From now on, before buying anything, think clearly about whether you really need it.

examples.zh: 以后不管走到哪里,别忘了自己是从哪儿来的。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ hòu bù guǎn zǒu dào nǎ lǐ, bié wàng le zì jǐ shì cóng nǎ ér lái de。
examples.en: No matter where you go in the future, don't forget where you came from.

title: Zaman sözcükleri ve söz dizimi
summary: Zaman sözcüğü (今天, 明天, 每天 vb.) ya öznenin HEMEN ARDINA ya da cümlenin en BAŞINA gelir, ama her zaman fiilden ÖNCEDİR.
explanation: Çince'de "ne zaman" bildiren sözcük (今天, 明天, 现在, 每天, 星期一 vb.) fiilin ÖNÜNDE bulunur ve iki yeri olabilir: (1) öznenin hemen ardında — 我今天很忙; (2) cümlenin en başında, özneden önce — 今天我很忙. İki dizim de doğrudur; başa alındığında zamana biraz daha vurgu düşer. ÖNEMLİ: İngilizce/Türkçenin aksine zaman sözcüğü cümlenin SONUNA konmaz ("很忙今天" yanlıştır). Birden çok zaman ifadesi varsa büyükten küçüğe sıralanır: 明天早上八点.

examples.zh: 我今天特别忙,恐怕没时间陪你去逛街了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīn tiān tè bié máng, kǒng pà méi shí jiān péi nǐ qù guàng jiē le。
examples.en: I'm especially busy today; I'm afraid I don't have time to go shopping with you.

examples.zh: 明天早上八点,咱们在学校门口见,别迟到。
examples.pinyin: Míng tiān zǎo shàng bā diǎn, zán men zài xué xiào mén kǒu jiàn, bié chí dào。
examples.en: Tomorrow at eight in the morning, let's meet at the school gate; don't be late.

examples.zh: 每天晚上睡觉以前,他都要看一会儿书。
examples.pinyin: Měi tiān wǎn shàng shuì jiào yǐ qián, tā dōu yào kàn yī huì er shū。
examples.en: Every night before bed he reads for a while.

examples.zh: 现在几点了?我怎么觉得时间过得这么慢。
examples.pinyin: Xiàn zài jǐ diǎn le? wǒ zěn me jué de shí jiān guò de zhè me màn。
examples.en: What time is it now? Why does time feel like it's passing so slowly?

examples.zh: 星期六我们全家打算去郊外野餐。
examples.pinyin: Xīng qī liù wǒ men quán jiā dǎ suàn qù jiāo wài yě cān。
examples.en: On Saturday our whole family plans to go on a picnic in the countryside.

examples.zh: 他昨天晚上很晚才睡,今天一整天都没精神。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuó tiān wǎn shàng hěn wǎn cái shuì, jīn tiān yī zhěng tiān dōu méi jīng shén。
examples.en: He went to bed very late last night, so he's been listless all day today.

examples.zh: 下个月我要去南方出差,大概待一个星期。
examples.pinyin: Xià gè yuè wǒ yào qù nán fāng chū chāi, dà gài dài yí gè xīng qī。
examples.en: Next month I'm going south on a business trip, staying about a week.

examples.zh: 今年冬天特别冷,前几天还下了一场大雪。
examples.pinyin: Jīn nián dōng tiān tè bié lěng, qián jǐ tiān hái xià le yī cháng dà xuě。
examples.en: This winter is especially cold; it even snowed heavily a few days ago.

examples.zh: 每年春节,我们都会回老家跟爷爷奶奶团聚。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián chūn jié, wǒ men dū huì huí lǎo jiā gēn yé yé nǎi nǎi tuán jù。
examples.en: Every Spring Festival we return home to reunite with our grandparents.

examples.zh: 你明天下午有空吗?我想请你帮个忙。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ míng tiān xià wǔ yǒu kòng ma? wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ bāng gè máng。
examples.en: Are you free tomorrow afternoon? I'd like to ask you for a favor.

examples.zh: 我一般早上六点起床,然后去公园跑步。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yì bān zǎo shàng liù diǎn qǐ chuáng, rán hòu qù gōng yuán pǎo bù。
examples.en: I usually get up at six in the morning and then go running in the park.

examples.zh: 上个星期我病了三天,落下了不少功课。
examples.pinyin: Shàng gè xīng qī wǒ bìng le sān tiān, là xià le bù shǎo gōng kè。
examples.en: Last week I was sick for three days and fell behind on quite a bit of work.

examples.zh: 他每个周末都去看望住在城外的父母。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi gè zhōu mò dōu qù kàn wàng zhù zài chéng wài de fù mǔ。
examples.en: Every weekend he visits his parents who live outside the city.

examples.zh: 今天晚上有一场重要的比赛,你一定要看。
examples.pinyin: Jīn tiān wǎn shàng yǒu yī cháng zhòng yào de bǐ sài, nǐ yí dìng yào kàn。
examples.en: There's an important match tonight; you must watch it.

examples.zh: 我们明年打算搬到一个离海更近的城市。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men míng nián dǎ suàn bān dào yí gè lí hǎi gèng jìn de chéng shì。
examples.en: Next year we plan to move to a city closer to the sea.

examples.zh: 她小时候每天放学都会先去外婆家吃饭。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎo shí hòu měi tiān fàng xué dū huì xiān qù wài pó jiā chī fàn。
examples.en: As a child she went to grandma's for dinner after school every day.

examples.zh: 后天是妈妈的生日,我想给她一个惊喜。
examples.pinyin: Hòu tiān shì mā mā de shēng rì, wǒ xiǎng gěi tā yí gè jīng xǐ。
examples.en: The day after tomorrow is mom's birthday; I want to surprise her.

examples.zh: 这几天天气变化很大,你出门记得带伞。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān tiān qì biàn huà hěn dà, nǐ chū mén jì de dài sǎn。
examples.en: The weather has changed a lot these days; remember your umbrella when you go out.

examples.zh: 我通常中午在公司附近的小店随便吃点。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tōng cháng zhōng wǔ zài gōng sī fù jìn de xiǎo diàn suí biàn chī diǎn。
examples.en: I usually grab a quick bite at a small shop near the office at noon.

examples.zh: 刚才还是大晴天,一会儿就阴下来了。
examples.pinyin: Gāng cái hái shì dà qíng tiān, yī huì er jiù yīn xià lái le。
examples.en: It was clear just now, but it clouded over in a moment.

examples.zh: 每天早上,街角那家包子店总是排着长队。
examples.pinyin: Měi tiān zǎo shàng, jiē jiǎo nà jiā bāo zi diàn zǒng shì pái zhe cháng duì。
examples.en: Every morning the bun shop on the corner always has a long line.

examples.zh: 去年这个时候,我还在国外读书呢。
examples.pinyin: Qù nián zhè ge shí hòu, wǒ hái zài guó wài dú shū ne。
examples.en: This time last year, I was still studying abroad.

examples.zh: 你星期几有时间?我们约个时间好好聊聊。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xīng qī jǐ yǒu shí jiān? wǒ men yuē gè shí jiān hǎo hǎo liáo liáo。
examples.en: Which day are you free? Let's set a time for a good talk.

examples.zh: 他一到周末就睡懒觉,常常睡到中午。
examples.pinyin: Tā yī dào zhōu mò jiù shuì lǎn jiào, cháng cháng shuì dào zhōng wǔ。
examples.en: As soon as the weekend comes he sleeps in, often until noon.

examples.zh: 从今天起,我每天早上都要坚持读半个小时英文。
examples.pinyin: Cóng jīn tiān qǐ, wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng dōu yào jiān chí dú bàn gè xiǎo shí yīng wén。
examples.en: Starting today, I'll read English for half an hour every morning.

title: Ardışık sayılarla yaklaşık miktar
pattern: Sayı 1 + Sayı 2 (三四, 五六, 两三...)
summary: Ardışık iki sayıyı yan yana koymak yaklaşık bir miktar verir: 三四个 = üç dört (tane); 两三天 = iki üç gün.
explanation: Türkçedeki "üç beş, iki üç" gibi, Çince'de de ardışık iki sayıyı yan yana koyarak yaklaşık bir miktar belirtilir: 两三个 (iki üç tane), 三四天 (üç dört gün), 五六个人 (beş altı kişi), 七八十岁 (yetmiş seksen yaşlarında). Sayılar mutlaka ARDIŞIK ve küçükten büyüğe olur. "两" burada "二" yerine kullanılır (两三 doğru, 二三 sayıda kullanılmaz). Ölçü sözcüğü ya da isim genelde arkadan gelir. Bu, tam sayı vermeden "aşağı yukarı" demenin doğal yoludur.

examples.zh: 这件事我考虑两三天再给你答复,好吗?
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ kǎo lǜ liǎng sān tiān zài gěi nǐ dá fù, hǎo ma?
examples.en: Let me think about this for two or three days before I reply, okay?

examples.zh: 门口站着五六个人,好像在等什么人。
examples.pinyin: Mén kǒu zhàn zhe wǔ liù gè rén, hǎo xiàng zài děng shén me rén。
examples.en: Five or six people are standing at the door, seemingly waiting for someone.

examples.zh: 这本书不厚,三四个小时就能看完。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū bù hòu, sān sì gè xiǎo shí jiù néng kàn wán。
examples.en: This book isn't thick; you can finish it in three or four hours.

examples.zh: 他看上去也就二十三四岁,其实已经三十了。
examples.pinyin: Tā kàn shàng qù yě jiù èr shí sān sì suì, qí shí yǐ jīng sān shí le。
examples.en: He looks only twenty-three or twenty-four, but he's actually thirty.

examples.zh: 我们家离超市很近,走七八分钟就到了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men jiā lí chāo shì hěn jìn, zǒu qī bā fēn zhōng jiù dào le。
examples.en: Our home is close to the supermarket; it's a seven or eight minute walk.

examples.zh: 这道菜再放一两分钟就可以出锅了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài zài fàng yī liǎng fēn zhōng jiù kě yǐ chū guō le。
examples.en: This dish will be ready to serve in another minute or two.

examples.zh: 桌子上还剩三四块饼干,你都拿去吃吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhuō zi shàng hái shèng sān sì kuài bǐng gān, nǐ dōu ná qù chī ba。
examples.en: There are three or four cookies left on the table; take them all.

examples.zh: 这场雨大概还要下十来分钟,咱们等等再走。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng yǔ dà gài hái yào xià shí lái fēn zhōng, zán men děng děng zài zǒu。
examples.en: This rain will probably last another ten minutes or so; let's wait a bit.

examples.zh: 那位老人看着有七八十岁了,身体还很硬朗。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎo rén kàn zhe yǒu qī bā shí suì le, shēn tǐ hái hěn yìng lǎng。
examples.en: That old man looks seventy or eighty, yet he's still quite robust.

examples.zh: 我一个星期大概去五六次健身房。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yí gè xīng qī dà gài qù wǔ liù cì jiàn shēn fáng。
examples.en: I go to the gym about five or six times a week.

examples.zh: 这些葡萄不多,也就两三串,给孩子吃正好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē pú táo bù duō, yě jiù liǎng sān chuàn, gěi hái zi chī zhèng hǎo。
examples.en: There aren't many grapes, just two or three bunches, just right for the child.

examples.zh: 从这儿到火车站，坐车也就十几分钟。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhè ér dào huǒ chē zhàn， zuò chē yě jiù shí jǐ fēn zhōng。
examples.en: From here to the train station, it's only about ten-odd minutes by car.

examples.zh: 他每天要接三四十个电话,忙得连饭都顾不上吃。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān yào jiē sān sì shí gè diàn huà, máng de lián fàn dōu gù bù shàng chī。
examples.en: He takes thirty or forty calls a day, too busy even to eat.

examples.zh: 这么小的房间,顶多能坐五六个人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me xiǎo de fáng jiān, dǐng duō néng zuò wǔ liù gè rén。
examples.en: Such a small room can seat six people at most.

examples.zh: 再等三五分钟,他应该就到了。
examples.pinyin: Zài děng sān wǔ fēn zhōng, tā yīng gāi jiù dào le。
examples.en: Wait another three to five minutes and he should arrive.

examples.zh: 我们班有三四个同学都报名参加了比赛。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men bān yǒu sān sì gè tóng xué dōu bào míng cān jiā le bǐ sài。
examples.en: Three or four classmates in our class signed up for the competition.

examples.zh: 这条鱼不小,估计有两三斤重。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo yú bù xiǎo, gū jì yǒu liǎng sān jīn zhòng。
examples.en: This fish isn't small; it's probably two or three jin in weight.

examples.zh: 孩子发烧了,已经烧了两三天还没退。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi fā shāo le, yǐ jīng shāo le liǎng sān tiān hái méi tuì。
examples.en: The child has a fever that's lasted two or three days and still hasn't broken.

examples.zh: 这家小店开了二三十年,是这条街上最老的一家。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā xiǎo diàn kāi le èr sān shí nián, shì zhè tiáo jiē shàng zuì lǎo de yī jiā。
examples.en: This small shop has been open for twenty or thirty years, the oldest on the street.

examples.zh: 我给你留了四五个苹果,放在冰箱里了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gěi nǐ liú le sì wǔ gè píng guǒ, fàng zài bīng xiāng lǐ le。
examples.en: I left you four or five apples in the fridge.

examples.zh: 这段路不长,骑自行车五六分钟就过去了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duàn lù bù zhǎng, qí zì xíng chē wǔ liù fēn zhōng jiù guò qù le。
examples.en: This stretch of road isn't long; five or six minutes by bike.

examples.zh: 他一顿能吃三四碗米饭,饭量特别大。
examples.pinyin: Tā yī dùn néng chī sān sì wǎn mǐ fàn, fàn liàng tè bié dà。
examples.en: He can eat three or four bowls of rice in one meal; his appetite is huge.

examples.zh: 会议室里坐着十几个人,正在认真地讨论。
examples.pinyin: Huì yì shì lǐ zuò zhe shí jǐ gè rén, zhèng zài rèn zhēn de tǎo lùn。
examples.en: A dozen or so people are seated in the meeting room, discussing seriously.

examples.zh: 这种花一年能开两三次,特别好养。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhòng huā yī nián néng kāi liǎng sān cì, tè bié hǎo yǎng。
examples.en: This flower blooms two or three times a year and is easy to keep.

examples.zh: 再过三四年,这些小树就能长得很高了。
examples.pinyin: Zài guò sān sì nián, zhè xiē xiǎo shù jiù néng zhǎng de hěn gāo le。
examples.en: In another three or four years, these little trees will grow quite tall.

title: Çince'de büyük sayılar (万 / 亿)
summary: Çince büyük sayıları dörtlü basamakla sayar: 万 (wàn) = on bin, 亿 (yì) = yüz milyon.
explanation: Çince'de büyük sayılar Türkçeden farklı gruplanır: temel büyük birim "万" (wàn) = 10.000 (on bin) ve "亿" (yì) = 100.000.000 (yüz milyon)'dur. Yani Türkçedeki "yüz bin" Çince'de 十万 (on tane wàn), "bir milyon" 一百万 (yüz wàn), "on milyon" 一千万 (bin wàn) olur. Bu dörtlü basamak sistemi başta zorlar; anahtar, sayıyı önce kaç "万" olduğuna bölmektir. 一万 (10 bin), 十万 (100 bin), 百万 (milyon), 亿 (100 milyon). Bütün sayılar Çince rakamlarla yazılır.

examples.zh: 这座城市大概有五百万人,是个不小的城市。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéng shì dà gài yǒu wǔ bǎi wàn rén, shì gè bù xiǎo de chéng shì。
examples.en: This city has about five million people; it's a fairly large city.

examples.zh: 那套房子太贵了,听说要三百多万。
examples.pinyin: Nà tào fáng zi tài guì le, tīng shuō yào sān bǎi duō wàn。
examples.en: That apartment is too expensive; I heard it costs over three million.

examples.zh: 这家公司去年一年就挣了好几个亿。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōng sī qù nián yī nián jiù zhēng le hǎo jǐ gè yì。
examples.en: This company earned several hundred million in just one year.

examples.zh: 我们学校一共有一万多名学生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men xué xiào yī gòng yǒu yī wàn duō míng xué shēng。
examples.en: Our school has over ten thousand students in total.

examples.zh: 中国有十几亿人口,是世界上人口最多的国家之一。
examples.pinyin: Zhōng guó yǒu shí jǐ yì rén kǒu, shì shì jiè shàng rén kǒu zuì duō de guó jiā zhī yī。
examples.en: China has over a billion people, one of the most populous countries in the world.

examples.zh: 这次活动一共来了差不多两万人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huó dòng yī gòng lái le chà bu duō liǎng wàn rén。
examples.en: About twenty thousand people came to this event in total.

examples.zh: 他辛辛苦苦攒了十几万,想给父母买套房子。
examples.pinyin: Tā xīn xīn kǔ kǔ zǎn le shí jǐ wàn, xiǎng gěi fù mǔ mǎi tào fáng zi。
examples.en: He painstakingly saved a hundred-odd thousand to buy his parents an apartment.

examples.zh: 这条大桥花了好几十亿才建成。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo dà qiáo huā le hǎo jǐ shí yì cái jiàn chéng。
examples.en: This great bridge cost several billion to build.

examples.zh: 那位画家的一幅画,竟然卖了上千万。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi huà jiā de yī fú huà, jìng rán mài le shàng qiān wàn。
examples.en: One of that painter's works actually sold for over ten million.

examples.zh: 这个手机应用有一亿多用户,非常受欢迎。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge shǒu jī yìng yòng yǒu yī yì duō yòng hù, fēi cháng shòu huān yíng。
examples.en: This phone app has over a hundred million users and is very popular.

examples.zh: 我们村现在也就剩下几百人了,年轻人都进城了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men cūn xiàn zài yě jiù shèng xià jǐ bǎi rén le, nián qīng rén dōu jìn chéng le。
examples.en: Our village now has only a few hundred people left; the young have all moved to the city.

examples.zh: 光是修这条路,政府就投了好几个亿。
examples.pinyin: Guāng shì xiū zhè tiáo lù, zhèng fǔ jiù tóu le hǎo jǐ gè yì。
examples.en: Just to build this road, the government invested several hundred million.

examples.zh: 这次地震,有几十万人受到了影响。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì dì zhèn, yǒu jǐ shí wàn rén shòu dào le yǐng xiǎng。
examples.en: This earthquake affected several hundred thousand people.

examples.zh: 他中了彩票,一下子得了五百万。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhōng le cǎi piào, yī xià zi de le wǔ bǎi wàn。
examples.en: He won the lottery and suddenly got five million.

examples.zh: 这家工厂一年能生产几百万台机器。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōng chǎng yī nián néng shēng chǎn jǐ bǎi wàn tái jī qì。
examples.en: This factory can produce several million machines a year.

examples.zh: 那个明星在网上有三千多万粉丝。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge míng xīng zài wǎng shàng yǒu sān qiān duō wàn fěn sī。
examples.en: That celebrity has over thirty million fans online.

examples.zh: 这本书一共卖了一千多万本,非常畅销。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū yī gòng mài le yī qiān duō wàn běn, fēi cháng chàng xiāo。
examples.en: This book has sold over ten million copies; it's a bestseller.

examples.zh: 为了这个项目,公司准备投资五个亿。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le zhè ge xiàng mù, gōng sī zhǔn bèi tóu zī wǔ gè yì。
examples.en: For this project, the company is prepared to invest five hundred million.

examples.zh: 这座体育馆能坐五万多人,场面特别壮观。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò tǐ yù guǎn néng zuò wǔ wàn duō rén, chǎng miàn tè bié zhuàng guān。
examples.en: This stadium can seat over fifty thousand people; the scene is spectacular.

examples.zh: 他们花了将近一百万,把老房子重新装修了一遍。
examples.pinyin: Tā men huā le jiāng jìn yì bǎi wàn, bǎ lǎo fáng zi chóng xīn zhuāng xiū le yī biàn。
examples.en: They spent nearly a million to fully renovate the old house.

examples.zh: 这条河养活了沿岸上千万的老百姓。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé yǎng huó le yán àn shàng qiān wàn de lǎo bǎi xìng。
examples.en: This river sustains tens of millions of people along its banks.

examples.zh: 这次网上活动,参加的人超过了一百万。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì wǎng shàng huó dòng, cān jiā de rén chāo guò le yì bǎi wàn。
examples.en: Over a million people took part in this online event.

examples.zh: 这家医院一年要接待几十万个病人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yī yuàn yī nián yào jiē dài jǐ shí wàn gè bìng rén。
examples.en: This hospital receives several hundred thousand patients a year.

examples.zh: 这个游戏刚上线,一天就有几百万人下载。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge yóu xì gāng shàng xiàn, yī tiān jiù yǒu jǐ bǎi wàn rén xià zài。
examples.en: This game just launched, and millions downloaded it in a single day.

examples.zh: 那家老店一年的收入也不过一二十万。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā lǎo diàn yī nián de shōu rù yě bù guò yī èr shí wàn。
examples.en: That old shop's annual income is only a hundred to two hundred thousand.

title: Saat yapısı (ileri düzey)
pattern: Sayı + 点(钟) + Sayı + 分 / 半 / 刻
summary: Saat söylenirken "点" (diǎn) saati, "分" (fēn) dakikayı, "半" (bàn) yarımı, "刻" (kè) çeyreği gösterir: 两点十分 = iki on.
explanation: Çince'de saat şöyle kurulur: Sayı + 点 (saat) + Sayı + 分 (dakika). 两点十分 (2:10), 八点半 (8:30, 半 = yarım), 三点一刻 (3:15, 一刻 = bir çeyrek), 差一刻五点 (5'e çeyrek var, 差 = eksik). ÖNEMLİ ayrıntılar: saat 2 için "两点" denir ("二点" değil); "钟" (点钟) yalnız dakika söylenmediğinde eklenebilir (五点钟). "半" yarım saati, "刻" on beş dakikayı verir. "差" ile saate kalan süre söylenir. Bütün sayılar Çince rakamlarla yazılır.

examples.zh: 现在是下午两点十分,离下班还有三个小时。
examples.pinyin: Xiàn zài shì xià wǔ liǎng diǎn shí fēn, lí xià bān hái yǒu sān gè xiǎo shí。
examples.en: It's now 2:10 in the afternoon; there are still three hours until the end of work.

examples.zh: 我们约的是晚上七点半,你怎么六点就来了?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men yuē de shì wǎn shàng qī diǎn bàn, nǐ zěn me liù diǎn jiù lái le?
examples.en: We agreed on seven-thirty in the evening; why did you come at six?

examples.zh: 火车八点一刻发车,你最好七点五十就到站。
examples.pinyin: Huǒ chē bā diǎn yī kè fā chē, nǐ zuì hǎo qī diǎn wǔ shí jiù dào zhàn。
examples.en: The train leaves at a quarter past eight; you'd better be at the station by 7:50.

examples.zh: 差一刻九点了,快点儿,不然要迟到了。
examples.pinyin: Chà yī kè jiǔ diǎn le, kuài diǎn ér, bù rán yào chí dào le。
examples.en: It's a quarter to nine; hurry, or you'll be late.

examples.zh: 每天早上六点钟,闹钟一响我就得起床。
examples.pinyin: Měi tiān zǎo shàng liù diǎn zhōng, nào zhōng yī xiǎng wǒ jiù de qǐ chuáng。
examples.en: Every morning at six, I have to get up as soon as the alarm rings.

examples.zh: 会议从上午十点开到中午十二点半才结束。
examples.pinyin: Huì yì cóng shàng wǔ shí diǎn kāi dào zhōng wǔ shí èr diǎn bàn cái jié shù。
examples.en: The meeting ran from ten in the morning until half past twelve at noon.

examples.zh: 他常常工作到晚上十一点多才回家。
examples.pinyin: Tā cháng cháng gōng zuò dào wǎn shàng shí yì diǎn duō cái huí jiā。
examples.en: He often works until past eleven at night before going home.

examples.zh: 现在几点?我的表停了,好像是三点差五分。
examples.pinyin: Xiàn zài jǐ diǎn? wǒ de biǎo tíng le, hǎo xiàng shì sān diǎn chà wǔ fēn。
examples.en: What time is it now? My watch stopped; it seems to be five to three.

examples.zh: 飞机是下午四点二十的,咱们两点就得出发。
examples.pinyin: Fēi jī shì xià wǔ sì diǎn èr shí de, zán men liǎng diǎn jiù dé chū fā。
examples.en: The flight is at 4:20 in the afternoon; we need to leave by two.

examples.zh: 商店晚上九点关门,你得在九点以前赶到。
examples.pinyin: Shāng diàn wǎn shàng jiǔ diǎn guān mén, nǐ děi zài jiǔ diǎn yǐ qián gǎn dào。
examples.en: The store closes at nine at night; you need to get there before nine.

examples.zh: 我一般十一点半睡觉,早上七点起床。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yì bān shí yì diǎn bàn shuì jiào, zǎo shàng qī diǎn qǐ chuáng。
examples.en: I usually go to bed at half past eleven and get up at seven.

examples.zh: 电影七点四十开始,咱们先去吃个饭吧。
examples.pinyin: Diàn yǐng qī diǎn sì shí kāi shǐ, zán men xiān qù chī gè fàn ba。
examples.en: The movie starts at 7:40; let's grab a meal first.

examples.zh: 现在才五点一刻,时间还早,不用着急。
examples.pinyin: Xiàn zài cái wǔ diǎn yī kè, shí jiān hái zǎo, bù yòng zháo jí。
examples.en: It's only a quarter past five now; there's still plenty of time, no rush.

examples.zh: 他每天中午十二点准时去食堂吃饭。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zhōng wǔ shí èr diǎn zhǔn shí qù shí táng chī fàn。
examples.en: Every day at exactly noon he goes to the canteen to eat.

examples.zh: 差十分八点的时候,老师就走进了教室。
examples.pinyin: Chà shí fēn bā diǎn de shí hòu, lǎo shī jiù zǒu jìn le jiào shì。
examples.en: At ten to eight, the teacher walked into the classroom.

examples.zh: 我们下午三点半在咖啡馆见,别忘了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men xià wǔ sān diǎn bàn zài kā fēi guǎn jiàn, bié wàng le。
examples.en: We're meeting at the café at half past three in the afternoon; don't forget.

examples.zh: 银行的开门时间是早上九点,别去太早。
examples.pinyin: Yín háng de kāi mén shí jiān shì zǎo shàng jiǔ diǎn, bié qù tài zǎo。
examples.en: The bank opens at nine in the morning; don't go too early.

examples.zh: 现在是晚上八点整,新闻节目马上就要开始了。
examples.pinyin: Xiàn zài shì wǎn shàng bā diǎn zhěng, xīn wén jié mù mǎ shàng jiù yào kāi shǐ le。
examples.en: It's now eight o'clock sharp in the evening; the news is about to start.

examples.zh: 他六点四十五起床,七点一刻准时出门。
examples.pinyin: Tā liù diǎn sì shí wǔ qǐ chuáng, qī diǎn yī kè zhǔn shí chū mén。
examples.en: He gets up at 6:45 and leaves the house at a quarter past seven sharp.

examples.zh: 比赛下午两点开始,四点半左右就能结束。
examples.pinyin: Bǐ sài xià wǔ liǎng diǎn kāi shǐ, sì diǎn bàn zuǒ yòu jiù néng jié shù。
examples.en: The match starts at two in the afternoon and should end around four-thirty.

examples.zh: 我们坐的是十点五十的高铁,时间挺合适。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men zuò de shì shí diǎn wǔ shí de gāo tiě, shí jiān tǐng hé shì。
examples.en: We're taking the 10:50 high-speed train; the timing is quite convenient.

examples.zh: 差一刻十二点了,厨房里还飘着饭菜的香味。
examples.pinyin: Chà yī kè shí èr diǎn le, chú fáng lǐ hái piāo zhe fàn cài de xiāng wèi。
examples.en: It's a quarter to twelve, and the smell of food still drifts from the kitchen.

examples.zh: 每天下午四点钟,他都要喝一杯茶休息一下。
examples.pinyin: Měi tiān xià wǔ sì diǎn zhōng, tā dōu yào hē yī bēi chá xiū xī yī xià。
examples.en: Every afternoon at four, he has a cup of tea and rests a bit.

examples.zh: 现在是凌晨一点多,整个城市都安静下来了。
examples.pinyin: Xiàn zài shì líng chén yì diǎn duō, zhěng gè chéng shì dōu ān jìng xià lái le。
examples.en: It's now past one in the morning, and the whole city has quieted down.

examples.zh: 我们说好八点半集合,结果九点还有人没到。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men shuō hǎo bā diǎn bàn jí hé, jié guǒ jiǔ diǎn hái yǒu rén méi dào。
examples.en: We agreed to gather at eight-thirty, but at nine some still hadn't arrived.

title: "几" ile "birkaç"
summary: "几" (jǐ) bir ölçü sözcüğüyle birlikte "birkaç" (belirsiz küçük sayı) anlamı verir: 几个人 = birkaç kişi.
explanation: "几" hem "kaç?" diye soru sorar (几个人? = kaç kişi?), hem de düz cümlede "birkaç" anlamında belirsiz küçük bir sayı bildirir: 我买了几本书 (Birkaç kitap aldım). Bu ikinci kullanımda soru anlamı yoktur; bağlam ve cümle sonundaki soru işaretinin olup olmaması ayırt eder. "几" mutlaka bir ÖLÇÜ SÖZCÜĞÜ ile gelir: 几个 (birkaç tane), 几天 (birkaç gün), 几次 (birkaç kez). Genelde ondan küçük belirsiz bir miktarı gösterir. On üstü için "十几" (on küsur), "几十" (birkaç on) gibi kalıplara girer.

examples.zh: 我昨天在书店买了几本关于历史的书。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuó tiān zài shū diàn mǎi le jǐ běn guān yú lì shǐ de shū。
examples.en: Yesterday I bought several history books at the bookstore.

examples.zh: 这几天他一直不舒服,你去看看他吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān tā yì zhí bù shū fú, nǐ qù kàn kàn tā ba。
examples.en: He's been unwell these past few days; go check on him.

examples.zh: 桌子上放着几个又大又红的苹果。
examples.pinyin: Zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe jǐ gè yòu dà yòu hóng de píng guǒ。
examples.en: There are several big red apples on the table.

examples.zh: 我有几个问题想问你,你现在方便吗?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu jǐ gè wèn tí xiǎng wèn nǐ, nǐ xiàn zài fāng biàn ma?
examples.en: I have a few questions to ask you; is now convenient?

examples.zh: 他在国外住了几年,汉语都快忘光了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài guó wài zhù le jǐ nián, hàn yǔ dōu kuài wàng guāng le。
examples.en: He lived abroad for several years and has nearly forgotten his Chinese.

examples.zh: 周末我约了几个老朋友一起去爬山。
examples.pinyin: Zhōu mò wǒ yuē le jǐ gè lǎo péng yǒu yì qǐ qù pá shān。
examples.en: For the weekend I've arranged to go hiking with several old friends.

examples.zh: 门口停着几辆车,不知道是谁的。
examples.pinyin: Mén kǒu tíng zhe jǐ liàng chē, bù zhī dào shì shéi de。
examples.en: Several cars are parked at the entrance; I don't know whose they are.

examples.zh: 这件事我考虑了好几天,还是决定去试一试。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ kǎo lǜ le hǎo jǐ tiān, hái shì jué dìng qù shì yī shì。
examples.en: I thought about this for several days and still decided to give it a try.

examples.zh: 妈妈给我做了几样我最爱吃的菜。
examples.pinyin: Mā mā gěi wǒ zuò le jǐ yàng wǒ zuì ài chī de cài。
examples.en: Mom made me several of my favorite dishes.

examples.zh: 我们在那个小城玩了几天,过得特别开心。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men zài nà ge xiǎo chéng wán le jǐ tiān, guò de tè bié kāi xīn。
examples.en: We played in that small town for a few days and had a great time.

examples.zh: 他从包里拿出几张照片,给我们讲起了往事。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng bāo lǐ ná chū jǐ zhāng zhào piān, gěi wǒ men jiǎng qǐ le wǎng shì。
examples.en: He took several photos out of his bag and told us about the past.

examples.zh: 这几个月我一直很忙,连给家里打电话的时间都没有。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ gè yuè wǒ yì zhí hěn máng, lián gěi jiā lǐ dǎ diàn huà de shí jiān dōu méi yǒu。
examples.en: These past few months I've been so busy I hardly had time to call home.

examples.zh: 路边种着几棵樱花树,春天开得特别美。
examples.pinyin: Lù biān zhǒng zhe jǐ kē yīng huā shù, chūn tiān kāi de tè bié měi。
examples.en: Several cherry trees are planted by the road; in spring they bloom beautifully.

examples.zh: 我想请几天假,回老家看看年迈的父母。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐng jǐ tiān jiǎ, huí lǎo jiā kàn kàn nián mài de fù mǔ。
examples.en: I'd like to take a few days off to visit my aging parents back home.

examples.zh: 这道题我做错了好几次,今天终于弄明白了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí wǒ zuò cuò le hǎo jǐ cì, jīn tiān zhōng yú nòng míng bái le。
examples.en: I got this problem wrong several times, but today I finally understood it.

examples.zh: 他每天只睡几个小时,身体越来越差了。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zhǐ shuì jǐ gè xiǎo shí, shēn tǐ yuè lái yuè chà le。
examples.en: He sleeps only a few hours a day, and his health is getting worse.

examples.zh: 我们班有几个同学的汉语说得特别流利。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men bān yǒu jǐ gè tóng xué de hàn yǔ shuō de tè bié liú lì。
examples.en: Several classmates in our class speak Chinese especially fluently.

examples.zh: 这几种水果里,我最喜欢的还是西瓜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ zhǒng shuǐ guǒ lǐ, wǒ zuì xǐ huān de hái shì xī guā。
examples.en: Of these few kinds of fruit, my favorite is still watermelon.

examples.zh: 过几天就是妈妈的生日了,我得准备一份礼物。
examples.pinyin: Guò jǐ tiān jiù shì mā mā de shēng rì le, wǒ děi zhǔn bèi yī fèn lǐ wù。
examples.en: In a few days it'll be mom's birthday, so I need to prepare a gift.

examples.zh: 他一口气吃了好几个包子,看来是真饿了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yì kǒu qì chī le hǎo jǐ gè bāo zi, kàn lái shì zhēn è le。
examples.en: He wolfed down several buns in one go; he must have been really hungry.

examples.zh: 这几年城市变化很大,很多老房子都拆了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ nián chéng shì biàn huà hěn dà, hěn duō lǎo fáng zi dōu chāi le。
examples.en: The city has changed a lot in recent years; many old houses were torn down.

examples.zh: 我给你带了几件冬天穿的厚衣服。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gěi nǐ dài le jǐ jiàn dōng tiān chuān de hòu yī fú。
examples.en: I brought you several thick clothes for winter.

examples.zh: 会议室里只坐着几个人,气氛有点儿冷清。
examples.pinyin: Huì yì shì lǐ zhǐ zuò zhe jǐ gè rén, qì fēn yǒu diǎn ér lěng qīng。
examples.en: Only a few people are seated in the meeting room; the mood is a bit quiet.

examples.zh: 这条小河里有好几种颜色鲜艳的小鱼。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo xiǎo hé lǐ yǒu hǎo jǐ zhǒng yán sè xiān yàn de xiǎo yú。
examples.en: There are several kinds of brightly colored little fish in this stream.

examples.zh: 我在这家公司只待了几个月就辞职了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài zhè jiā gōng sī zhǐ dài le jǐ gè yuè jiù cí zhí le。
examples.en: I stayed at this company only a few months before resigning.

title: "了" ile durum değişimi
summary: Cümle sonundaki "了" (le) yeni bir durumun ortaya çıktığını, bir değişimin olduğunu bildirir: 下雨了 = Yağmur başladı (yağmaya başladı).
explanation: Cümlenin sonuna gelen "了" çoğu zaman bir DURUM DEĞİŞİMİNİ bildirir: önce öyle değildi, şimdi öyle oldu. 下雨了 (Yağmur yağmaya başladı — önce yağmıyordu), 天黑了 (Hava karardı), 他长大了 (Büyüdü), 我懂了 (Anladım — artık anlıyorum). Bu "了" geçmiş zaman eki DEĞİLDİR; şimdiki ya da gelecekteki bir değişimi de gösterebilir: 春天了 (Bahar geldi). Sıfat, isim ya da fiil öbeğinin ardından gelip "artık ... oldu" anlamını taşır. Yeni durumu vurgular.

examples.zh: 你看,外面下雨了,快把窗户关上吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, wài miàn xià yǔ le, kuài bǎ chuāng hù guān shàng ba。
examples.en: Look, it's started raining outside; hurry and close the windows.

examples.zh: 天黑了,孩子们该回家吃晚饭了。
examples.pinyin: Tiān hēi le, hái zi men gāi huí jiā chī wǎn fàn le。
examples.en: It's gotten dark; the children should head home for dinner.

examples.zh: 几年不见,你女儿都长这么高了。
examples.pinyin: Jǐ nián bú jiàn, nǐ nǚ ér dōu zhǎng zhè me gāo le。
examples.en: It's been a few years — your daughter has grown so tall now.

examples.zh: 我以前不喜欢喝茶,现在慢慢喜欢上了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ qián bù xǐ huān hē chá, xiàn zài màn màn xǐ huān shàng le。
examples.en: I used to dislike tea, but now I've gradually come to like it.

examples.zh: 春天了,公园里的树都绿了,花也开了。
examples.pinyin: Chūn tiān le, gōng yuán lǐ de shù dōu lǜ le, huā yě kāi le。
examples.en: It's spring now; the trees in the park have turned green and the flowers have bloomed.

examples.zh: 别叫他了,他已经睡着了。
examples.pinyin: Bié jiào tā le, tā yǐ jīng shuì zháo le。
examples.en: Don't call him anymore; he's already fallen asleep.

examples.zh: 我终于明白了,原来他一直在为我着想。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhōng yú míng bái le, yuán lái tā yì zhí zài wèi wǒ zhuó xiǎng。
examples.en: I finally understand now; he's been thinking of me all along.

examples.zh: 以前这里很热闹,现在人越来越少了。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ qián zhè lǐ hěn rè nào, xiàn zài rén yuè lái yuè shǎo le。
examples.en: It used to be lively here; now there are fewer and fewer people.

examples.zh: 你怎么瘦了这么多?是不是最近太累了?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěn me shòu le zhè me duō? shì bú shì zuì jìn tài lèi le?
examples.en: How did you get so much thinner? Have you been too tired lately?

examples.zh: 水开了,你快去把火关小一点。
examples.pinyin: Shuǐ kāi le, nǐ kuài qù bǎ huǒ guān xiǎo yì diǎn。
examples.en: The water's boiling; go turn the heat down a bit.

examples.zh: 天气冷了,你出门记得多穿一件外套。
examples.pinyin: Tiān qì lěng le, nǐ chū mén jì de duō chuān yī jiàn wài tào。
examples.en: The weather's gotten cold; remember to wear an extra coat when you go out.

examples.zh: 孩子上小学了,家里一下子安静了不少。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi shàng xiǎo xué le, jiā lǐ yī xià zi ān jìng le bù shǎo。
examples.en: The child has started primary school, and the house has suddenly become much quieter.

examples.zh: 我不生气了,刚才是我太着急了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù shēng qì le, gāng cái shì wǒ tài zháo jí le。
examples.en: I'm not angry anymore; I was just too anxious earlier.

examples.zh: 路灯亮了,街上的行人也渐渐多了起来。
examples.pinyin: Lù dēng liàng le, jiē shàng de xíng rén yě jiàn jiàn duō le qǐ lái。
examples.en: The streetlights have come on, and more and more pedestrians appear on the street.

examples.zh: 他戒烟了,身体比以前好多了。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiè yān le, shēn tǐ bǐ yǐ qián hǎo duō le。
examples.en: He's quit smoking, and his health is much better than before.

examples.zh: 我们到站了,快拿好行李准备下车。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men dào zhàn le, kuài ná hǎo xíng lǐ zhǔn bèi xià chē。
examples.en: We've reached the station; grab your luggage and get ready to get off.

examples.zh: 奶奶年纪大了,耳朵有点儿不好使了。
examples.pinyin: Nǎi nǎi nián jì dà le, ěr duǒ yǒu diǎn ér bù hǎo shǐ le。
examples.en: Grandma has gotten old, and her hearing isn't quite so good anymore.

examples.zh: 你别担心,他的病已经好了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié dān xīn, tā de bìng yǐ jīng hǎo le。
examples.en: Don't worry; he's already recovered from his illness.

examples.zh: 外面刮风了,看样子要变天了。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn guā fēng le, kàn yàng zi yào biàn tiān le。
examples.en: The wind has picked up outside; it looks like the weather's about to change.

examples.zh: 以前我不会做饭,现在会做好几样菜了。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ qián wǒ bú huì zuò fàn, xiàn zài huì zuò hǎo jǐ yàng cài le。
examples.en: I used to not know how to cook; now I can make several dishes.

examples.zh: 时间不早了,咱们该走了。
examples.pinyin: Shí jiān bù zǎo le, zán men gāi zǒu le。
examples.en: It's getting late; we should get going.

examples.zh: 这本书太旧了,很多页都掉了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū tài jiù le, hěn duō yè dōu diào le。
examples.en: This book has gotten too old; many pages have fallen out.

examples.zh: 他终于想通了,决定重新开始。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhōng yú xiǎng tōng le, jué dìng chóng xīn kāi shǐ。
examples.en: He's finally come to terms with it and decided to start over.

examples.zh: 孩子懂事了,知道帮妈妈做家务了。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi dǒng shì le, zhī dào bāng mā mā zuò jiā wù le。
examples.en: The child has become sensible and now knows to help mom with chores.

examples.zh: 路修好了,现在开车进城方便多了。
examples.pinyin: Lù xiū hǎo le, xiàn zài kāi chē jìn chéng fāng biàn duō le。
examples.en: The road's been repaired; driving into the city is much easier now.

title: "吧" ile isteksiz kabul / rıza
summary: Cümle sonundaki "吧" (ba) burada isteksizce razı olmayı, "peki, öyle olsun" gibi bir kabulü bildirir: 好吧 = Peki o zaman.
explanation: "吧" cümle sonuna gelen çok işlevli bir parçacıktır; bu konuda özellikle İSTEKSİZ KABUL / razı olma tonunu ele alıyoruz. Karşıdakinin dediğini gönülsüzce ama kabul ederek onaylar: 好吧,就听你的 (Peki, dediğin gibi olsun), 那就这样吧 (O zaman öyle olsun). Türkçedeki "peki, madem öyle, tamam o zaman" tonuna denk gelir. Konuşmacı tam istemese de teklifi kabul eder ya da bir sonuca boyun eğer. ("吧" ayrıca yumuşak öneri ve tahmin de bildirir — bkz. diğer konular.)

examples.zh: 好吧,既然你这么想去,那咱们就去吧。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo ba, jì rán nǐ zhè me xiǎng qù, nà zán men jiù qù ba。
examples.en: Fine, since you want to go so badly, let's just go.

examples.zh: 你实在不想吃这个,那就换一个吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shí zài bù xiǎng chī zhè ge, nà jiù huàn yí gè ba。
examples.en: If you really don't want to eat this, then let's switch to another.

examples.zh: 算了吧,这件事就这样过去吧,别再提了。
examples.pinyin: Suàn le ba, zhè jiàn shì jiù zhè yàng guò qù ba, bié zài tí le。
examples.en: Forget it; let's let this matter go and not bring it up again.

examples.zh: 你说得也有道理,那就照你说的办吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de yě yǒu dào lǐ, nà jiù zhào nǐ shuō de bàn ba。
examples.en: You have a point too, so let's do it your way then.

examples.zh: 时间不早了,今天就先到这儿吧。
examples.pinyin: Shí jiān bù zǎo le, jīn tiān jiù xiān dào zhè ér ba。
examples.en: It's getting late; let's call it a day for now.

examples.zh: 既然大家都同意,那我们就这么决定吧。
examples.pinyin: Jì rán dà jiā dōu tóng yì, nà wǒ men jiù zhè me jué dìng ba。
examples.en: Since everyone agrees, let's decide it this way then.

examples.zh: 他不愿意来就别勉强了,让他留在家里吧。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù yuàn yì lái jiù bié miǎn qiǎng le, ràng tā liú zài jiā lǐ ba。
examples.en: If he doesn't want to come, don't force him; let him stay home.

examples.zh: 好吧好吧,是我错了,你别生气了。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo ba hǎo ba, shì wǒ cuò le, nǐ bié shēng qì le。
examples.en: Okay, okay, it's my fault; don't be angry anymore.

examples.zh: 你既然累了,那今天就别做饭了,咱们出去吃吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jì rán lèi le, nà jīn tiān jiù bié zuò fàn le, zán men chū qù chī ba。
examples.en: Since you're tired, let's not cook today; let's eat out.

examples.zh: 这个价钱确实有点贵,不过东西好,就买了吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge jià qián què shí yǒu diǎn guì, bù guò dōng xī hǎo, jiù mǎi le ba。
examples.en: This price is indeed a bit high, but the item's good, so let's just buy it.

examples.zh: 你想一个人静一静,那我先走了,你好好休息吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng yí gè rén jìng yī jìng, nà wǒ xiān zǒu le, nǐ hǎo hǎo xiū xī ba。
examples.en: You want to be alone for a while, so I'll go first; get some rest.

examples.zh: 反正也睡不着了,那咱们干脆早点起来吧。
examples.pinyin: Fǎn zhèng yě shuì bù zhe le, nà zán men gān cuì zǎo diǎn qǐ lái ba。
examples.en: We can't fall asleep anyway, so let's just get up early.

examples.zh: 行吧,我答应你,不过下不为例。
examples.pinyin: Xíng ba, wǒ dā yìng nǐ, bù guò xià bù wéi lì。
examples.en: Alright, I'll agree, but this is the last time.

examples.zh: 既然错过了这班车,那就等下一班吧。
examples.pinyin: Jì rán cuò guò le zhè bān chē, nà jiù děng xià yī bān ba。
examples.en: Since we missed this bus, let's wait for the next one.

examples.zh: 你实在坚持的话,那就按你的意思来吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shí zài jiān chí de huà, nà jiù àn nǐ de yì si lái ba。
examples.en: If you really insist, then let's do it your way.

examples.zh: 天气这么差,今天的活动就取消吧。
examples.pinyin: Tiān qì zhè me chà, jīn tiān de huó dòng jiù qǔ xiāo ba。
examples.en: The weather is so bad; let's just cancel today's activity.

examples.zh: 这道题太难了,咱们先跳过去,做后面的吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí tài nán le, zán men xiān tiào guò qù, zuò hòu miàn de ba。
examples.en: This question is too hard; let's skip it and do the later ones.

examples.zh: 他既然道歉了,你就原谅他这一次吧。
examples.pinyin: Tā jì rán dào qiàn le, nǐ jiù yuán liàng tā zhè yī cì ba。
examples.en: Since he's apologized, forgive him this once.

examples.zh: 既然你不放心,那我陪你一起去吧。
examples.pinyin: Jì rán nǐ bù fàng xīn, nà wǒ péi nǐ yì qǐ qù ba。
examples.en: Since you're worried, I'll go with you then.

examples.zh: 好吧,我承认这次是我考虑得不够周到。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo ba, wǒ chéng rèn zhè cì shì wǒ kǎo lǜ de bù gòu zhōu dào。
examples.en: Fine, I admit I didn't think it through carefully enough this time.

examples.zh: 菜有点儿凉了,不过将就着吃吧。
examples.pinyin: Cài yǒu diǎn ér liáng le, bù guò jiāng jiù zhe chī ba。
examples.en: The food's gotten a bit cold, but let's just make do and eat it.

examples.zh: 既然大家都累了,今天的会就开到这里吧。
examples.pinyin: Jì rán dà jiā dōu lèi le, jīn tiān de huì jiù kāi dào zhè lǐ ba。
examples.en: Since everyone's tired, let's end today's meeting here.

examples.zh: 你们年轻人有自己的想法,那就随你们吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ men nián qīng rén yǒu zì jǐ de xiǎng fǎ, nà jiù suí nǐ men ba。
examples.en: You young people have your own ideas, so suit yourselves.

examples.zh: 那本书他那么想要,就送给他吧。
examples.pinyin: Nà běn shū tā nà me xiǎng yào, jiù sòng gěi tā ba。
examples.en: He wants that book so much; let's just give it to him.

examples.zh: 既然已经这样了,着急也没用,慢慢想办法吧。
examples.pinyin: Jì rán yǐ jīng zhè yàng le, zháo jí yě méi yòng, màn màn xiǎng bàn fǎ ba。
examples.en: Since it's already like this, worrying is useless; let's figure it out slowly.

title: Sadece "了" ile "artık, çoktan"
summary: Fiil öbeğinin sonundaki "了" bir eylemin gerçekleştiğini / tamamlandığını bildirir: 我吃了 = (Ben) yedim / çoktan yedim.
explanation: Cümle sonundaki "了", bir eylemin artık olduğunu, gerçekleştiğini bildirir ve bağlama göre "çoktan, zaten" (already) anlamı taşır: 我吃饭了 (Yemek yedim), 他走了 (Gitti), 电影开始了 (Film başladı). Çoğu zaman "已经...了" ile birlikte gelir ama "了" tek başına da bu anlamı verebilir. Bu, tamamlanmış / gerçekleşmiş bir olayı bildirir; olumsuzu ise "没(有)" iledir ve o zaman "了" düşer: 我还没吃 (Henüz yemedim). Konuşma dilinde çok sık kullanılır.

examples.zh: 你怎么才来?电影都开始半天了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěn me cái lái? diàn yǐng dōu kāi shǐ bàn tiān le。
examples.en: Why are you only arriving now? The movie started ages ago.

examples.zh: 我已经把你要的资料发到你邮箱了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ jīng bǎ nǐ yào de zī liào fā dào nǐ yóu xiāng le。
examples.en: I've already sent the materials you wanted to your email.

examples.zh: 别等我了,我在路上吃过饭了。
examples.pinyin: Bié děng wǒ le, wǒ zài lù shàng chī guò fàn le。
examples.en: Don't wait for me; I already ate on the way.

examples.zh: 他昨天就把作业交给老师了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuó tiān jiù bǎ zuò yè jiāo gěi lǎo shī le。
examples.en: He already handed the homework to the teacher yesterday.

examples.zh: 我跟他说了好几遍了,他还是没记住。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tā shuō le hǎo jǐ biàn le, tā hái shì méi jì zhù。
examples.en: I've told him several times already, but he still hasn't remembered.

examples.zh: 你放心,我把门锁好了,也把灯关了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ fàng xīn, wǒ bǎ mén suǒ hǎo le, yě bǎ dēng guān le。
examples.en: Rest assured, I've locked the door and turned off the lights.

examples.zh: 火车已经开走了,我们只能等下一班了。
examples.pinyin: Huǒ chē yǐ jīng kāi zǒu le, wǒ men zhǐ néng děng xià yī bān le。
examples.en: The train has already left; we can only wait for the next one.

examples.zh: 这本书我看完了,现在借给你吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū wǒ kàn wán le, xiàn zài jiè gěi nǐ ba。
examples.en: I've finished this book; I'll lend it to you now.

examples.zh: 孩子们都睡了,你说话小声一点。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi men dōu shuì le, nǐ shuō huà xiǎo shēng yì diǎn。
examples.en: The children have all gone to sleep; keep your voice down.

examples.zh: 我们认识都十年了,你还这么客气。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men rèn shí dōu shí nián le, nǐ hái zhè me kè qì。
examples.en: We've known each other for ten years already, yet you're still so polite.

examples.zh: 你要的东西我早就买好了,放在你桌子上了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào de dōng xī wǒ zǎo jiù mǎi hǎo le, fàng zài nǐ zhuō zi shàng le。
examples.en: I bought what you wanted long ago; it's on your desk.

examples.zh: 时间过得真快,一转眼一年又过去了。
examples.pinyin: Shí jiān guò de zhēn kuài, yī zhuǎn yǎn yī nián yòu guò qù le。
examples.en: Time really flies; in the blink of an eye another year has passed.

examples.zh: 我把这件事告诉他了,他一点儿都不惊讶。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ zhè jiàn shì gào sù tā le, tā yì diǎn ér dōu bù jīng yà。
examples.en: I told him about this, and he wasn't surprised at all.

examples.zh: 外面的雨停了,我们可以出发了。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn de yǔ tíng le, wǒ men kě yǐ chū fā le。
examples.en: The rain outside has stopped; we can set off now.

examples.zh: 你放的盐太多了,这道菜有点儿咸了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ fàng de yán tài duō le, zhè dào cài yǒu diǎn ér xián le。
examples.en: You put in too much salt; this dish has gotten a bit salty.

examples.zh: 我把你上次借我的钱还给你了,你收到了吗?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ nǐ shàng cì jiè wǒ de qián huán gěi nǐ le, nǐ shōu dào le ma?
examples.en: I've paid back the money you lent me last time; did you get it?

examples.zh: 会议已经结束了,大家都陆续离开了。
examples.pinyin: Huì yì yǐ jīng jié shù le, dà jiā dōu lù xù lí kāi le。
examples.en: The meeting has ended, and everyone has left one after another.

examples.zh: 我等了他一个多小时,他还是没出现。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ děng le tā yí gè duō xiǎo shí, tā hái shì méi chū xiàn。
examples.en: I waited over an hour for him, but he still didn't show up.

examples.zh: 这件衣服我穿了好多年了,该换新的了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yī fú wǒ chuān le hǎo duō nián le, gāi huàn xīn de le。
examples.en: I've worn this shirt for many years; it's time for a new one.

examples.zh: 我们已经商量好了,决定下个月去旅行。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men yǐ jīng shāng liáng hǎo le, jué dìng xià gè yuè qù lǚ xíng。
examples.en: We've already discussed it and decided to travel next month.

examples.zh: 你别找了,我把那份文件交给经理了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié zhǎo le, wǒ bǎ nà fèn wén jiàn jiāo gěi jīng lǐ le。
examples.en: Stop looking; I've handed that document to the manager.

examples.zh: 天气预报说的那场雪,昨天晚上就下了。
examples.pinyin: Tiān qì yù bào shuō de nà chǎng xuě, zuó tiān wǎn shàng jiù xià le。
examples.en: The snow the forecast mentioned already fell last night.

examples.zh: 我给你打了好几个电话了,你怎么都不接?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gěi nǐ dǎ le hǎo jǐ gè diàn huà le, nǐ zěn me dōu bù jiē?
examples.en: I've called you several times; why don't you answer?

examples.zh: 这些菜我都尝过了,味道都很不错。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē cài wǒ dōu cháng guò le, wèi dào dōu hěn bú cuò。
examples.en: I've tasted all these dishes; they all taste quite good.

examples.zh: 孩子今年上大学了,家里就剩我们俩了。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi jīn nián shàng dà xué le, jiā lǐ jiù shèng wǒ men liǎ le。
examples.en: The child started university this year, leaving just the two of us at home.

title: "不/没...了" ile "artık ...-mez oldu"
pattern: 不 / 没(有) + Fiil Öbeği + 了
summary: "不...了" ya da "没...了" bir eylemin ARTIK olmadığını/yapılmadığını bildirir: 我不去了 = Artık gitmiyorum (vazgeçtim).
explanation: Olumsuzluk sözcüğü ("不" ya da "没") ile birlikte cümle sonundaki "了", eskiden olan bir şeyin ARTIK olmadığı/yapılmadığı yönünde bir DEĞİŞİMİ bildirir: 我不喝酒了 (Artık içki içmiyorum — bıraktım), 他不来了 (Artık gelmeyecek / gelmekten vazgeçti), 我没钱了 (Artık param kalmadı). "不...了" niyet/alışkanlık değişimini (artık yapmıyorum), "没...了" ise bir şeyin tükenmesini/kalmamasını anlatır. Anahtar fikir: durum değişti, önceki hâl sona erdi.

examples.zh: 我决定了,以后再也不熬夜了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jué dìng le, yǐ hòu zài yě bù áo yè le。
examples.en: I've decided: I'll never stay up late again.

examples.zh: 他戒烟以后,身体好多了,也不咳嗽了。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiè yān yǐ hòu, shēn tǐ hǎo duō le, yě bù ké sòu le。
examples.en: After he quit smoking, his health improved and he no longer coughs.

examples.zh: 对不起,我今天有事,不能去参加你的生日会了。
examples.pinyin: Duì bù qǐ, wǒ jīn tiān yǒu shì, bù néng qù cān jiā nǐ de shēng rì huì le。
examples.en: Sorry, I have something on today and can't come to your birthday party after all.

examples.zh: 天太晚了,我不打扰你了,改天再聊。
examples.pinyin: Tiān tài wǎn le, wǒ bù dǎ rǎo nǐ le, gǎi tiān zài liáo。
examples.en: It's too late; I won't bother you anymore, let's talk another day.

examples.zh: 钱包里没钱了,我得先去银行取点儿。
examples.pinyin: Qián bāo lǐ méi qián le, wǒ děi xiān qù yín háng qǔ diǎn ér。
examples.en: There's no money left in my wallet; I need to withdraw some from the bank first.

examples.zh: 这双鞋太旧了,我不想穿了,扔了吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shuāng xié tài jiù le, wǒ bù xiǎng chuān le, rēng le ba。
examples.en: These shoes are too old; I don't want to wear them anymore, let's toss them.

examples.zh: 他伤好了以后,就再也不踢足球了。
examples.pinyin: Tā shāng hǎo le yǐ hòu, jiù zài yě bù tī zú qiú le。
examples.en: After his injury healed, he never played soccer again.

examples.zh: 我不爱吃甜的了,以前可是无糖不欢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù ài chī tián de le, yǐ qián kě shì wú táng bù huān。
examples.en: I don't like sweets anymore, though I once couldn't live without sugar.

examples.zh: 时间来不及了,咱们不吃早饭了,直接出发吧。
examples.pinyin: Shí jiān lái bù jí le, zán men bù chī zǎo fàn le, zhí jiē chū fā ba。
examples.en: There's no time; let's skip breakfast and set off directly.

examples.zh: 自从搬了家,我们就很少见面了。
examples.pinyin: Zì cóng bān le jiā, wǒ men jiù hěn shǎo jiàn miàn le。
examples.en: Ever since we moved, we rarely see each other anymore.

examples.zh: 这件事我想通了,不再为它烦恼了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ xiǎng tōng le, bù zài wèi tā fán nǎo le。
examples.en: I've come to terms with this and no longer worry about it.

examples.zh: 冰箱里没有牛奶了,你出去的时候顺便买一盒。
examples.pinyin: Bīng xiāng lǐ méi yǒu niú nǎi le, nǐ chū qù de shí hòu shùn biàn mǎi yī hé。
examples.en: There's no more milk in the fridge; buy a carton when you go out.

examples.zh: 孩子长大了,不再需要我天天照顾了。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi zhǎng dà le, bù zài xū yào wǒ tiān tiān zhào gù le。
examples.en: The child has grown up and no longer needs my daily care.

examples.zh: 我最近很忙,好久没去健身房了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuì jìn hěn máng, hǎo jiǔ méi qù jiàn shēn fáng le。
examples.en: I've been busy lately and haven't been to the gym in a while.

examples.zh: 他退休以后就不上班了,天天在家养花。
examples.pinyin: Tā tuì xiū yǐ hòu jiù bù shàng bān le, tiān tiān zài jiā yǎng huā。
examples.en: After retiring he no longer goes to work and tends flowers at home all day.

examples.zh: 这部电视剧越来越没意思了,我不想看了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diàn shì jù yuè lái yuè méi yì si le, wǒ bù xiǎng kàn le。
examples.en: This TV series is getting more and more boring; I don't want to watch it anymore.

examples.zh: 外面不下雨了,我们可以出去散步了。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn bù xià yǔ le, wǒ men kě yǐ chū qù sàn bù le。
examples.en: It's stopped raining outside; we can go out for a walk now.

examples.zh: 我跟他早就没联系了,不知道他现在怎么样。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tā zǎo jiù méi lián xì le, bù zhī dào tā xiàn zài zěn me yàng。
examples.en: I lost touch with him long ago and don't know how he's doing now.

examples.zh: 身体最重要,以后我不喝那么多酒了。
examples.pinyin: Shēn tǐ zuì zhòng yào, yǐ hòu wǒ bù hē nà me duō jiǔ le。
examples.en: Health matters most; from now on I won't drink so much.

examples.zh: 这个手机太卡了,我不用它了,准备换新的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge shǒu jī tài kǎ le, wǒ bù yòng tā le, zhǔn bèi huàn xīn de。
examples.en: This phone is too laggy; I'm not using it anymore and plan to get a new one.

examples.zh: 下雪了,路太滑,今天就别开车了。
examples.pinyin: Xià xuě le, lù tài huá, jīn tiān jiù bié kāi chē le。
examples.en: It's snowing and the roads are slippery; don't drive today.

examples.zh: 我不生他的气了,毕竟他也是好心。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù shēng tā de qì le, bì jìng tā yě shì hǎo xīn。
examples.en: I'm not angry at him anymore; after all, he meant well.

examples.zh: 家里的米没有了,晚上只能煮面条了。
examples.pinyin: Jiā lǐ de mǐ méi yǒu le, wǎn shàng zhǐ néng zhǔ miàn tiáo le。
examples.en: There's no rice left at home; we can only cook noodles tonight.

examples.zh: 他最近忙工作,连周末都没时间休息了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuì jìn máng gōng zuò, lián zhōu mò dōu méi shí jiān xiū xī le。
examples.en: He's been busy with work lately, with no time to rest even on weekends.

examples.zh: 这条路在修,车过不去了,咱们绕一下吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù zài xiū, chē guò bù qù le, zán men rào yī xià ba。
examples.en: This road is under repair and cars can't get through anymore; let's take a detour.

title: "了" ile "artık ... oldu" (yeni durum)
summary: Cümle sonundaki "了" bir noktaya ulaşıldığını, artık yeni bir durumun geçerli olduğunu bildirir: 他今年二十岁了 = Bu yıl yirmi yaşına geldi.
explanation: Bu "了" bir ölçünün/durumun ARTIK yeni bir noktaya ulaştığını bildirir; özellikle yaş, saat, miktar gibi sayılarla "artık ... oldu" anlamı verir: 他二十岁了 (Yirmi yaşına geldi), 都几点了? (Saat kaç oldu artık?), 快十二点了 (Neredeyse on iki oldu). Bir eşiğin geçildiğini, durumun değiştiğini vurgular ve çoğu zaman "都" (bile/artık) ya da "快" (neredeyse) ile birlikte gelir. Konuşmacı çoğu zaman zamanın geçtiğine ya da bir sınıra gelindiğine dikkat çeker.

examples.zh: 都十一点了,你怎么还不睡觉?
examples.pinyin: Dōu shí yì diǎn le, nǐ zěn me hái bù shuì jiào?
examples.en: It's eleven o'clock already; why aren't you asleep yet?

examples.zh: 我儿子今年都上大学了,时间过得真快。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ ér zi jīn nián dōu shàng dà xué le, shí jiān guò de zhēn kuài。
examples.en: My son is already in university this year; time really flies.

examples.zh: 快到春节了,街上到处都是买年货的人。
examples.pinyin: Kuài dào chūn jié le, jiē shàng dào chù dōu shì mǎi nián huò de rén。
examples.en: The Spring Festival is almost here; the streets are full of people shopping for it.

examples.zh: 你都这么大了,应该学会自己照顾自己了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dōu zhè me dà le, yīng gāi xué huì zì jǐ zhào gù zì jǐ le。
examples.en: You're this grown up now; you should learn to take care of yourself.

examples.zh: 外面都天亮了,他们竟然还在聊天。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn dōu tiān liàng le, tā men jìng rán hái zài liáo tiān。
examples.en: It's already dawn outside, yet they're still chatting.

examples.zh: 再过两个月,我来这个城市就整整十年了。
examples.pinyin: Zài guò liǎng gè yuè, wǒ lái zhè ge chéng shì jiù zhěng zhěng shí nián le。
examples.en: In another two months, I'll have been in this city for a full ten years.

examples.zh: 菜都凉了,你再不回来就不好吃了。
examples.pinyin: Cài dōu liáng le, nǐ zài bù huí lái jiù bù hǎo chī le。
examples.en: The food's gone cold; if you don't come back soon it won't taste good.

examples.zh: 孩子都会走路了,你看他跑得多稳。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi dū huì zǒu lù le, nǐ kàn tā pǎo de duō wěn。
examples.en: The child can walk now; look how steadily he runs.

examples.zh: 都这个时候了,你还不着急,真让人担心。
examples.pinyin: Dōu zhè ge shí hòu le, nǐ hái bù zháo jí, zhēn ràng rén dān xīn。
examples.en: It's already this late and you're still not worried; it's concerning.

examples.zh: 春天到了,天气一天比一天暖和了。
examples.pinyin: Chūn tiān dào le, tiān qì yī tiān bǐ yī tiān nuǎn huo le。
examples.en: Spring has arrived; the weather is getting warmer day by day.

examples.zh: 我奶奶今年八十岁了,身体还很健康。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nǎi nǎi jīn nián bā shí suì le, shēn tǐ hái hěn jiàn kāng。
examples.en: My grandma turns eighty this year and is still very healthy.

examples.zh: 眼看就要放假了,同学们都很兴奋。
examples.pinyin: Yǎn kàn jiù yào fàng jià le, tóng xué men dōu hěn xīng fèn。
examples.en: The holiday is almost here, and the students are all excited.

examples.zh: 你看,都开始下雪了,今年冬天来得真早。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, dōu kāi shǐ xià xuě le, jīn nián dōng tiān lái de zhēn zǎo。
examples.en: Look, it's already started snowing; winter came really early this year.

examples.zh: 我们等了快一个小时了,他怎么还没到?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men děng le kuài yí gè xiǎo shí le, tā zěn me hái méi dào?
examples.en: We've waited nearly an hour; why hasn't he arrived yet?

examples.zh: 时间不早了,再不出发就要赶不上飞机了。
examples.pinyin: Shí jiān bù zǎo le, zài bù chū fā jiù yào gǎn bù shàng fēi jī le。
examples.en: It's getting late; if we don't leave soon we'll miss the flight.

examples.zh: 这孩子都会自己穿衣服了,真让人高兴。
examples.pinyin: Zhè hái zi dū huì zì jǐ chuān yī fú le, zhēn ràng rén gāo xìng。
examples.en: This child can dress himself now; it's really heartwarming.

examples.zh: 天气越来越热了,该把厚衣服收起来了。
examples.pinyin: Tiān qì yuè lái yuè rè le, gāi bǎ hòu yī fú shōu qǐ lái le。
examples.en: The weather is getting hotter; it's time to put away the heavy clothes.

examples.zh: 都快下班了,今天的工作总算做完了。
examples.pinyin: Dōu kuài xià bān le, jīn tiān de gōng zuò zǒng suàn zuò wán le。
examples.en: It's almost time to get off work, and today's tasks are finally done.

examples.zh: 你看看几点了,再睡就要迟到了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn kàn jǐ diǎn le, zài shuì jiù yào chí dào le。
examples.en: Look what time it is; if you keep sleeping you'll be late.

examples.zh: 这些树都长得比房子还高了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē shù dōu zhǎng de bǐ fáng zi hái gāo le。
examples.en: These trees have grown even taller than the house now.

examples.zh: 我学汉语已经三年了,现在能看懂报纸了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xué hàn yǔ yǐ jīng sān nián le, xiàn zài néng kàn dǒng bào zhǐ le。
examples.en: I've studied Chinese for three years now and can read newspapers.

examples.zh: 眼看天就要黑了,我们得快点下山。
examples.pinyin: Yǎn kàn tiān jiù yào hēi le, wǒ men děi kuài diǎn xià shān。
examples.en: It's about to get dark; we need to hurry down the mountain.

examples.zh: 他毕业都五年了,可是还没想好要做什么。
examples.pinyin: Tā bì yè dōu wǔ nián le, kě shì hái méi xiǎng hǎo yào zuò shén me。
examples.en: He's been graduated five years now but still hasn't figured out what to do.

examples.zh: 水果放太久都坏了,只能扔掉了。
examples.pinyin: Shuǐ guǒ fàng tài jiǔ dōu huài le, zhǐ néng rēng diào le。
examples.en: The fruit sat too long and has gone bad; it can only be thrown away.

examples.zh: 你都长这么高了,阿姨都快认不出你了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dōu zhǎng zhè me gāo le, ā yí dōu kuài rèn bù chū nǐ le。
examples.en: You've grown so tall that auntie can hardly recognize you.

title: "了" ile tamamlanma (nesneyle)
summary: Fiilin hemen ARDINDAKİ "了" eylemin tamamlandığını gösterir: 我买了一本书 = Bir kitap aldım (satın alma tamamlandı).
explanation: Fiilin hemen arkasına gelen "了" (cümle sonundaki değil, fiil-sonu "了") o eylemin TAMAMLANDIĞINI/gerçekleştiğini bildirir: 我喝了一杯咖啡 (Bir fincan kahve içtim). Kalıp: Özne + Fiil + 了 + (sayı/sıfat + ölçü) + Nesne. Nesne genellikle bir belirteçle (数量: 一杯, 两个) nitelenir; yalın nesneyle tek başına biraz eksik durur ve arkasına bir devam cümlesi ya da cümle-sonu "了" beklenir. Olumsuzda "没(有)" gelir ve "了" düşer: 我没喝咖啡 (Kahve içmedim). Bu "了" tamamlanmış eylem içindir, geçmiş zaman eki değildir.

examples.zh: 我今天早上喝了一大杯咖啡,现在特别精神。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīn tiān zǎo shàng hē le yī dà bēi kā fēi, xiàn zài tè bié jīng shén。
examples.en: I drank a big cup of coffee this morning and feel very energetic now.

examples.zh: 他昨天在书店买了三本关于做饭的书。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuó tiān zài shū diàn mǎi le sān běn guān yú zuò fàn de shū。
examples.en: Yesterday he bought three cookbooks at the bookstore.

examples.zh: 我们在那家饭馆点了好几个菜,都很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men zài nà jiā fàn guǎn diǎn le hǎo jǐ gè cài, dōu hěn hǎo chī。
examples.en: We ordered several dishes at that restaurant, and all were delicious.

examples.zh: 妈妈给我织了一件毛衣,穿在身上很暖和。
examples.pinyin: Mā mā gěi wǒ zhī le yī jiàn máo yī, chuān zài shēn shàng hěn nuǎn huo。
examples.en: Mom knitted me a sweater; it's warm to wear.

examples.zh: 老师今天讲了一个很重要的语法,你可别没听。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo shī jīn tiān jiǎng le yí gè hěn zhòng yào de yǔ fǎ, nǐ kě bié méi tīng。
examples.en: The teacher taught an important grammar point today; don't tell me you missed it.

examples.zh: 我在路上遇到了一个多年不见的老同学。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài lù shàng yù dào le yí gè duō nián bú jiàn de lǎo tóng xué。
examples.en: On the way I ran into an old classmate I hadn't seen in years.

examples.zh: 他花了整整一个下午,才把房间打扫干净。
examples.pinyin: Tā huā le zhěng zhěng yí gè xià wǔ, cái bǎ fáng jiān dǎ sǎo gān jìng。
examples.en: It took him a whole afternoon to clean the room.

examples.zh: 我昨天看了一部很感人的电影,哭了好几次。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuó tiān kàn le yī bù hěn gǎn rén de diàn yǐng, kū le hǎo jǐ cì。
examples.en: I watched a very moving movie yesterday and cried several times.

examples.zh: 这次旅行,我拍了几百张漂亮的照片。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚ xíng, wǒ pāi le jǐ bǎi zhāng piào liàng de zhào piān。
examples.en: On this trip I took several hundred beautiful photos.

examples.zh: 他喝了不少酒,现在脸红得像苹果一样。
examples.pinyin: Tā hē le bù shǎo jiǔ, xiàn zài liǎn hóng de xiàng píng guǒ yī yàng。
examples.en: He drank quite a lot and his face is now red as an apple.

examples.zh: 我给孩子讲了一个故事,他很快就睡着了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gěi hái zi jiǎng le yí gè gù shì, tā hěn kuài jiù shuì zháo le。
examples.en: I told the child a story, and he soon fell asleep.

examples.zh: 我们爬了三个小时的山,终于到了山顶。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men pá le sān gè xiǎo shí de shān, zhōng yú dào le shān dǐng。
examples.en: We climbed for three hours and finally reached the summit.

examples.zh: 她学了五年钢琴,现在弹得非常好。
examples.pinyin: Tā xué le wǔ nián gāng qín, xiàn zài dàn de fēi cháng hǎo。
examples.en: She studied piano for five years and now plays very well.

examples.zh: 我今天收到了一封老朋友寄来的信。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīn tiān shōu dào le yī fēng lǎo péng yǒu jì lái de xìn。
examples.en: Today I received a letter from an old friend.

examples.zh: 他为了准备考试,看了很多参考书。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèi le zhǔn bèi kǎo shì, kàn le hěn duō cān kǎo shū。
examples.en: To prepare for the exam, he read many reference books.

examples.zh: 我们在公园里散了很久的步,聊了很多事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men zài gōng yuán lǐ sàn le hěn jiǔ de bù, liáo le hěn duō shì。
examples.en: We strolled in the park for a long time and talked about many things.

examples.zh: 我尝了一口她做的汤,味道好极了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cháng le yī kǒu tā zuò de tāng, wèi dào hǎo jí le。
examples.en: I took a sip of the soup she made; it tasted wonderful.

examples.zh: 他用了一个星期,把这个难题解决了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng le yí gè xīng qī, bǎ zhè ge nán tí jiě jué le。
examples.en: He took a week to solve this difficult problem.

examples.zh: 我买了一些水果和蔬菜,准备晚上做饭。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le yī xiē shuǐ guǒ hé shū cài, zhǔn bèi wǎn shàng zuò fàn。
examples.en: I bought some fruit and vegetables to cook dinner tonight.

examples.zh: 孩子写了一封信给远方的爷爷奶奶。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi xiě le yī fēng xìn gěi yuǎn fāng de yé yé nǎi nǎi。
examples.en: The child wrote a letter to his grandparents far away.

examples.zh: 我们讨论了很长时间,最后做出了决定。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men tǎo lùn le hěn zhǎng shí jiān, zuì hòu zuò chū le jué dìng。
examples.en: We discussed it for a long time and finally made a decision.

examples.zh: 他喝了药,躺下休息了一会儿。
examples.pinyin: Tā hē le yào, tǎng xià xiū xī le yī huì er。
examples.en: He took the medicine and lay down to rest for a while.

examples.zh: 我在网上订了两张周末的电影票。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài wǎng shàng dìng le liǎng zhāng zhōu mò de diàn yǐng piào。
examples.en: I booked two movie tickets online for the weekend.

examples.zh: 这次考试我复习了很久,考得还不错。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎo shì wǒ fù xí le hěn jiǔ, kǎo de hái bú cuò。
examples.en: I reviewed a lot for this exam and did fairly well.

examples.zh: 她换了一份新工作,收入比以前高多了。
examples.pinyin: Tā huàn le yī fèn xīn gōng zuò, shōu rù bǐ yǐ qián gāo duō le。
examples.en: She changed to a new job, and her income is much higher than before.

title: "过" ile geçmiş deneyim
summary: Fiilin ardındaki "过" (guo) o eylemin daha önce (en az bir kez) deneyimlendiğini bildirir: 我去过北京 = Pekin'e gitmişliğim var.
explanation: Fiilin ardına gelen "过", bir eylemin geçmişte YAŞANMIŞ bir DENEYİM olduğunu bildirir: 我吃过北京烤鸭 (Pekin ördeği yemişliğim var), 你去过长城吗? (Çin Seddi'ne gittin mi hiç?). Türkçedeki "...-mişliğim var / hiç ...-dın mı" mantığına yakındır ve olayın belli bir zamanına değil, deneyimin varlığına odaklanır. Olumsuzu "没(有)...过" biçimindedir: 我没去过 (Hiç gitmedim). "过" tamamlanma "了"sinden farklıdır: "了" belli bir olayı, "过" ise "böyle bir tecrübem oldu" fikrini anlatır.

examples.zh: 你去过西安吗?那里的兵马俑非常有名。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ qù guò xī ān ma? nà lǐ de bīng mǎ yǒng fēi cháng yǒu míng。
examples.en: Have you been to Xi'an? The Terracotta Warriors there are very famous.

examples.zh: 我从来没吃过这么辣的菜,辣得我直流眼泪。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cóng lái méi chī guò zhè me là de cài, là de wǒ zhí liú yǎn lèi。
examples.en: I've never eaten food this spicy; it made my eyes water.

examples.zh: 他学过三年法语,可是现在差不多都忘了。
examples.pinyin: Tā xué guò sān nián fǎ yǔ, kě shì xiàn zài chà bu duō dōu wàng le。
examples.en: He studied French for three years, but has almost forgotten it all now.

examples.zh: 这部电影我看过两遍,每次看都很感动。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diàn yǐng wǒ kàn guò liǎng biàn, měi cì kàn dōu hěn gǎn dòng。
examples.en: I've watched this movie twice, and it moves me every time.

examples.zh: 你坐过高铁吗?又快又舒服,特别方便。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuò guò gāo tiě ma? yòu kuài yòu shū fú, tè bié fāng biàn。
examples.en: Have you ridden the high-speed rail? It's fast, comfortable, and convenient.

examples.zh: 我小时候在这条河里游过泳,现在河水没那么干净了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎo shí hòu zài zhè tiáo hé lǐ yóu guò yǒng, xiàn zài hé shuǐ méi nà me gān jìng le。
examples.en: As a child I swam in this river; now the water isn't so clean anymore.

examples.zh: 她去过很多国家,见过各种各样的风景。
examples.pinyin: Tā qù guò hěn duō guó jiā, jiàn guò gè zhǒng gè yàng de fēng jǐng。
examples.en: She's been to many countries and seen all kinds of scenery.

examples.zh: 我以前养过一只小狗,后来送给了乡下的亲戚。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ qián yǎng guò yī zhī xiǎo gǒu, hòu lái sòng gěi le xiāng xià de qīn qī。
examples.en: I once kept a puppy, which I later gave to relatives in the countryside.

examples.zh: 这么好听的歌,我以前怎么从来没听过?
examples.pinyin: Zhè me hǎo tīng de gē, wǒ yǐ qián zěn me cóng lái méi tīng guò?
examples.en: Such a lovely song — how have I never heard it before?

examples.zh: 他年轻的时候当过老师,后来改行做了生意。
examples.pinyin: Tā nián qīng de shí hòu dāng guò lǎo shī, hòu lái gǎi háng zuò le shēng yì。
examples.en: When young he worked as a teacher, then switched to business.

examples.zh: 你有没有一个人旅行过?那种感觉很特别。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu méi yǒu yí gè rén lǚ xíng guò? nà zhǒng gǎn jué hěn tè bié。
examples.en: Have you ever traveled alone? That feeling is quite special.

examples.zh: 我尝过很多地方的面条,还是妈妈做的最好吃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cháng guò hěn duō dì fāng de miàn tiáo, hái shì mā mā zuò de zuì hǎo chī。
examples.en: I've tasted noodles from many places, but mom's are still the best.

examples.zh: 这本书我读过好几次,每次都有新的体会。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū wǒ dú guò hǎo jǐ cì, měi cì dōu yǒu xīn de tǐ huì。
examples.en: I've read this book several times, gaining new insights each time.

examples.zh: 他从来没迟到过,今天不知道出了什么事。
