title: Sonuç tümleci: "完" (bitirmek)
summary: "完" fiilin ardına gelip eylemin TAMAMEN BİTTİĞİNİ gösterir: 吃完 = yiyip bitirmek; 做完 = yapıp bitirmek.
explanation: "完" bir fiilin ardına "sonuç tümleci" olarak gelir ve eylemin TAMAMEN tamamlandığını, sonuna kadar bitirildiğini bildirir: 吃完 (yiyip bitirmek), 做完作业 (ödevi bitirmek), 说完 (söyleyip bitirmek), 看完 (okuyup/izleyip bitirmek). Çoğu zaman "了" ile birlikte gelir: 我写完了 (Yazıp bitirdim). Olumsuzu "没(有)...完" (henüz bitmedi): 还没吃完 (henüz yiyip bitirmedi). Olanak biçimi: 做得完 (bitirebilir) / 做不完 (bitiremez). "完" salt bir eylemi değil, eylemin SONUNA ulaşıldığını vurgular; bu yüzden "了"dan (yalnız gerçekleşme) daha güçlü bir "bitmişlik" verir. Günlük dilde çok sık kullanılır.

examples.zh: 你先把作业做完,然后才能出去玩儿。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bǎ zuò yè zuò wán, rán hòu cái néng chū qù wán ér。
examples.en: Finish your homework first, then you can go out to play.

examples.zh: 这本小说我一个晚上就看完了,实在太精彩了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn xiǎo shuō wǒ yí gè wǎn shàng jiù kàn wán le, shí zài tài jīng cǎi le。
examples.en: I finished this novel in one night; it was truly wonderful.

examples.zh: 等我说完,你再发表意见也不迟。
examples.pinyin: Děng wǒ shuō wán, nǐ zài fā biǎo yì jiàn yě bù chí。
examples.en: Wait until I finish, and then it's not too late to give your view.

examples.zh: 桌上的菜还没吃完,别急着收拾。
examples.pinyin: Zhuō shàng de cài hái méi chī wán, bié jí zhe shōu shí。
examples.en: The food on the table isn't finished; don't rush to clear it.

examples.zh: 他花了三天才把这份报告写完。
examples.pinyin: Tā huā le sān tiān cái bǎ zhè fèn bào gào xiě wán。
examples.en: It took him three days to finish writing this report.

examples.zh: 我们把该谈的事都谈完了,剩下的以后再说。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men bǎ gāi tán de shì dōu tán wán le, shèng xià de yǐ hòu zài shuō。
examples.en: We've discussed all we needed; the rest can wait.

examples.zh: 这么多活儿,我一个人今天肯定做不完。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me duō huó er, wǒ yí gè rén jīn tiān kěn dìng zuò bù wán。
examples.en: With so much work, I definitely can't finish it alone today.

examples.zh: 孩子把碗里的饭吃得干干净净,一点儿都没剩。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi bǎ wǎn lǐ de fàn chī de gān gān jìng jìng, yì diǎn ér dōu méi shèng。
examples.en: The child ate the rice clean, leaving nothing behind.

examples.zh: 电影还没看完,他就困得睡着了。
examples.pinyin: Diàn yǐng hái méi kàn wán, tā jiù kùn de shuì zháo le。
examples.en: Before the movie ended, he fell asleep from tiredness.

examples.zh: 你把话说完啊,别说一半就不说了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ huà shuō wán a, bié shuō yí bàn jiù bù shuō le。
examples.en: Finish what you're saying; don't stop halfway.

examples.zh: 这些衣服洗完以后,记得晾到阳台上。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē yī fú xǐ wán yǐ hòu, jì de liàng dào yáng tái shàng。
examples.en: After washing these clothes, remember to hang them on the balcony.

examples.zh: 我得把这件事处理完才能安心休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ děi bǎ zhè jiàn shì chǔ lǐ wán cái néng ān xīn xiū xī。
examples.en: I must finish dealing with this before I can rest at ease.

examples.zh: 他一口气把一大杯水喝完,看来是真渴了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yì kǒu qì bǎ yī dà bēi shuǐ hē wán, kàn lái shì zhēn kě le。
examples.en: He downed a big cup of water in one go; he must have been really thirsty.

examples.zh: 考试的时间到了,我还有两道题没做完。
examples.pinyin: Kǎo shì de shí jiān dào le, wǒ hái yǒu liǎng dào tí méi zuò wán。
examples.en: The exam time is up, and I still have two questions unfinished.

examples.zh: 等大家都到齐、事情说完了,我们就散会。
examples.pinyin: Děng dà jiā dōu dào qí、 shì qíng shuō wán le, wǒ men jiù sàn huì。
examples.en: Once everyone's here and things are said, we'll adjourn.

examples.zh: 这项工程再有一个月就能全部完工了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gōng chéng zài yǒu yí gè yuè jiù néng quán bù wán gōng le。
examples.en: This project will be completely finished in another month.

examples.zh: 你把这杯药喝完,好好睡一觉就没事了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ zhè bēi yào hē wán, hǎo hǎo shuì yī jiào jiù méi shì le。
examples.en: Finish this medicine, sleep well, and you'll be fine.

examples.zh: 这么厚的一本书,你真的看完了吗?
examples.pinyin: Zhè me hòu de yī běn shū, nǐ zhēn de kàn wán le ma?
examples.en: Such a thick book — did you really finish it?

examples.zh: 我把该买的都买完了,咱们可以回家了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ gāi mǎi de dōu mǎi wán le, zán men kě yǐ huí jiā le。
examples.en: I've bought everything I needed; we can go home now.

examples.zh: 他还没把话讲完,电话就断了。
examples.pinyin: Tā hái méi bǎ huà jiǎng wán, diàn huà jiù duàn le。
examples.en: Before he could finish speaking, the call cut off.

examples.zh: 孩子们把蛋糕分完以后,开心地吃了起来。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi men bǎ dàn gāo fēn wán yǐ hòu, kāi xīn de chī le qǐ lái。
examples.en: After dividing the cake, the children happily started eating.

examples.zh: 这些材料你什么时候能整理完?我等着用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē cái liào nǐ shén me shí hòu néng zhěng lǐ wán? wǒ děng zhe yòng。
examples.en: When can you finish organizing these materials? I'm waiting to use them.

examples.zh: 等雨下完,我们就出发,现在先等一等。
examples.pinyin: Děng yǔ xià wán, wǒ men jiù chū fā, xiàn zài xiān děng yī děng。
examples.en: Once the rain stops, we'll set off; let's wait for now.

examples.zh: 他把一年的假一次就休完了,接下来要好好工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ yī nián de jiǎ yī cì jiù xiū wán le, jiē xià lái yào hǎo hǎo gōng zuò。
examples.en: He used up a year's leave all at once; now he'll work hard.

examples.zh: 这顿饭我们吃得又慢又开心,一直到很晚才吃完。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dùn fàn wǒ men chī de yòu màn yòu kāi xīn, yì zhí dào hěn wǎn cái chī wán。
examples.en: We ate this meal slowly and happily, not finishing until very late.

title: Sonuç tümleçleri: "到" ve "见"
summary: "到" ve "见" fiilin ardına gelip eylemin BAŞARIYLA sonuçlandığını gösterir: 看到/看见 = görebilmek (görmeyi başarmak); 找到 = bulmak.
explanation: "到" ve "见" sık kullanılan sonuç tümleçleridir; algı/kavrama fiillerinin ardına gelip eylemin BAŞARIYLA gerçekleştiğini bildirirler. "见" özellikle algı fiilleriyle (看/听/闻): 看见 (görmek — görmeyi başarmak), 听见 (işitmek). "到" hem algı hem de "elde etme/ulaşma" fiilleriyle: 看到 (görmek), 听到 (duymak), 找到 (bulmak), 买到 (bulup satın almak), 收到 (almak), 想到 (aklına gelmek). Aradaki fark ince: 看见 salt görme olayını, 看到 çoğu zaman ulaşılan sonucu vurgular; çoğu bağlamda ikisi de kullanılabilir. Olumsuzu "没(有)": 没看见 (görmedi/göremedi), 没找到 (bulamadı). Bu tümleçler bir çabanın SONUÇ verdiğini anlatır.

examples.zh: 我在人群里一眼就看见了你,你今天特别显眼。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài rén qún lǐ yī yǎn jiù kàn jiàn le nǐ, nǐ jīn tiān tè bié xiǎn yǎn。
examples.en: I spotted you at a glance in the crowd; you stand out today.

examples.zh: 找了整整一个上午,我终于找到了那份文件。
examples.pinyin: Zhǎo le zhěng zhěng yí gè shàng wǔ, wǒ zhōng yú zhǎo dào le nà fèn wén jiàn。
examples.en: After searching all morning, I finally found that document.

examples.zh: 你收到我昨天发给你的邮件了吗?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shōu dào wǒ zuó tiān fā gěi nǐ de yóu jiàn le ma?
examples.en: Did you receive the email I sent you yesterday?

examples.zh: 刚才我好像听见有人敲门,你去看看。
examples.pinyin: Gāng cái wǒ hǎo xiàng tīng jiàn yǒu rén qiāo mén, nǐ qù kàn kàn。
examples.en: I think I just heard someone knock; go check.

examples.zh: 这么小的字,我戴上眼镜才看得到。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me xiǎo de zì, wǒ dài shàng yǎn jìng cái kàn dé dào。
examples.en: Such small print — I can only see it with my glasses on.

examples.zh: 这种限量的鞋子很难买到,他排了一夜的队。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xiàn liàng de xié zi hěn nán mǎi dào, tā pái le yī yè de duì。
examples.en: This limited-edition shoe is hard to get; he queued all night.

examples.zh: 我怎么也想不到,他竟然会做出这样的事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zěn me yě xiǎng bú dào, tā jìng rán huì zuò chū zhè yàng de shì。
examples.en: I could never have imagined he'd do such a thing.

examples.zh: 站在山顶上,能看到整座城市的夜景。
examples.pinyin: Zhàn zài shān dǐng shàng, néng kàn dào zhěng zuò chéng shì de yè jǐng。
examples.en: Standing on the summit, you can see the whole city's night view.

examples.zh: 我在书店里没找到你要的那本书,是不是卖完了?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài shū diàn lǐ méi zhǎo dào nǐ yào de nà běn shū, shì bú shì mài wán le?
examples.en: I couldn't find the book you wanted at the store; is it sold out?

examples.zh: 隔着这么远,我都能闻到花园里花的香味。
examples.pinyin: Gé zhe zhè me yuǎn, wǒ dōu néng wén dào huā yuán lǐ huā de xiāng wèi。
examples.en: Even from this far, I can smell the flowers in the garden.

examples.zh: 他说话声音太小,坐在后排的同学根本听不到。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō huà shēng yīn tài xiǎo, zuò zài hòu pái de tóng xué gēn běn tīng bú dào。
examples.en: He speaks too softly; students in the back can't hear at all.

examples.zh: 多亏你提醒,我才想到今天是妈妈的生日。
examples.pinyin: Duō kuī nǐ tí xǐng, wǒ cái xiǎng dào jīn tiān shì mā mā de shēng rì。
examples.en: Thanks to your reminder, I remembered today is mom's birthday.

examples.zh: 我在旧箱子里找到了一张很老的全家福。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài jiù xiāng zi lǐ zhǎo dào le yī zhāng hěn lǎo de quán jiā fú。
examples.en: I found a very old family photo in the old box.

examples.zh: 刚一进门,我就闻到了饭菜的香味。
examples.pinyin: Gāng yī jìn mén, wǒ jiù wén dào le fàn cài de xiāng wèi。
examples.en: As soon as I entered, I smelled the aroma of the food.

examples.zh: 这个好消息你是从哪儿听到的?
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge hǎo xiāo xī nǐ shì cóng nǎ ér tīng dào de?
examples.en: Where did you hear this good news?

examples.zh: 我等了很久,终于等到了他平安归来的消息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ děng le hěn jiǔ, zhōng yú děng dào le tā píng ān guī lái de xiāo xī。
examples.en: After waiting a long time, I finally got word of his safe return.

examples.zh: 天太黑了,我看不见路,你打开手电筒吧。
examples.pinyin: Tiān tài hēi le, wǒ kàn bú jiàn lù, nǐ dǎ kāi shǒu diàn tǒng ba。
examples.en: It's too dark; I can't see the road, turn on the flashlight.

examples.zh: 经过多方打听,他总算找到了失散多年的哥哥。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò duō fāng dǎ tīng, tā zǒng suàn zhǎo dào le shī sàn duō nián dī gē gē。
examples.en: After much asking around, he finally found his long-lost brother.

examples.zh: 我买到了两张周末音乐会的票,一起去吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi dào le liǎng zhāng zhōu mò yīn yuè huì de piào, yì qǐ qù ba。
examples.en: I got two tickets to the weekend concert; let's go together.

examples.zh: 你没听到广播吗?火车马上就要开了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ méi tīng dào guǎng bō ma? huǒ chē mǎ shàng jiù yào kāi le。
examples.en: Didn't you hear the announcement? The train is about to leave.

examples.zh: 我突然想到一个好主意,也许能解决这个难题。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tū rán xiǎng dào yí gè hǎo zhǔ yì, yě xǔ néng jiě jué zhè ge nán tí。
examples.en: I suddenly thought of a good idea that might solve this problem.

examples.zh: 在那么多陌生的面孔中,我一下子看到了熟悉的他。
examples.pinyin: Zài nà me duō mò shēng de miàn kǒng zhōng, wǒ yī xià zi kàn dào le shú xī de tā。
examples.en: Among so many strangers, I instantly saw his familiar face.

examples.zh: 这封信我上周就收到了,一直忘了回复,真抱歉。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fēng xìn wǒ shàng zhōu jiù shōu dào le, yì zhí wàng le huí fù, zhēn bào qiàn。
examples.en: I received this letter last week but kept forgetting to reply; sorry.

examples.zh: 他到处打听,可惜一直没打听到有用的消息。
examples.pinyin: Tā dào chù dǎ tīng, kě xī yì zhí méi dǎ tīng dào yǒu yòng de xiāo xī。
examples.en: He asked around everywhere but sadly got no useful news.

examples.zh: 你要是看到我的钥匙,一定要告诉我一声。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào shì kàn dào wǒ de yào shi, yí dìng yào gào sù wǒ yī shēng。
examples.en: If you see my keys, be sure to let me know.

title: "一些" ile "bir miktar, birkaç"
summary: "一些" (yìxiē) belirsiz bir miktar/çokluk bildirir: "biraz, birkaç, bir kısım": 一些书 = birkaç kitap; 一些水 = biraz su.
explanation: "一些" belirsiz, küçük ya da orta bir miktarı bildirir ve hem SAYILABİLEN hem SAYILAMAYAN isimlerle kullanılabilir: 一些朋友 (birkaç arkadaş), 一些钱 (biraz para), 一些问题 (bazı sorunlar). Bir ölçü sözcüğü GEREKTİRMEZ — doğrudan isimden önce gelir. "一" çoğu zaman düşebilir ve sadece "些" kalır: 买些水果 (biraz meyve al). Sıfattan sonra gelip "biraz daha" karşılaştırması da yapar: 好一些 (biraz daha iyi), 便宜一些 (biraz daha ucuz). Türkçedeki "biraz, bir miktar, bazı, birkaç" karşılıklarına denk gelir; kesin sayı vermeden çokluk anlatmanın en yaygın yollarından biridir.

examples.zh: 我去超市买了一些水果和蔬菜,准备做晚饭。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù chāo shì mǎi le yī xiē shuǐ guǒ hé shū cài, zhǔn bèi zuò wǎn fàn。
examples.en: I went to the supermarket and bought some fruit and vegetables for dinner.

examples.zh: 关于这件事,我还有一些问题想问清楚。
examples.pinyin: Guān yú zhè jiàn shì, wǒ hái yǒu yī xiē wèn tí xiǎng wèn qīng chǔ。
examples.en: Regarding this matter, I still have some questions to clarify.

examples.zh: 他把一些旧衣服整理出来,送给了需要的人。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ yī xiē jiù yī fú zhěng lǐ chū lái, sòng gěi le xū yào de rén。
examples.en: He sorted out some old clothes and gave them to people in need.

examples.zh: 多喝一些水对身体好,尤其是天气干燥的时候。
examples.pinyin: Duō hē yī xiē shuǐ duì shēn tǐ hǎo, yóu qí shì tiān qì gān zào de shí hòu。
examples.en: Drinking more water is good for you, especially when the weather is dry.

examples.zh: 这次旅行我认识了一些有意思的新朋友。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚ xíng wǒ rèn shí le yī xiē yǒu yì si de xīn péng yǒu。
examples.en: On this trip I met some interesting new friends.

examples.zh: 桌子上放着一些点心,大家随便吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe yī xiē diǎn xīn, dà jiā suí biàn chī。
examples.en: There are some snacks on the table; help yourselves.

examples.zh: 吃过药,休息了一会儿,他觉得好了一些。
examples.pinyin: Chī guò yào, xiū xī le yī huì er, tā jué de hǎo le yī xiē。
examples.en: After the medicine and a rest, he felt a bit better.

examples.zh: 我从书里学到了一些做人的道理。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cóng shū lǐ xué dào le yī xiē zuò rén de dào lǐ。
examples.en: I learned some principles of life from the book.

examples.zh: 你能不能便宜一些?我一次买这么多。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng bù néng pián yi yī xiē? wǒ yī cì mǎi zhè me duō。
examples.en: Could you make it a bit cheaper? I'm buying so much at once.

examples.zh: 妈妈往我包里塞了一些家乡的特产。
examples.pinyin: Mā mā wǎng wǒ bāo lǐ sāi le yī xiē jiā xiāng de tè chǎn。
examples.en: Mom stuffed some hometown specialties into my bag.

examples.zh: 这些年他积累了一些经验,做事越来越稳。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē nián tā jī lěi le yī xiē jīng yàn, zuò shì yuè lái yuè wěn。
examples.en: Over the years he's gained some experience and works ever more steadily.

examples.zh: 天冷了,你该添一些厚衣服了。
examples.pinyin: Tiān lěng le, nǐ gāi tiān yī xiē hòu yī fú le。
examples.en: It's gotten cold; you should add some warm clothes.

examples.zh: 会上,大家提出了一些很有价值的建议。
examples.pinyin: Huì shàng, dà jiā tí chū le yī xiē hěn yǒu jià zhí de jiàn yì。
examples.en: At the meeting, everyone offered some valuable suggestions.

examples.zh: 我给孩子讲了一些小时候的趣事,他听得很入迷。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gěi hái zi jiǎng le yī xiē xiǎo shí hòu de qù shì, tā tīng de hěn rù mí。
examples.en: I told the child some funny childhood stories, and he was fascinated.

examples.zh: 这道菜再放一些盐,味道会更好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài zài fàng yī xiē yán, wèi dào huì gèng hǎo。
examples.en: Add a bit more salt to this dish and it'll taste better.

examples.zh: 他攒了一些钱,打算给父母换一台新电视。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǎn le yī xiē qián, dǎ suàn gěi fù mǔ huàn yī tái xīn diàn shì。
examples.en: He saved some money to buy his parents a new TV.

examples.zh: 经过这件事,我明白了一些以前不懂的道理。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò zhè jiàn shì, wǒ míng bái le yī xiē yǐ qián bù dǒng de dào lǐ。
examples.en: Through this, I understood some things I hadn't grasped before.

examples.zh: 周末我想在家看一些书,顺便休息休息。
examples.pinyin: Zhōu mò wǒ xiǎng zài jiā kàn yī xiē shū, shùn biàn xiū xī xiū xī。
examples.en: This weekend I want to read some books at home and rest a bit.

examples.zh: 路边开着一些不知名的小花,特别可爱。
examples.pinyin: Lù biān kāi zhe yī xiē bù zhī míng de xiǎo huā, tè bié kě ài。
examples.en: Some unnamed little flowers bloom by the road, so lovely.

examples.zh: 你脸色好一些了,看来药起作用了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ liǎn sè hǎo yī xiē le, kàn lái yào qǐ zuò yòng le。
examples.en: Your color looks a bit better; the medicine seems to be working.

examples.zh: 我在网上查了一些资料,对这个问题有了新的认识。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài wǎng shàng chá le yī xiē zī liào, duì zhè ge wèn tí yǒu le xīn de rèn shí。
examples.en: I looked up some information online and gained new insight into this.

examples.zh: 请你留一些空白,方便以后补充内容。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ liú yī xiē kòng bái, fāng biàn yǐ hòu bǔ chōng nèi róng。
examples.en: Please leave some blank space for adding content later.

examples.zh: 这几天忙,我落下了一些工作,得赶紧补上。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān máng, wǒ là xià le yī xiē gōng zuò, de gǎn jǐn bǔ shàng。
examples.en: I've been busy and fell behind on some work; I must catch up.

examples.zh: 他给了我一些鼓励,让我重新有了信心。
examples.pinyin: Tā gěi le wǒ yī xiē gǔ lì, ràng wǒ chóng xīn yǒu le xìn xīn。
examples.en: He gave me some encouragement, restoring my confidence.

examples.zh: 超市门口摆着一些刚到的新鲜草莓。
examples.pinyin: Chāo shì mén kǒu bǎi zhe yī xiē gāng dào de xīn xiān cǎo méi。
examples.en: Some freshly arrived strawberries are displayed at the supermarket entrance.

title: "有的" ile "bazıları, kimi"
summary: "有的" (yǒude) bir bütünün İÇİNDEN "bazıları, kimileri" der ve çoğu zaman tekrarlanır: 有的...有的... = kimi..., kimi...
explanation: "有的" bir grubun/bütünün İÇİNDEKİ bir kısmı seçip belirtir: "bazıları, kimisi, bir kısmı". Çoğu zaman İKİ ya da daha çok kez tekrarlanarak karşılaştırma kurar: 有的人喜欢喝茶,有的人喜欢喝咖啡 (Kimi insan çay sever, kimi kahve). Bir isimden önce gelir (有的书, 有的地方) ya da tek başına "有的" = "bazıları" olarak durabilir. "一些"den farkı: "一些" belirsiz bir MİKTAR verir; "有的" ise bilinen bir bütünün içinden bir ALT KÜMEYİ ayırır ve çoğu zaman "..., diğerleri..." karşıtlığını kurar. Türkçedeki "kimi..., kimi...; bazıları..., bazıları..." yapısına birebir denk gelir.

examples.zh: 同样一件事,有的人觉得难,有的人觉得容易。
examples.pinyin: Tóng yàng yī jiàn shì, yǒu de rén jué de nán, yǒu de rén jué de róng yì。
examples.en: For the same thing, some find it hard while others find it easy.

examples.zh: 这些苹果有的很甜,有的却有点儿酸。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē píng guǒ yǒu de hěn tián, yǒu de què yǒu diǎn ér suān。

examples.zh: 下课以后,有的同学去打球,有的回家写作业。
examples.pinyin: Xià kè yǐ hòu, yǒu de tóng xué qù dǎ qiú, yǒu de huí jiā xiě zuò yè。
examples.en: After class, some students play ball while others go home to study.

examples.zh: 这些书有的很有意思,有的读起来比较枯燥。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē shū yǒu de hěn yǒu yì si, yǒu de dú qǐ lái bǐ jiào kū zào。

examples.zh: 周末大家的安排都不一样,有的休息,有的还要加班。

examples.zh: 公园里,有的老人在下棋,有的在打太极。

examples.zh: 这几条路,有的近但难走,有的远却很平坦。

examples.zh: 这些问题,有的容易解决,有的还得慢慢想办法。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē wèn tí, yǒu de róng yì jiě jué, yǒu de hái de màn màn xiǎng bàn fǎ。

examples.zh: 天气变化大,有的人穿着外套,有的人还穿着短袖。

examples.zh: 桌上的菜,有的辣,有的淡,总有一样合你口味。

title: Para sayma (块 / 毛 / 分)
pattern: Sayı + 块 / 元 (+ Sayı + 毛 / 角 + Sayı + 分)
summary: Para konuşma dilinde 块 (yuan), 毛 (0,1 yuan) ve 分 (0,01 yuan) ile sayılır: 三块五 = 3,5 yuan.
explanation: Çince'de para sayarken üç birim vardır: 块 (kuài, resmî yazıda 元 yuán) = ana birim; 毛 (máo, resmî 角 jiǎo) = 块'ın onda biri; 分 (fēn) = yüzde biri. Konuşma dilinde 块/毛/分, resmî/yazılı dilde 元/角/分 kullanılır. Örnek: 三块五毛 (3,5 yuan), çoğu zaman son birim düşürülür: 三块五 (3,5). Sadece iki için "两" gelir: 两块 (2 yuan). Fiyat sorulurken "多少钱?" (ne kadar?) denir. "钱" (para) sözcüğü sonda eklenebilir: 五块钱 (5 yuan). Bütün sayılar Çince rakamlarla yazılır. Bu, günlük alışverişte en gerekli kalıplardan biridir.

examples.zh: 我给了他一百块,他找了我三十五块。

examples.zh: 这个西瓜十几块钱,又大又甜,很值。

examples.zh: 坐一次地铁三块钱,一个月下来也不少。

examples.zh: 这条围巾我花了一百二十块,妈妈很喜欢。

examples.zh: 请问这个多少钱一个?我想买五个。

examples.zh: 我兜里就剩十几块钱了,得去取点儿了。

examples.zh: 他省吃俭用,一个月能攒下两三千块。

examples.zh: 门票成人五十块,小孩半价二十五块。

examples.zh: 这台旧手机卖了三百块,总比放着强。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái jiù shǒu jī mài le sān bǎi kuài, zǒng bǐ fàng zhe qiáng。

examples.zh: 一杯咖啡要三十多块,我还是自己泡吧。

examples.zh: 这条鱼十五块一斤,新鲜得很,买一条吧。

examples.en: This fish is fifteen yuan a jin, very fresh; let's buy one.

examples.zh: 孩子的这双鞋两百多块,可是特别耐穿。

examples.zh: 你这件毛衣真好看,花了多少钱买的?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhè jiàn máo yī zhēn hǎo kàn, huā le duō shǎo qián mǎi de?

examples.zh: 水电费这个月一共交了三百六十块。

examples.zh: 这家理发店剪头发才二十块,手艺还不错。

examples.zh: 我买这些文具一共花了不到十块钱。

examples.en: I spent less than ten yuan on all this stationery.

examples.zh: 请帮我换一些零钱,我要坐公交车。

title: "每" ile "her"
pattern: 每 + Ölçü Sözcüğü (+ İsim) ... 都 ...
summary: "每" (měi) "her" demektir ve çoğu zaman yüklemde "都" ile birlikte gelir: 每天都学习 = her gün çalışır.
explanation: "每" bir bütünün İSTİSNASIZ her bir üyesini kapsar: "her". Ardından çoğu zaman bir ölçü sözcüğü gelir: 每个人 (her insan), 每天 (her gün — 天 kendi ölçüsü olduğundan doğrudan), 每次 (her sefer), 每年 (her yıl). Çok önemli kural: "每"li cümlede yüklemden önce sıklıkla "都" (hepsi/tümü) gelir ve "istisnasız hepsi" vurgusunu tamamlar: 每个学生都很努力 (Her öğrenci çok çalışkan). 天/年/次 gibi kendi başına ölçü olan sözcükler dışında "每" tek başına isimle kullanılmaz, araya ölçü sözcüğü girer: 每一本书 (her kitap). Türkçedeki "her, her bir" karşılığıdır ve genelleme yapmanın temel yoludur.

examples.zh: 他每天早上都六点起床,风雨无阻地去跑步。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zǎo shàng dōu liù diǎn qǐ chuáng, fēng yǔ wú zǔ de qù pǎo bù。
examples.en: He gets up at six every morning and runs, rain or shine.

examples.zh: 我们班每个同学都参加了这次的公益活动。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men bān měi gè tóng xué dōu cān jiā le zhè cì de gōng yì huó dòng。
examples.en: Every student in our class took part in this charity event.

examples.zh: 这家店每到周末都排起长长的队。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn měi dào zhōu mò dōu pái qǐ cháng cháng de duì。
examples.en: This shop has a long queue every weekend.

examples.zh: 妈妈每次做红烧肉,我都能多吃一碗饭。
examples.pinyin: Mā mā měi cì zuò hóng shāo ròu, wǒ dōu néng duō chī yī wǎn fàn。
examples.en: Every time mom makes braised pork, I eat an extra bowl of rice.

examples.zh: 他把每一分钱都花在了该花的地方。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ měi yī fēn qián dōu huā zài le gāi huā de dì fāng。
examples.en: He spent every cent where it was needed.

examples.zh: 每年春节,在外的游子都会赶回家团聚。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián chūn jié, zài wài de yóu zi dū huì gǎn huí jiā tuán jù。
examples.en: Every Spring Festival, those away rush home to reunite.

examples.zh: 老师对每个学生都很关心,从不偏心。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo shī duì měi gè xué shēng dōu hěn guān xīn, cóng bù piān xīn。
examples.en: The teacher cares about every student and never plays favorites.

examples.zh: 这条路我每天都走,闭着眼睛都不会走错。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù wǒ měi tiān dōu zǒu, bì zhuó yǎn jīng dōu bú huì zǒu cuò。
examples.en: I walk this road every day; I could do it with my eyes closed.

examples.zh: 他每做一件事都特别认真,从不马虎。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi zuò yī jiàn shì dōu tè bié rèn zhēn, cóng bù mǎ hǔ。
examples.en: He does everything with great care and is never sloppy.

examples.zh: 每逢下雨,这个路口就特别容易堵车。
examples.pinyin: Měi féng xià yǔ, zhè ge lù kǒu jiù tè bié róng yì dǔ chē。
examples.en: Whenever it rains, this intersection jams easily.

examples.zh: 我们每个月都会聚一次,聊聊各自的近况。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men měi gè yuè dū huì jù yī cì, liáo liáo gè zì de jìn kuàng。
examples.en: We meet once every month to catch up on each other's lives.

examples.zh: 这里的每一棵树都是当年他们亲手种下的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de měi yī kē shù dōu shì dāng nián tā men qīn shǒu zhòng xià de。
examples.en: Every tree here was planted by their own hands back then.

examples.zh: 他每天晚上都要检查一遍孩子的作业。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān wǎn shàng dōu yào jiǎn chá yī biàn hái zi de zuò yè。
examples.en: Every night he checks the child's homework.

examples.zh: 每个来过这里的人,都会被这里的风景打动。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè lái guò zhè lǐ de rén, dū huì bèi zhè lǐ de fēng jǐng dǎ dòng。
examples.en: Everyone who's been here is moved by the scenery.

examples.zh: 公司规定,每位员工每年都有带薪假期。
examples.pinyin: Gōng sī guī dìng, měi wèi yuán gōng měi nián dōu yǒu dài xīn jià qī。
examples.en: The company rule gives every employee paid leave each year.

examples.zh: 她把每天要做的事都仔仔细细地记在本子上。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ měi tiān yào zuò de shì dōu zǎi zǐ xì xì de jì zài běn zi shàng。
examples.en: She carefully records everything she has to do each day in a notebook.

examples.zh: 每当想起那段日子,他心里都充满了感激。
examples.pinyin: Měi dāng xiǎng qǐ nà duàn rì zi, tā xīn lǐ dōu chōng mǎn le gǎn jī。
examples.en: Whenever he recalls those days, his heart fills with gratitude.

examples.zh: 这套书每一册都值得反复阅读。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tào shū měi yī cè dōu zhí de fǎn fù yuè dú。
examples.en: Every volume of this set is worth reading again and again.

examples.zh: 他对待每一位客人都热情周到。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì dài měi yī wèi kè rén dōu rè qíng zhōu dào。
examples.en: He treats every guest warmly and attentively.

examples.zh: 每次考试之前,他都会紧张得睡不好觉。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì kǎo shì zhī qián, tā dū huì jǐn zhāng de shuì bù hǎo jué。
examples.en: Before every exam, he gets so nervous he can't sleep well.

examples.zh: 这条河两岸,每到春天都开满了野花。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé liǎng àn, měi dào chūn tiān dōu kāi mǎn le yě huā。
examples.en: Both banks of this river bloom with wildflowers every spring.

examples.zh: 每个人的生活方式不同,我们应该互相尊重。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén de shēng huó fāng shì bù tóng, wǒ men yīng gāi hù xiāng zūn zhòng。
examples.en: Everyone's way of life differs; we should respect one another.

examples.zh: 他每读完一本书,都要写下自己的感受。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi dú wán yī běn shū, dōu yào xiě xià zì jǐ de gǎn shòu。
examples.en: After finishing every book, he writes down his thoughts.

examples.zh: 这家医院每天都要接待成百上千的病人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yī yuàn měi tiān dōu yào jiē dài chéng bǎi shàng qiān de bìng rén。
examples.en: This hospital receives hundreds or thousands of patients every day.

examples.zh: 每一次失败,其实都是一次重新开始的机会。
examples.pinyin: Měi yī cì shī bài, qí shí dōu shì yī cì chóng xīn kāi shǐ de jī huì。
examples.en: Every failure is actually a chance to start anew.

title: "半" ile "yarım"
pattern: Sayı + Ölçü + 半 + İsim / 半 + Ölçü + İsim
summary: "半" (bàn) "yarım" demektir: 半个 = yarım (tane); 一个半 = bir buçuk.
explanation: "半" "yarım" anlamı taşır ve ölçü sözcükleriyle iki türlü kullanılır: (1) TEK BAŞINA yarım — 半 + ölçü + isim: 半个苹果 (yarım elma), 半杯水 (yarım bardak su), 半个小时 (yarım saat). (2) TAM SAYI + BUÇUK — sayı + ölçü + 半: 一个半小时 (bir buçuk saat), 三斤半 (üç buçuk jin). Yani "buçuk" için "半" ölçü sözcüğünden SONRA gelir. Saatlerde "半" "otuz dakika"yı verir: 八点半 (sekiz buçuk). "一半" ise "yarısı" anlamında bir isim gibidir: 这个苹果的一半 (bu elmanın yarısı). Miktarları hassas anlatmada temel bir sözcüktür; bütün sayılar Çince rakamlarla yazılır.

examples.zh: 我早上只吃了半个包子,现在饿得不行了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zǎo shàng zhǐ chī le bàn gè bāo zi, xiàn zài è de bù xíng le。
examples.en: I only ate half a bun this morning; now I'm starving.

examples.zh: 从家到公司要一个半小时,路上真够远的。
examples.pinyin: Cóng jiā dào gōng sī yào yí gè bàn xiǎo shí, lù shàng zhēn gòu yuǎn de。
examples.en: It takes an hour and a half from home to work; the way is really far.

examples.zh: 这瓶饮料你喝一半,剩下的半瓶留给弟弟。
examples.pinyin: Zhè píng yǐn liào nǐ hē yí bàn, shèng xià de bàn píng liú gěi dì di。
examples.en: Drink half this bottle and leave the other half for your brother.

examples.zh: 会议开了两个半小时,大家都有点儿累了。
examples.pinyin: Huì yì kāi le liǎng gè bàn xiǎo shí, dà jiā dōu yǒu diǎn ér lèi le。
examples.en: The meeting lasted two and a half hours; everyone got a bit tired.

examples.zh: 这块蛋糕太大了,咱们一人一半,分着吃吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuài dàn gāo tài dà le, zán men yī rén yí bàn, fēn zhe chī ba。
examples.en: This cake is too big; let's split it in half and share.

examples.zh: 他每天只睡五个半小时,难怪脸色这么差。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zhǐ shuì wǔ gè bàn xiǎo shí, nán guài liǎn sè zhè me chà。
examples.en: He sleeps only five and a half hours a day; no wonder he looks so pale.

examples.zh: 我称了半斤瓜子,一边看电视一边吃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chēng le bàn jīn guā zi, yī biān kàn diàn shì yī biān chī。
examples.en: I weighed half a jin of seeds to eat while watching TV.

examples.zh: 这半年他变化很大,整个人成熟了不少。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bàn nián tā biàn huà hěn dà, zhěng gè rén chéng shú le bù shǎo。
examples.en: He's changed a lot in this half year, becoming much more mature.

examples.zh: 孩子把苹果咬了一半就不吃了,真浪费。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi bǎ píng guǒ yǎo le yí bàn jiù bù chī le, zhēn làng fèi。
examples.en: The child bit half the apple and stopped; such a waste.

examples.zh: 我们等了半天,他才姗姗来迟。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men děng le bàn tiān, tā cái shān shān lái chí。
examples.en: We waited a long while before he finally showed up late.

examples.zh: 这份工作我干了一年半,学到了不少东西。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōng zuò wǒ gàn le yī nián bàn, xué dào le bù shǎo dōng xī。
examples.en: I did this job for a year and a half and learned a lot.

examples.zh: 再走半个小时就到山顶了,大家加把劲。
examples.pinyin: Zài zǒu bàn gè xiǎo shí jiù dào shān dǐng le, dà jiā jiā bǎ jìn。
examples.en: Another half hour and we'll reach the summit; keep it up, everyone.

examples.zh: 他把攒下的钱分成两半,一半存起来,一半给父母。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ zǎn xià de qián fēn chéng liǎng bàn, yí bàn cún qǐ lái, yí bàn gěi fù mǔ。
examples.en: He split his savings in half: one to save, one for his parents.

examples.zh: 这杯茶只剩半杯了,凉了就不好喝了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bēi chá zhǐ shèng bàn bēi le, liáng le jiù bù hǎo hē le。
examples.en: Only half a cup of tea is left; it won't taste good cold.

examples.zh: 那本书我看了一半,后半部分一直没时间读。
examples.pinyin: Nà běn shū wǒ kàn le yí bàn, hòu bàn bù fèn yì zhí méi shí jiān dú。
examples.en: I read half the book; I never had time for the second half.

examples.zh: 这条鱼三斤半,够我们一家人吃一顿了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo yú sān jīn bàn, gòu wǒ men yī jiā rén chī yī dùn le。
examples.en: This fish is three and a half jin, enough for our family's meal.

examples.zh: 他画了半张纸就停了下来,好像没了灵感。
examples.pinyin: Tā huà le bàn zhāng zhǐ jiù tíng le xià lái, hǎo xiàng méi le líng gǎn。
examples.en: He drew half a page and stopped, as if out of inspiration.

examples.zh: 我们班一半的同学都报名参加了合唱比赛。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men bān yí bàn de tóng xué dōu bào míng cān jiā le hé chàng bǐ sài。
examples.en: Half of our class signed up for the choral competition.

examples.zh: 再等半分钟,水就烧开了,你别着急。
examples.pinyin: Zài děng bàn fēn zhōng, shuǐ jiù shāo kāi le, nǐ bié zháo jí。
examples.en: Wait another half minute and the water will boil; don't rush.

examples.zh: 这袋米还剩下半袋,估计还能吃一个星期。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dài mǐ hái shèng xià bàn dài, gū jì hái néng chī yí gè xīng qī。
examples.en: Half a bag of rice is left; it should last about a week.

examples.zh: 孩子刚满一岁半,已经会说不少话了。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi gāng mǎn yī suì bàn, yǐ jīng huì shuō bù shǎo huà le。
examples.en: The child just turned one and a half and can already say quite a lot.

examples.zh: 路走了一半,他忽然想起忘带钱包了。
examples.pinyin: Lù zǒu le yí bàn, tā hū rán xiǎng qǐ wàng dài qián bāo le。
examples.en: Halfway down the road, he suddenly realized he'd forgotten his wallet.

examples.zh: 这道题我只做对了一半,还得再仔细检查。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí wǒ zhǐ zuò duì le yí bàn, hái de zài zǐ xì jiǎn chá。
examples.en: I got only half of this problem right; I need to recheck carefully.

examples.zh: 一天的活儿干了一大半,剩下的明天再说。
examples.pinyin: Yī tiān de huó er gàn le yī dà bàn, shèng xià de míng tiān zài shuō。
examples.en: We've done most of the day's work; the rest can wait till tomorrow.

examples.zh: 他把半生的心血都投入到了这份事业里。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ bàn shēng de xīn xuè dōu tóu rù dào le zhè fèn shì yè lǐ。
examples.en: He poured half a lifetime of effort into this endeavor.
